# Codebase map

Deep reference for `mindbound/Hbm-s-Nuclear-Tech-DBS` (NTM: Space fork). Paths are repo-relative; `com/hbm/...` means `src/main/java/com/hbm/...`. Line numbers are from the 2026-09-24 snapshot and will drift; method and class names are the stable anchors. Every area was surveyed and then adversarially verified against source; where the verifier could not settle a point it is listed under "Open questions".

Areas:

1. Bootstrap, lifecycle, config, commands
2. Public API packages (`api.hbm`, `cofh`) and repo meta
3. Blocks: registration and generic blocks
4. Blocks: machines, bombs, networks (BlockDummyable)
5. Tile entities: base classes and common machines
6. Tile entities: RBMK, fusion, Albion, bombs, turrets, deco
7. Energy/fluid networks (UNINOS) and packet threading
8. Items
9. Weapons: sedna gun system, projectiles, missiles, grenades
10. Recipes, ore dictionary, fluids, materials, item pools
11. Containers, GUIs, NEI
12. Entities, mobs, explosions
13. Hazards, radiation, pollution, neutron, atmosphere, compat, saved data
14. Dimensions and world generation (NTM: Space)
15. Client rendering, models, animations, particles, sound
16. Networking, packets, utilities, wiaj
17. Resources, localization, build, tooling
18. OpenComputers integration

---

## 1. Bootstrap, lifecycle, config, commands

### Purpose

`com/hbm/main/MainRegistry.java` is the single `@Mod` class (modid `hbm`). It owns every FML lifecycle hook, all registration ordering, config loading, command registration and missing-mapping remaps. `ServerProxy`/`ClientProxy` are the sided proxies. Four `ModEventHandler*` classes subscribe to the Forge/FML buses. `com/hbm/config/` holds the Forge-`Configuration`-backed static config classes (one `hbm.cfg`) plus JSON runtime configs written to `config/hbmConfig/`. `com/hbm/commands/` holds the `/ntm*` commands. `extprop/` carries per-entity radiation/keybind/shield state, `potion/` the reflective potion registrar, `qmaw/` the F1 manual, `module/` reusable TE helper objects, `interfaces/` marker interfaces and annotations.

### Patterns

- Sided proxy: `@SidedProxy(clientSide=RefStrings.CLIENTSIDE, serverSide=RefStrings.SERVERSIDE) public static ServerProxy proxy`. Add a new client hook to `ServerProxy` as a no-op first, override in `ClientProxy`; common code calls `MainRegistry.proxy.x()`.
- PreLoad order: `CrashHelper.init` -> config dirs -> `Identity.init` (writes `identity` into top-level `config/`, not `hbmConfig`) -> `loadConfig()` -> `HbmPotion.init` -> `Mats.MAT_STONE` touch -> `Fluids.init` -> `proxy.registerPreRenderInfo` -> `ModBlocks.mainRegistry` -> `ModItems.mainRegistry` -> `com.hbm.dbs.DBSFork.init` (fork hook: creative tabs + recipe listener) -> `ModBiomes.init` -> `proxy.registerRenderInfo` -> `HbmWorld.mainRegistry` -> FuelHandler -> `BulletConfigSyncingUtil` -> `CellularDungeonFactory` -> `XSatelliteRegistry` -> `HTTPHandler.loadStats` -> `CraftingManager.mainRegistry` -> `SiegeTier` -> `HazardRegistry.registerItems/registerTrafos` -> `XWeaponModManager` -> `SolarSystem.init` -> `OreDictManager` (`EVENT_BUS.register(new OreDictManager())`, `registerGroups` BEFORE `registerOres`) -> `BiomeGenCraterBase.initDictionary` (if crater biomes) -> repair items -> `NetworkRegistry.registerGuiHandler(GUIHandler)` -> `TileMappings.writeMappings` -> `MachineDynConfig.initialize` -> `TileEntityLaunchPadBase.registerLaunchables` -> `GameRegistry.registerTileEntity(WithAlternatives)` loop (L338-345) -> ChestGenHooks -> `EntityMappings.writeMappings` -> ForgeChunkManager callback -> `DispenserBehaviorHandler` -> `MicroBlocksCompatHandler.preInit`.
- Second preinit (`preInit`): registers `ModEventHandler` (FML + EVENT_BUS + TERRAIN_GEN_BUS + ORE_GEN_BUS), `ModEventHandlerImpact`, `PacketDispatcher.registerPackets()`, `ChunkRadiationManager`, `PollutionHandler`, `DamageResistanceHandler`, `ChunkAtmosphereManager`, `CelestialNukeShockHandler`, `NeutronHandler`, `BlockMigrations`; client: `HbmKeybinds.register()`.
- `load`: `RodRecipes.registerInit`, achievements + `AchievementPage` (L467), `BobmazonOfferFactory.init` (after achievements), `IMCHandler.registerHandler("blastfurnace"/"crystallizer"/"centrifuge")`, `PlanetGen.init`, GTNH-NEI gate (L543-547).
- `PostLoad` order (load-bearing): `Fluids.reloadFluids` + `FluidContainerRegistry.register` -> MagicRecipes/Lemegeton/SILEX/GasCentrifuge -> `CustomMachineConfigJSON.initialize` -> `SerializableRecipe.registerAllHandlers` + `initialize` -> `AnvilRecipes.register` -> `RadiolysisRecipes` (throws if `CrackingRecipes` empty) -> `FalloutConfigJSON` -> `ItemPoolConfigJSON` -> `ClientConfig.initConfig` (also on dedicated server) + `ServerConfig.initConfig` -> `TileEntityNukeCustom.registerBombItems` -> `ArmorUtil.register` (L599, hazard classes) -> `HazmatRegistry.registerHazmats` (L600, rad resistance; both tables freeze here, so armor must be constructed before PostLoad) -> DamageResistance/BlockToolConversion/AchievementHandler -> `MobUtil` pools -> `LogicBlock*` -> `proxy.registerMissileItems` -> `CompatHandler.init` (OC, L614) -> `AE2CompatHandler.init` (L617) -> `SchistStratum` on EVENT_BUS (L622) -> `OreLayer3D`/`OreCave` instances -> `BedrockOre.init` -> `PlanetGen.overrideOverworldProvider` -> client commands (`SuicideThreadDump`, `CommandReloadClient`, `CommandWikiRender`) -> `WorldTypeTeleport.init`.
- `serverStart(FMLServerStartingEvent)`: `RBMKDials.createDials(world)`, then `event.registerServerCommand(new CommandX())` for each command, then `ArcFurnaceRecipes.registerFurnaceSmeltables()` (deferred so other mods' furnace recipes exist).
- Forge config: one `Configuration(event.getSuggestedConfigurationFile())`; each `XConfig` has `public static` fields + `static void loadFromConfig(Configuration)`; keys `N.NN_camelName` under `CommonConfig.CATEGORY_*`; `config.save()` once. Values are final after preinit (no reload). MobConfig uses `12.M00_`, RadiationConfig `FOG_00_`/`AMBIENT_00_`/`RADIATION_99_`.
- JSON runtime config: subclass `RunningConfig`, `public static ConfigWrapper<T> NAME = new ConfigWrapper(default)`, register in `initDefaults()` into `configMap`; read with `ServerConfig.X.get()`; `/ntmserver set|get|list|reload`.
- Template-vs-live JSON pattern (Fallout, ItemPools, `hbmArmor.json`, `hbmRadResist.json`, `hbmFluidTraits.json`, `hbmRecipes/`): defaults built in code; `_hbmX.json` template written when `hbmX.json` is absent; when present it REPLACES the defaults.
- Missing mappings: `handleMissingMappings` fills `ignoreMappings` (HashSet) and `remapItems` (5 entries), ignores `hbm:item.ammo_*` prefix, remaps ITEM types only; there is no block remap branch.
- Keybinds: static `KeyBinding` in `HbmKeybinds`; server side via `EnumKeybind` -> `KeybindPacket` -> `HbmPlayerProps.setKeyPressed`; items implement `IKeybindReceiver`. QMAW/Jars use raw `Keyboard.isKeyDown(HbmKeybinds.qmaw.getKeyCode())` in `ModEventHandlerClient.clientTick`, not `getIsKeyPressed`.
- Marker annotations: `@Spaghetti(String)` (~26 uses), `@Untested` (~14), `@NotableComments` (~39); purely documentary.
- Logging: `MainRegistry.logger` (`LogManager.getLogger("HBM")` L121; `preInit` replaces it with `event.getModLog()` while it is null) is used in ~92 files and is the only logger (`CompatHandler` fetches the same `"HBM"` logger). Prefix the subsystem in brackets (`[QMAW]` 13 uses, `[Debug]` 10, `[Jigsaw]`, `[DET]`, `[BOMBPL]`). 62 `System.out.println` calls in 24 files are legacy; do not add more.
- Debug aids: `GeneralConfig.enableDebugMode` (`hbm.cfg` `1.00_enableDebugMode`; verbose worldgen/structure/dungeon logging, 17 sites), `ServerConfig.STRUCTURE_DEBUG` (`/ntmserver set STRUCTURE_DEBUG true`: jigsaw diagnostics, air-palette markers, `SpawnCondition.buildAll(world, x, y, z)`), `ClientConfig.SHOW_BLOCK_META_OVERLAY` and `DODD_RBMK_DIAGNOSTIC` (`/ntmclient set ...`; look overlays), `MobConfig.waypointDebug` (renders glyphid waypoints), `/ntmpackets info`, `/ntmrad`, `/ntmlocate`, `/ntmloadchunk`; F3+T fires `HFRModelReloader` (OBJ/VBO rebuild) and `QMAWLoader`; the dev run dir is `eclipse/` (`.gitignore`d, holds its own `config/`).

### How-to

- New `hbm.cfg` option: pick/add a `CommonConfig.CATEGORY_*`; add `public static <type> field = default;` to the matching `XConfig`; in `loadFromConfig` add `field = CommonConfig.createConfigBool(config, CATEGORY, "N.NN_fieldName", "comment", default);` keeping the numeric sequence; for a new class add `XConfig.loadFromConfig(config)` in `MainRegistry.loadConfig()` before `config.save()`. Exemplar `com/hbm/config/ToolConfig.java`.
- Runtime-editable option: in `ServerConfig`/`ClientConfig` add `public static ConfigWrapper<Boolean> MY_FLAG = new ConfigWrapper(false);` and `configMap.put("MY_FLAG", MY_FLAG);` in `initDefaults()`. Nothing else.
- New `/ntm*` command: `CommandBase` subclass in `com/hbm/commands/`; register in `serverStart(FMLServerStartingEvent)`; client-only commands self-register in a static `register()` guarded by `FMLLaunchHandler.side() != Side.CLIENT` and called from PostLoad. Exemplar `CommandRadiation.java`.
- Machine config via `hbmMachines.json`: implement `com.hbm.tileentity.IConfigurableMachine` (`getConfigName`, `readIfPresent` using `IConfigurableMachine.grab(obj, "I:key", default)` with `I:/L:/D:/B:/D[:` prefixes, `writeConfig`); the TE must be in `TileMappings.writeMappings()` (put() auto-adds it to `configurables`). Exemplar `tileentity/machine/TileEntityMachineCentrifuge.java`.
- Client keybind: `KeyBinding` field + `ClientRegistry.registerKeyBinding` in `HbmKeybinds.register()`, lang `hbm.key.foo`; for server awareness add an `EnumKeybind` constant, a case in `ClientProxy.getIsKeyPressed`, and handle in `HbmPlayerProps.setKeyPressed` or `IKeybindReceiver`.
- Extended-props field: add to `HbmPlayerProps`/`HbmLivingProps`, persist in `saveNBTData`/`loadNBTData`, append to `serialize`/`deserialize` in the same order if the client needs it or it must survive respawn (`onPlayerClone` copies only that subset, on every clone incl. End-portal return).
- New potion: `PotionConfig` id (`8.NN_fooID`), `HbmPotion.registerPotion(...)` in `init()`, branches in `performEffect`/`isReady`, icon in `textures/gui/potions.png`, lang `potion.hbm_foo`.
- Creative tab: subclass in `com/hbm/creativetabs/` with null-guarded `getTabIconItem()`; static in `MainRegistry` with `CreativeTabs.getNextID()`; lang `itemGroup.tabFoo`.
- QMAW page: see area 17 (all four of `name`, `title`, `content`, `trigger` are mandatory).
- Access transformer line: append `public net.minecraft.pkg.Class field_xxxxx_y # readableName` (or `func_...(desc)`), then `./gradlew clean setupDecompWorkspace`.
- IMC handler: `extends IMCHandler` (abstract class, `process(IMCMessage)`), `IMCHandler.registerHandler("key", new IMCFoo())` in `load()`; the whole inbound IMC API is @Deprecated.

### Gotchas

- Two `FMLPreInitializationEvent` handlers (`PreLoad`, `preInit`): dispatch order is reflection order, unverified; nothing currently cross-depends. `load`/`initIMC`/`PostLoad` are static; `PreLoad`/`preInit`/`serverStart`/`handleMissingMappings` are instance methods.
- ForgeChunkManager `LoadingCallback` (`PreLoad` ~L363-377) `return`s after the first NORMAL ticket, so ENTITY tickets listed after it in the same world are never re-`init()`ed on load.
- `TileMappings.put` is private (`TileMappings.java:568`); registration happens only inside `writeMappings()`.
- `HbmPotion.registerPotion` resizes to `new Potion[Math.max(256, id)]`; ids >= 256 throw AIOOBE; reflection failure is swallowed silently (Java 8 only).
- `onPlayerClone` never checks `event.wasDeath`: NBT-only fields (`hasWarped`, `lastDimension`, `maskManTimer`, `nitanCount`, dash) reset on every clone.
- `ExtPropPacket` streams `HbmLivingProps.serialize` then `HbmPlayerProps.serialize`; any order change desyncs everything after it.
- `hbm.cfg` values never reload; only `ServerConfig`/`ClientConfig` JSON do. `/ntmreload` re-runs fluids, serializable recipes, item pools, armor resistances, logic blocks. RBMK tuning is not in `hbm.cfg` at all but in per-world gamerules (`RBMKDials`, listed in area 6).
- `GeneralConfig.enable528` forces `enableLBSM=false`; `enableThermosPreventer` throws from `loadConfig` when Thermos is on the classpath; `enableRenderDistCheck` clamps render distance to 16 unless OptiFine/Angelica.
- Biome ID collisions: intra-NTM duplicates in `hbm.cfg` always crash (`SpaceConfig.createConfigBiome`); cross-mod collisions crash from `BiomeGenBaseCelestial`/`BiomeGenCraterBase` constructors only when `1.92_crashOnBiomeConflict` is true.
- `HbmKeybinds.slamKey`/`EnumKeybind.SLAM` has no `ClientProxy.getIsKeyPressed` case and no handler (dormant).
- `HTTPHandler.loadStats` compares `RefStrings.VERSION` against JameH2's branch on GitHub; a fork with its own version string always sees "new version available".
- `polaroidID` randomised 1..18 (never 4 or 9); NEIConfig hides `book_secret`/`book_of_`/`burnt_bark` unless it is 11 (easter egg).
- `ModEventHandler.worldTick` has a dead reflective `reference` field hack; `chatEvent` `!gv` only for HbMinecraft's UUID in debug mode.

### Known bugs and smells

- `FalloutConfigJSON.java:292`: `matchesMaterial` is read from key `"mustBeOpaque"` (user configs using `matchesMaterial` get null material).
- `handler/Identity.java:35`: writes `value + ""` (-1) instead of `newValue`; nothing reads `Identity.value`.
- `extprop/HbmLivingProps.java:496-498`: `ContaminationEffect.load` reads from parent `nbt` instead of child `me`; loaded effects come back with time/maxTime 0 (`getRad()` yields NaN, no exception).
- `BlockMigrations`: the lazy `buildNumber()` accessor (L14-20, parses `RefStrings.VERSION`) is never called; both `ChunkDataEvent` handlers read the raw field, so chunks are stamped -1 and the migration check never fires; `doMigraion` is an empty stub with a `for(y = height; y >= 0; y++)` loop.
- TODOs: `MainRegistry.java:747` (CommandWikiRender clientside), `HbmPotion.java:234` (use an AT), `ModEventHandlerRenderer.java:673`, `HbmChestContents.java:19`. `MainRegistry.handleMissingMappings` is ~800 lines of hard-coded strings.
- Duplicate numeric key prefixes in `hbm.cfg` (cosmetic): 1.42, 1.43, 1.44, 1.93, 2.18, 8.11, 16.24, 17.10.

### Open questions

- Runtime order of `PreLoad` vs `preInit` (never verified empirically).
- Whether `Identity.value` and `HbmKeybinds.slamKey` are unfinished features or dead.
- What `LoadingScreenRendererNT` does when another mod also replaces `mc.loadingScreen`.

## 2. Public API packages (`api.hbm`, `cofh`) and repo meta

### Purpose

`api.hbm` is the integration surface: interfaces that tiles, blocks, items and entities implement to join the HE power net (`energymk2`), the fluid net (`fluidmk2`; `fluid` is @Deprecated shims), conveyors, crucible metal flow, hand tools (`IToolable`), radar, Redstone-over-Radio (`redstoneoverradio`, "INDEX"), pneumatic item storage (`ntl`), station propulsion (`tile.IPropulsion`) and addon hooks (`recipe.IRecipeRegisterListener`, `fluidmk2.IFluidRegisterListener`). `PowerNetMK2`, `FluidNetMK2`, `Nodespace.PowerNode`, `FluidNode` are thin subclasses of the UNINOS engine (area 7). `cofh` is a vendored CoFH RedstoneFlux API used by the RF<->HE converters and by EMP/nuke drain code (`instanceof cofh.api.energy.IEnergyProvider`). Top-level source dirs are `api`, `cofh`, `com` only.

### Key files

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `src/main/java/api/hbm/energymk2/IEnergyReceiverMK2.java` | Consumer contract (84 implementing files): `transferPower`, `getReceiverSpeed`, `allowDirectProvision`, `trySubscribe(world, x, y, z, dir)`, `tryUnsubscribe` (no-op, uses `createNode()`), `ConnectionPriority` enum (also reused by the fluid API). |
| `api/hbm/energymk2/IEnergyProviderMK2.java` | Generator contract (24 implementing files): `usePower`, `getProviderSpeed`, `tryProvide(...)` registers with a cable net OR pushes directly into any adjacent receiver. |
| `api/hbm/energymk2/IEnergyHandlerMK2.java`, `IEnergyConnectorMK2.java`, `IEnergyConductorMK2.java`, `IEnergyConnectorBlock.java`, `IBatteryItem.java` | Common ancestor (long power), `canConnect(dir)` root (defaults true except UNKNOWN), cable interface (`createNode()` = 1 pos + 6 DirPos, NOT ILoadedTile), render-only block hook, battery item contract (NBT `charge`). |
| `api/hbm/energymk2/Nodespace.java`, `PowerNetMK2.java`, `package-info.java` | @Deprecated husk over UniNodespace (`THE_POWER_PROVIDER`, still used by the API's own `trySubscribe`/`tryProvide` and 6+ classes); priority-weighted net update, `sendPowerDiode`, `timeout = 3000` ms; design rant. |
| `api/hbm/fluidmk2/IFluidUserMK2.java`, `IFluidReceiverMK2.java`, `IFluidProviderMK2.java`, `IFluidStandardReceiverMK2.java`, `IFluidStandardSenderMK2.java`, `IFluidStandardTransceiverMK2.java`, `IFluidPipeMK2.java`, `IFluidConnectorMK2.java`, `IFluidConnectorBlockMK2.java`, `FluidNetMK2.java`, `FluidNode.java`, `IFillableItem.java`, `IFluidRegisterListener.java` | Fluid net contracts (`HIGHEST_VALID_PRESSURE = 5`); tank-backed defaults driven by `getReceivingTanks()`/`getSendingTanks()`; per-FluidType nets via `FluidType.getNetworkProvider()` (`FluidType.java:291`). |
| `api/hbm/fluid/IFluidStandardReceiver.java`, `IFluidStandardSender.java`, `IFluidStandardTransceiver.java`, `IFluidConnector.java`, `IFluidConnectorBlock.java` | @Deprecated shims extending MK2 with `subscribeToAllAround`/`sendFluidToAll`/`tryUnsubscribe` helpers (~38 transceiver implementers). |
| `api/hbm/tile/ILoadedTile.java` | `isLoaded()` used by `NodeNet.isBadLink`; nested static `TileAccessCache.getTileOrCache` (null cached 20 ticks, tile 60 ticks, invalid/unloaded entries self-expire; never cleared; shared mutable key `publicCumRag`, server-thread only). |
| `api/hbm/tile/IHeatSource.java`, `IInfoProviderEC.java`, `IPropulsion.java` | TU heat, Energy Control info keys, station engines (`OrbitalStation.addPropulsion` registers on the station instance found from the tile's x/z). |
| `api/hbm/block/IToolable.java` | `onScrew(...)` + `ToolType` enum (`SCREWDRIVER, HAND_DRILL, DEFUSER, WRENCH, TORCH, BOLT`); `register()`/`getType()` lazy map (registrations after the first `getType` are ignored). |
| `api/hbm/block/ICrucibleAcceptor.java`, `IFuckingExplode.java`, `ILaserable.java`, `IBlowable.java`, `IInsertable.java`, `IPileNeutronReceiver.java` (@Deprecated) | Block hooks. Dead: `IRadioControllable`, `IDrillInteraction`, `IMiningDrill` (only the last two are @Deprecated). |
| `api/hbm/conveyor/*`, `api/hbm/item/*`, `api/hbm/entity/*`, `api/hbm/ntl/*`, `api/hbm/recipe/*`, `api/hbm/redstoneoverradio/*` | Conveyor belt/item/package/enterable; gas mask/designator/depth tool (`IGunHUDProvider` dead); `IRadarDetectableNT` (+ deprecated `IRadarDetectable`, `RadarEntry`); pneumatic storage (`ISlotMonitorProvider`, `SlotMonitor`, `StackCache`); addon recipe hook + guide; ROR (`IRORInfo` `VAL:`/`FUN:` prefixes, final interface constants; `IRORValueProvider` 42 impl, `IRORInteractive` 27 impl). |
| `src/main/java/cofh/api/energy/*`, `cofh/api/CoFHAPIProps.java`, `cofh/api/package-info.java` | 12 files: `energy/` holds `IEnergyHandler`, `IEnergyProvider`, `IEnergyReceiver`, `IEnergyConnection`, `IEnergyContainerItem`, `IEnergyStorage`, `EnergyStorage`, `TileEnergyHandler`, `ItemEnergyContainer` and a `package-info` declaring `@API(apiVersion = CoFHAPIProps.VERSION, owner = "CoFHAPI", provides = "CoFHAPI|energy")`; the top-level `cofh/api/package-info.java` declares `owner = "CoFHLib", provides = "CoFHAPI"`; `CoFHAPIProps.VERSION = "1.7.10R1.0.2"`. |
| `.github/workflows/build.yml`, `.editorconfig`, `.gitignore`, `.gitattributes` (fork-added: `tools/*.sh text eol=lf`) | CI on `space-travel-twopointfive` only; tabs + CRLF (mixed reality); ignores `/eclipse` (ForgeGradle runDir), `/build`, `/run`, `curseforge.properties`, `maven.properties`, `changelog.bak`. |

### Patterns

- Hierarchy: receiver/provider -> `IEnergyHandlerMK2` -> (`IEnergyConnectorMK2`, `ILoadedTile`); conductors only `IEnergyConductorMK2`. Fluids mirror it with `IFluidUserMK2` and `IFluidPipeMK2`.
- Subscription by heartbeat: receivers call `trySubscribe` toward each connection point, providers `tryProvide`; both resolve the neighbour via `TileAccessCache`, check the conductor's `canConnect(dir.getOpposite())`, and stamp `System.currentTimeMillis()` into `NodeNet.receiverEntries`/`providerEntries`. Power looks up `Nodespace.getNode`, fluid `UniNodespace.getNode(world, x, y, z, type.getNetworkProvider())`. Entries older than 3000 ms or failing `isBadLink` are dropped. Convention: every tick or `worldObj.getTotalWorldTime() % 20 == 0`.
- Direct provision: `tryProvide` also pushes into ANY adjacent `IEnergyReceiverMK2` (conductor or not) when `canConnect` and `allowDirectProvision()` pass; the fluid side has no `allowDirectProvision` gate, only `canConnect(type, dir)`. A tile that is both conductor and receiver must override `allowDirectProvision()` to false (`TileEntityBatteryBase` does).
- Node lifecycle (cables/ducts): in `updateEntity` (server) `if(node == null || node.expired)` -> `getNode` else `createNode()` + `UniNodespace.createNode`; `invalidate()` -> `destroyNode`. `TileEntityCableBaseNT.shouldCreateNode()` gates creation. Machine-as-link: only `TileEntityBatteryBase` (implements `IEnergyConductorMK2` + provider + receiver, manages membership directly with `node.net.addProvider/addReceiver/remove*` by mode, forces priority into LOW..HIGH). Fluid tanks/barrels are ordinary transceivers, not links.
- Distribution: `PowerNetMK2.update` sums supply/demand per `ConnectionPriority`, iterates HIGHEST->LOWEST with weighted transfer, random "scapegoat" rounding loop; returns early unless BOTH provider and receiver maps are non-empty (so the purge does not run on one-sided nets). `sendPowerDiode` skips `isBadLink` and demand clamping. `FluidNetMK2` does the same per pressure 0..5 x priority.
- ROR: `getFunctionInfo()` returns `PREFIX_VALUE + name` / `PREFIX_FUNCTION + name + NAME_SEPARATOR + param`; consumers lowercase names (`TileEntityRadioTorchReader.java:49`, `IRORInteractive.getCommand`), so compare lowercase in `provideRORValue`/`runRORFunction`; `TileEntityProxyCombo` forwards ROR and OC to the core.
- Addon hooks: `CompatExternal.registerRecipeRegisterListener` (fires only in `SerializableRecipe.initialize`'s defaults branch, NOT when a user JSON exists) and `registerFluidRegisterListener` (fires in `Fluids.init` and `reloadFluids`). `CompatExternal` also exposes `getCoreFromPos`, `getBufferedPowerFromTile`, turret target lists, warhead hooks.
- CI versioning: `build.yml` seds `RefStrings.VERSION` to `1.0.27 BETA (<days>)` and `gradle.properties` `mod_build_number`; `build.gradle` forms `1.0.27_X<n>_H261`.

### How-to

- HE consumer: extend `TileEntityMachineBase`/`TileEntityLoadedBase`, `implements IEnergyReceiverMK2`, `long power`, `getPower/setPower/getMaxPower`, `DirPos[] getConPos()`, server-side `trySubscribe(worldObj, pos.getX(), pos.getY(), pos.getZ(), pos.getDir())` every <= 20 ticks, persist `power` in NBT + ByteBuf. Exemplar `tileentity/machine/TileEntityMachinePumpElectric.java`.
- HE provider: `implements IEnergyProviderMK2`, `tryProvide(worldObj, nx, ny, nz, dir)` per side; do not call `usePower` yourself for net transfers. Exemplar `tileentity/network/TileEntityConverterRfHe.java`.
- Fluid machine (MK2): `implements IFluidStandardTransceiverMK2`, `FluidTank` fields, `getReceivingTanks/getSendingTanks/getAllTanks`, `trySubscribe(tank.getTankType(), worldObj, x, y, z, dir)` inputs, `tryProvide(tank, worldObj, x, y, z, dir)` outputs, `tank.writeToNBT(nbt, key)`/`serialize(buf)`. Exemplar `tileentity/machine/TileEntitySolarBoiler.java`. Deprecated shim path (`subscribeToAllAround`/`sendFluidToAll`): `tileentity/machine/TileEntityDeuteriumExtractor.java`.
- Cable: extend `TileEntityCableBaseNT`; override `createNode()` for multi-block geometry (`new PowerNode(BlockPos...).setConnections(DirPos...)`, DirPos = neighbour position + direction toward it); `Nodespace.destroyNode` in `invalidate()`. Exemplar `tileentity/network/TileEntitySubstation.java`.
- Duct: extend `TileEntityPipeBaseNT`; call `setType(FluidType)` (destroys the old-type node) never mutate `type` directly. Exemplar `tileentity/network/TileEntityFluidValve.java`.
- New network kind: `MyNetwork extends NodeNet<R, P, GenNode>` with `update()` (runs every tick for every live net; empty-update nets must purge stale members themselves), `MyNetworkProvider implements INetworkProvider<MyNetwork>` with `THE_PROVIDER` returning a fresh net each call, `new GenNode<>(provider, BlockPos).setStandardConnections(x, y, z)` + `UniNodespace.createNode`; destroy with the `(world, x, y, z, provider)` overload (the `(World, GenNode)` overload NPEs when the world entry is missing). Exemplar `uninos/networkproviders/RebarNetworkProvider.java`.
- Battery item: `implements IBatteryItem` with NBT `charge` (missing tag = full). Exemplar `items/machine/ItemBattery.java`.
- Tool interaction: block `implements IToolable`; tool items call `ToolType.X.register(new ItemStack(this))` in the constructor. Exemplar `blocks/machine/MachineAutosaw.java`.
- Pneumatic storage: extend `TileEntityPneumaticStorageBase` (already implements `IPneumaticConnector`, `IFluidStandardReceiverMK2`, `ISlotMonitorProvider`, allocates monitors, calls `availabilityHasChanged`/`updateMonitors`); override only `getAmountAt`/`allowTypeSetting` etc. Exemplar `tileentity/network/pneumatic/TileEntityPneumoStorageMono.java`.
- Propulsion: `implements IPropulsion`, `registerPropulsion()` when facing prograde, `unregisterPropulsion()` in `invalidate`/`onChunkUnload`; `getTileEntity()` must return a tile with valid coords. Note `TileEntityXenonThruster` sets `hasRegistered = true` even when not prograde and returns early unless `CelestialBody.inOrbit`.
- Radar: `implements IRadarDetectableNT` (TIER constants, `canBeSeenBy`, `paramsApplicable`). Exemplar `entity/missile/EntityMissileBaseNT.java`.
- RF bridge: `implements IEnergyProviderMK2, cofh.api.energy.IEnergyHandler` with `EnergyStorage storage` (NBT `Energy`). Exemplar `tileentity/network/TileEntityConverterRfHe.java`.

### Gotchas

- Implementing receiver/provider/`IFluidUserMK2` forces `isLoaded()`; extend `TileEntityLoadedBase` or nets never evict you.
- `UniNodeWorld.popNode` calls `node.net.destroy()`: breaking one cable, `setType`, pylon disconnects and `TileEntityCableSwitch` tear down the whole net; it re-forms next tick and machines re-subscribe within 20 ticks.
- `UniNodespace.worlds` is keyed by World object and never cleared on unload (only `/ntmreapnetworks`); integrated-server world switches leak nodes. Nodes are not persisted; `GenNode.net` is null the first tick.
- `TileEntityPylonBase.addConnection` dereferences `Nodespace.getNode` without a null check (`TileEntityPipelineBase` guards it).
- `TileEntityBatteryBase` creates its node at `getPortPos()` but looks up/destroys at its own xyz; `TileEntityBatteryREDD` ports exclude the core position, so REDD recreates duplicate nodes on every tile recreation and never destroys them (ghost links until `/ntmreapnetworks`).
- `FluidNetMK2` arrays are sized `HIGHEST_VALID_PRESSURE + 1 = 6` x priorities; pressure > 5 indexes out of bounds.
- `particleDebug` constants in `IEnergyHandlerMK2`/`IFluidUserMK2` spam `AuxParticlePacketNT` if flipped.
- `ToolType.getType` builds its map once; later `register` calls are ignored.
- Line endings: `api/` is entirely LF, `cofh/` entirely CRLF.
- CI runs only on `space-travel-twopointfive`; the `1.0.27` literal in `build.yml`'s sed is separate from `gradle.properties`.

### Smells

- `PowerNetMK2.update` (L75-86) and `sendPowerDiode` subtract cumulative `energyUsed` each priority tier; `FluidNetMK2.transferFluid` (L108) has the same shape (upstream behaviour, unverified intent).
- `FluidNetMK2.transfered[]` dead; `currentTime` shared static; `IBatteryItem.emptyBattery` copies twice; redundant `getReceiverSpeed` overrides; typos in API docs.
- `gradle.properties` credits string has mojibake (`V�r`), a doubled paren, and missing commas after two names.

## 3. Blocks: registration and generic blocks

### Purpose

`com/hbm/blocks/ModBlocks.java` (4092 lines) is the flat registry: ~1062 `public static Block` fields plus 11 `public static Fluid` fields (L54-1410), `initializeBlock()` (L1412-2736) instantiating with fluent setters, `registerBlock()` (L2738-4042) calling `GameRegistry.registerBlock`. It runs from `MainRegistry.PreLoad` after `Fluids.init()` and before `ModItems`. The top-level package holds base classes (`BlockBase`, `BlockMulti`/`BlockEnumMulti`, `BlockDummyable`, `BlockRemap`), marker interfaces (`ITooltipProvider`, `ILookOverlay`, `IPersistentInfoProvider`, `IBlockMulti`, `IBlockMultiPass`, `IBlockSideRotation`, `ICustomBlockHighlight`, `IStepTickReceiver`, `IRadResistantBlock`, `IProxyController`) and ~12 leaf blocks (BlockCoral, BlockCrop, BlockKelp, BlockVolcanoV2, ...). `generic/` has ~159 non-machine blocks, `fluid/` Forge fluids, `gas/` self-propagating gases, `rail/` NTM rails, `turret/` turret blocks, `test/` dev blocks.

### Key files

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `com/hbm/blocks/BlockBase.java` | `setBlockName()` also sets texture to `hbm:<name>`; `setBeaconable()`/`noMobSpawn()` are unused repo-wide. |
| `com/hbm/blocks/BlockContainerBase.java` | BlockBase + ITileEntityProvider; users: `bomb/BlockChargeBase`, `machine/PistonInserter`. |
| `com/hbm/blocks/IBlockMulti.java`, `BlockMulti.java`, `BlockEnumMulti.java`, `BlockEnums.java` | Meta-subtype contract (`rectify` = `abs(meta % count)`), enum-driven blocks (`icons '<tex>.<enum_lower>'`, lang `tile.<name>.<enum_lower>`), shared enums. |
| `com/hbm/blocks/BlockDummyable.java` | Multiblock base (948 lines); see area 4. |
| `com/hbm/blocks/BlockRemap.java` + `items/block/ItemBlockRemap.java` | Rename compat (random tick + inventory conversion); `ModBlocks.addRemap` is the only public entry and has zero callers. |
| `com/hbm/blocks/ITooltipProvider.java`, `IPersistentInfoProvider.java`, `ILookOverlay.java` | Tooltip (`addStandardInfo` shows `tile.<name>.desc` on LSHIFT), persistent-NBT tooltip, crosshair HUD overlay (`printGeneric`). |
| `com/hbm/blocks/ModSoundType.java`, `ModSoundTypes.java`, `BlockFallingNT.java`, `MaterialGas.java` | Custom sound types (`ModSoundTypes.grate/pipe/mork/flesh/platemetal`) built from static factories: `ModSoundType.mod("hbm:x", volume, pitch)` (dig/step derived from the name), `customStep/customBreak/customDig/customPlace(<name or vanilla Block.SoundType>, "hbm:step.x"|"hbm:block.x", volume, pitch)`, `placeBreakStep(place, break, step, volume, pitch)`, optionally `.enveloped(rand).pitchFunction(...)`; the ids must exist in `sounds.json` (`step.*`, `block.*`). Falling block via `EntityFallingBlockNT`, gas material. |
| `com/hbm/blocks/generic/BlockOre.java` | `IBlockMultiPass` (pass 0 planet stone, pass 1 overlay), `IBlockMulti` (meta = `SolarSystem.Body` ordinal), drop tables by identity, `addValidBody/addAllBodies/addAllExcept`. `damageDropped`: `ore_rare` -> chunk enum ordinal, `ore_lapis` -> 4, else 0 or `rectify(meta)`. |
| `generic/BlockOreOutgas.java`, `BlockOutgas.java`, `BlockCluster.java`, `BlockOreFluid.java`, `BlockBedrockOreTE.java` | Gas-venting ores (4- and 5-arg ctors; identity tables in `getGas()`), crystal drops, oil/gas/brine reserves, bedrock ore TE. |
| `generic/BlockHazard.java` | Radiation from `HazardSystem.getHazardLevelFromStack` in `onBlockAdded` via scheduled ticks (`tickRate` 20, not random ticks); `makeBeaconable()`, `setDisplayEffect()` must be chained BEFORE `setBlockName` (they return `BlockHazard`). Default material iron. |
| `generic/BlockEnumMultiCT.java`, `BlockNTMGlassCT.java` | Connected textures (`IBlockCT`, `CT.renderID`, `<tex>_ct` fragments). |

Only mud/acid/toxic/corium use dedicated `MaterialLiquid` constants; schrabidic uses `Material.water`, lava blocks `Material.lava`. `GenericFluidBlock.onEntityCollidedWithBlock` only damages for `sulfuric_acid_block`. |
| `blocks/gas/BlockGasBase.java`, `BlockGasRadon.java`, `BlockGasFlammable.java` | Invisible (`renderType -1`) replaceable gases; `updateTick` -> `tryMove(getFirstDirection)`/`getSecondDirection`, sets `world.scheduledUpdatesAreImmediate = false`. |
| `blocks/rail/IRailNTM.java`, `IRenderBlock.java` (@Deprecated but load-bearing), `RailStandardStraight.java`, `BlockRailWaypointSystem.java` | Train rail contract (`TrackGauge`, `RailContext`), rail ISBRH id, `RailDef.nodes`-based curves. |

| `items/block/ItemBlockBase.java`, `ItemBlockLore.java` | Default ItemBlock wiring `IBlockMulti`, `ITooltipProvider`, `IPersistentInfoProvider` (tag `persistent`); item icon = `block.getIcon(1, meta)` (top face). `ItemBlockLore` extends `ItemBlockBase` and adds `tile.<name>.desc`. Vanilla-derived (no dispatch): `ItemOreBlock`, `ItemBlockMeta`, `ItemBlockNamedMeta`, `ItemCustomMachine`. |
| `inventory/OreDictManager.java` | `DictFrame` fluent ore-dict + hazard registration: `.block()`, `.ore()`, `.oreAll()` (wildcard meta), `.oreNether()`, `.rad()`. |
| `main/ClientProxy.java` L835-905 | `registerBlockRenderer()`: `RenderISBRHUniversal` first, then ~60 legacy per-block handlers under `/// STOP DOING THIS ///`. |
| `render/block/ISBRHUniversal.java`, `RenderBlockMultipass.java` | Modern ISBRH contract (block implements `renderInventoryBlock`/`renderWorldBlock`, returns `ISBRHUniversal.renderID`); multipass handler (`currentPass` static). |

### Patterns

- Declaration/registration split: `x = new X(Material.rock).setBlockName("x").setCreativeTab(MainRegistry.blockTab).setHardness(f).setResistance(f).setBlockTextureName(RefStrings.MODID + ":x");` then `register(x)` / `GameRegistry.registerBlock(x, x.getUnlocalizedName())`. Registry name `hbm:tile.<name>`.
- Registration forms (counts): 2-arg `GameRegistry.registerBlock` (~540, vanilla ItemBlock), `registerBlock(b, ItemBlockBase.class, ...)` (~122) or `register(b)` (~379), `register(b, Class)` (~10), explicit classes `ItemBlockBlastInfo` (38), `ItemBlockLore` (11), `ItemModSlab` (8), `ItemBlockStorageCrate` (6), `ItemOreBlock`, `ItemBlockMeta`, `ItemBlockNamedMeta`, `ItemBlockColoredConcrete`, `ItemTrapBlock`, `ItemPrototypeBlock`, `ItemGlyphBlock`, `ItemCustomMachine`.
- Bases that do NOT extend `BlockBase` (explicit `setBlockTextureName` mandatory): `BlockOre`, `BlockHazard`, `BlockGasBase`, `BlockDummyable`, `BlockTint`, `BlockNoSpawn`, `BlockFallingNT`, `BlockDepth`, `BlockSpeedy`, `BlockMultiSlab`, `BlockGenericStairs`, `GenericFluidBlock`.
- Identity-driven behaviour: `BlockOre`, `BlockCluster`, `BlockDepthOre`, `BlockStepEffect`, `BlockOreOutgas`, `BlockOutgas`, `DecoBlock`, `MeltedFlesh` branch on `this == ModBlocks.x`; a new instance gets default behaviour until a branch is added.
- Hazard blocks: radiation comes from the ore dictionary (`DictFrame.rad(x)...block(block)` -> `HazardSystem` with `HazardRegistry.block = 10F`); without an entry the block is inert.
- Forge fluids: `x_fluid = new GenericFluid("x_fluid").setDensity(..); FluidRegistry.registerFluid(x_fluid); x_block = new GenericFluidBlock(x_fluid, Material.water, "x_still", "x_flowing").setDamage(...)...` (this is the Forge system; NTM machine fluids are `inventory/fluid/Fluids` FluidTypes).
- Render ids: `public static int renderID = RenderingRegistry.getNextAvailableRenderId();` on the block or a shared interface, `getRenderType()` returns it, matching handler registered in `ClientProxy.registerBlockRenderer`. Modern path: implement `ISBRHUniversal`, no registration needed. `-1` = TESR-only/invisible.
- Look overlays: `ILookOverlay.printHook` dispatched from `ModEventHandlerClient` (~L226) gated on `ClientConfig.DODD_RBMK_DIAGNOSTIC` (default true).
- Conditional blocks: guard both at init (`Loader.isModLoaded("OpenComputers")`) and at registration (`Compat.MOD_OC`).
- Creative tabs: `blockTab`, `machineTab`, `nukeTab`, `missileTab`, `weaponTab`, `partsTab`, `controlTab`, `templateTab`, `consumableTab`; `null` hides.
- Naming families: pick the base by the closest existing family and name the class after it: `BlockBase` (plain; `setBlockName` also sets the texture), `BlockGeneric`, `BlockEnumMulti`/`BlockMulti` (meta subtypes), `BlockContainerBase`/`BlockMachineBase` (single-block machine with TE), `BlockDummyable` (multiblock; classes are `Machine*`), `BlockHazard`, `BlockOre*`, `BlockGasBase`, `BlockFallingNT`, `BlockMultiSlab`/`BlockGenericStairs`, `DecoBlock*`. Field name = unlocalized name = registry name (`hbm:tile.<name>`) = texture (`hbm:<name>`), and the class family mirrors it (`machine_x` -> `MachineX`, `TileEntityMachineX`, `ContainerMachineX`, `GUIMachineX`, `RenderX`).

### How-to

- Plain block: field; init chain copied from `gneiss_brick` (~L1487) using `BlockGeneric`; `register(x)`; `textures/blocks/x.png`; `tile.x.name`; ore dict via `DictFrame.block(x)`. Exemplar `generic/BlockGeneric.java`.
- Enum subtypes: enum in `BlockEnums.java`; `new BlockEnumMulti(Material.rock, MyEnum.class, true, true)` (copy `vinyl_tile` ~L1774); register with an `ItemBlockBase`-derived class; textures `x.<constant_lower>.png`; lang `tile.x.<constant_lower>.name`. CT variant `BlockEnumMultiCT` + `_ct.png`. Exemplar `generic/BlockMeteorOre.java`.
- Ore: `new BlockOre(Material.rock)` (copy `ore_titanium` ~L1429) or `BlockOreOutgas`; drop branch in `BlockOre.getItemDropped`; register with `ItemBlockBase.class`; texture is the overlay only; `.oreAll(ore_x)` in `OreDictManager`; `BlockOre.addValidBody(ModBlocks.ore_x, Body.X)` in the body's `WorldGenerator*`.
- Radioactive block: `new BlockHazard().makeBeaconable().setDisplayEffect(ExtDisplayEffect.RADFOG).setBlockName(...)...` (copy `block_uranium` ~L1551 / `block_schrabidium` ~L1597); `.block(x)` on a `DictFrame` with `.rad()`.
- Forge fluid: fields ~L1303-1330, init ~L2618-2667 (copy sulfuric acid ~L2646), register ~L3959, textures `x_still.png`/`x_flowing.png`.
- Gas: subclass `BlockGasBase` (ctor `super(r, g, b)`, `getFirstDirection`, `onEntityCollidedWithBlock`, `updateTick` decay); init copy `gas_radon` ~L2596; spawn via `getGas()` branches or `world.setBlock`. Exemplar `gas/BlockGasRadon.java`.
- Custom ISBRH: implement `ISBRHUniversal`, `getRenderType() { return ISBRHUniversal.renderID; }`, `isOpaqueCube`/`renderAsNormalBlock` false, implement both render methods (must implement `renderInventoryBlock`; `RenderISBRHUniversal.shouldRender3DInInventory` is always true and casts unconditionally). Exemplar `generic/BlockSandbags.java`, `generic/BlockRebar.java` (uses `RenderBlocksNT.INSTANCE.setWorld(world)`).
- Tooltip/overlay: `ITooltipProvider.addStandardInfo` (needs `ItemBlockBase`), `ItemBlockLore.class` for code-free `.desc`, `ILookOverlay.printGeneric`. Exemplar `generic/BlockDepth.java`.
- Slabs/stairs: `new BlockMultiSlab(null, mat, blocks...)` + double variant (copy `concrete_slab` ~L1744); add the pair to `ItemModSlab.shittyFuckingHackSingle/Double`; register with `ItemModSlab.class`; `new BlockGenericStairs(block, 0)`.
- Rename/remove: never change `setBlockName` in place; `addRemap("old", newBlock, meta)` (unexercised path, verify in-game) or `ignoreMappings.add("hbm:tile.old")` in `handleMissingMappings`; or keep the field `@Deprecated` (55 such fields).

### Gotchas

- `IBlockMulti`, `ITooltipProvider`, `IPersistentInfoProvider` only work through `ItemBlockBase` (sole `instanceof ITooltipProvider` site); ~540 blocks use the vanilla ItemBlock.
- `BlockEnumMulti.getIcon` wraps with `meta % icons.length`; `rectify`/`grabEnumSafely` wrap negatives too.
- `BlockMultiSlab`/`BlockGenericStairs` force `setBlockTextureName(hbm:concrete)`; icons come from the source blocks.
- `GenericFiniteFluid` has static `stillIcon`/`flowingIcon` shared by `concrete_liquid` and `corium_block` (whichever registers last wins). `CoriumBlock` is never instantiated but `CoriumFluid.getStillIcon()` returns its static icons (null).
- `ItemModSlab` with a missing pair creates an `ItemSlab` with null slab references (NPE on naming/placement).
- `BlockGasBase.updateTick` flips a world-global flag. Gas spawn sites also include ZirnoxDestroyed, RBMKDebrisBurning/Radiating, BlockGasMeltdown, YellowBarrel, BlockOreBasalt.
- `ModBlocks.getDropsWithoutDamage()` exists because `damageDropped`-based meta breaks creative middle-click.
- `BlockRemap` ctor is protected, uses `Material.tnt` and random ticks (unloaded chunks never convert).

### Smells

- `ModBlocks.java:1853` `//TODO: dear god` over 24 @Deprecated `deco_pipe_*`; `:445` ike_stone comment; ~L3117 vinyl_tile comment; `generic/BlockCrate.java:26` @Spaghetti + TODO loot pools; `BlockNTMGlassPane.java:22` auto-generated stub; `BlockStepEffect` identity grab-bag; `CoriumFinite.updateTick` try/catch(ClassCastException) CoFH band-aid; `WarController.java` (a `BlockMachineBase`) lives in the top-level package.

### Open questions

- `MultiblockHandlerXR.rotate` frame is answered in area 4; whether `RenderingRegistry.getNextAvailableRenderId()` in block static initializers is safe on a dedicated server was not tested (codebase relies on it everywhere).

## 4. Blocks: machines, bombs, networks (BlockDummyable)

### Purpose

`blocks/machine/` (307 files incl. albion/fusion/pile/rbmk), `blocks/bomb/` (50) and `blocks/network/` (71 incl. pneumatic). Blocks are thin: multiblock footprint and rotation (`BlockDummyable`), TE creation by metadata, right-click forwarding to the GUI system (`FMLNetworkHandler.openGui` -> `GUIHandler` -> `IGUIProvider` on the TE), break/drop/NBT persistence. ~156 machine classes are `BlockDummyable` (147 direct + 9 via `RBMKBase`, `BlockPWR`, `BlockICF`, `MachineCraneBase`, ...), 4 bombs, 9 network blocks.

### Key files

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `com/hbm/blocks/BlockDummyable.java` | Metadata scheme (`offset = 10`, `extra = 6`): 0-5 plain dummy (ForgeDirection from the core toward the dummy along the fill chain, y->x->z), 6-11 "extra" port dummy (gets a proxy TE), 12-15 core (`dir.ordinal() + 10`, horizontal only). `onBlockPlacedBy` placement, `findCore`/`findCoreRec`, `checkRequirement`/`fillSpace`, `makeExtra`/`removeExtra`, `breakBlock` cascade + inventory spill, `standardOpenBehavior(id)` (protected; returns true when sneaking), `bounding` hitboxes, `drawPlacementHighlight`, `getRenderType() = -1`, `isOpaqueCube`/`renderAsNormalBlock` false. Static globals `safeRem`, `overrideTileMeta`; instance scratch state `positions`, `internalPlayers`. |
| `com/hbm/handler/MultiblockHandlerXR.java` | `checkSpace`/`fillSpace`/`rotate(dim, dir)`: dims treated as `{+Y, -Y, -Z, +Z, -X, +X}` (U, D, N, S, W, E) in the SOUTH-facing frame (identity for SOUTH; NORTH swaps N/S and W/E; EAST/WEST map Z<->X). `ox/oy/oz` parameters are unused. 2000-block cap with `System.out.println("checkspace: ded")`. |
| `com/hbm/blocks/BlockDummyableBeam.java` | Pass-through dummy forwarding to the adjacent real BlockDummyable (`dummy_beam`); its `findCore(World, ...)` is an overload, not an override. |
| `com/hbm/tileentity/TileEntityProxyBase.java`, `TileEntityProxyCombo.java`, `TileEntityProxyDyn.java` | Port proxies: `getTE()` (`cachedPosition` -> `findCore` -> `IProxyController.getCore`); Combo delegates energy/fluid/inventory/heat/crucible/OC/ROR by builder flags `inventory()/power()/fluid()/conductor()/heatSource()/moltenMetal()`; Dyn asks the core for a per-port delegate. |
| `blocks/machine/BlockMachineBase.java`, `DummyOldBase.java`, `DummyBlockMachine.java`, `DummyBlockBlast.java`, `interfaces/IMultiblock.java`, `tileentity/machine/TileEntityDummy.java` | Legacy single-block base (`guiID`, -1 = none; `breakBlock` returns early without `super` when the TE is not ISidedInventory) and the mk1 dummy system (only BlastDoor, MachineGasCent, MachineSatDock, LaunchTable, CompactLauncher remain; do not use). |
| `com/hbm/handler/GUIHandler.java`, `tileentity/IGUIProvider.java` | Resolves the provider from TE at (x,y,z), then Block, then held Item, then Entity with id == x; passes the ID through unchanged. |
| `tileentity/IPersistentNBT.java`, `blocks/IPersistentInfoProvider.java` | `writeNBT/readNBT`; static `getDrops(world, x, y, z, block)` (returns an EMPTY list when the core is not IPersistentNBT or gone) and `restoreData(world, x, y, z, stack)` (called by `BlockDummyable.onBlockPlacedBy`). |
| `api/hbm/block/IToolable.java`, `tileentity/IRepairable.java`, `interfaces/ICopiable.java` | Tool interactions (`onScrew`), damaged-multiblock repair helpers, settings copy tool (BlockDummyable forwards to the core). |
| `blocks/machine/MachineChemicalPlant.java` | Canonical minimal BlockDummyable machine (45 lines): dims `{2,0,1,1,1,1}`, offset 1, `fillSpace` marks the ring as extra. |
| `blocks/machine/MachineCoker.java`, `MachineChungus.java`, `MachineCentrifuge.java`, `MachineFluidTank.java`, `MachineBattery.java`, `MachinePress.java`, `MachineAssemblyFactory.java`, `BlockCustomMachine.java`, `rbmk/RBMKBase.java`, `pile/BlockPile.java` | XL multiblock (calls super), fully custom check/fill (dims `{4,0,10,3,2,2}`), detailed hitboxes (`maxY = 0.999D`), IPersistentNBT drops + ILookOverlay + torch repair, single-block BlockContainer with persistent NBT (whole MachineBattery family is @Deprecated), legacy monoblock promotion, ProxyDyn user, JSON custom machine (meta >= 100), RBMK column base (lid in metadata), pile role metadata. |
| `blocks/bomb/BlockDetonatable.java`, `BlockTNTBase.java`, `BlockChargeBase.java`, `DetCord.java`, `NukeGadget.java`, `LaunchPad.java`, `interfaces/IBomb.java`, `api/hbm/block/IFuckingExplode.java` | Explosive blocks: `IBomb.explode -> BombReturnCode`; chained explosions go through `EntityTNTPrimedBase` (`IFuckingExplode.explodeEntity`) to avoid stack overflow; redstone in `onNeighborBlockChange`. |
| `blocks/network/BlockCable.java`, `BlockCablePaintable.java`, `FluidDuctBase.java`, `FluidDuctStandard.java`, `BlockConveyorBase.java`, `BlockConveyorBendable.java`, `BlockCraneBase.java`, `CraneInserter.java`, `pneumatic/PneumoTube.java`, `PylonBase.java`, `PylonLarge.java`, `RadioTorchBase.java`, `MachineBatterySocket.java` | Network blocks: connection bounds from `Library.canConnect`/`canConnectFluid`/`IPneumaticConnector`; conveyors have NO TE (meta = direction, 6-9 left bend, 10-13 right); cranes have TEs; `PylonLarge.getMetaForCore` is a 4-way mapping with 45-degree shifted sectors; `RadioTorchBase` implements `IGUIProvider` at the Block level with null container. |

### Patterns

- `createNewTileEntity(world, meta)`: `if(meta >= 12) return new TileEntityMachineX(); if(meta >= 6) return new TileEntityProxyCombo().inventory().power().fluid(); return null;`. Set `BlockDummyable.overrideTileMeta` via `setOverride()`/`resetOverride()` to pass info into it.
- Placement: `onBlockPlacedBy` derives facing from yaw, `dir = getDirModified(facing)`, `o = -getOffset()`, core at `(x + facing.offsetX * o, y + getHeightOffset(), z + facing.offsetZ * o)`; `checkRequirement` refunds and aborts; `IPersistentNBT.restoreData`; `fillSpace`. Hooks: `getDirModified` (8 users), `getHeightOffset` (16), `getMetaForCore` (PylonLarge, must return 12-15), `isLegacyMonoblock`.
- XL multiblocks override `checkRequirement`/`fillSpace` with extra `MultiblockHandlerXR` calls and `makeExtra` on ports; `getAllDimensions()` (rows of 6, or 9 with fwd/up/lat offsets) and `getAABBExtras()` drive ONLY the client placement wireframe, which rotates with `facing` while the real footprint uses `getDirModified(facing)`; keep them in sync by hand.
- Break/drops: breaking a dummy cascades toward the core; breaking the core alone does not cascade (dummies self-delete via `destroyIfOrphan` one update later); `breakBlock` spills any `ISidedInventory` at the broken position; drops are produced in `onBlockHarvested` (`harvestBlock` only adds stats); creative drops nothing.
- Persistent NBT: TE `writeNBT` must build a child compound and `nbt.setTag(IPersistentNBT.NBT_PERSISTENT_KEY, data)`; `readNBT` reads `nbt.getCompoundTag(NBT_PERSISTENT_KEY)`; block overrides `getDrops(...) { return IPersistentNBT.getDrops(world, x, y, z, this); }` and implements `IPersistentInfoProvider`; non-Dummyable blocks call `restoreData` in `onBlockPlacedBy` and override `onBlockHarvested`/`harvestBlock` as `MachineBattery` does.
- GUI: `standardOpenBehavior` finds the core and opens at core coordinates (a proxy TE is not an IGUIProvider). IDs are pass-through; 0 by convention; 14 blocks pass the clicked `side` (works only because those TEs ignore it).
- Registration: fluent chain in `ModBlocks.initializeBlock()` ending in `setBlockTextureName`; `register(x)` for ItemBlockBase; nested `public static class TileEntityX` inside the Block file is accepted (MachineCapacitor, Floodlight, BlockPWR, FluidPump, CableDiode, BlockCablePaintable) but still needs a `TileMappings` entry.
- Rendering: BlockDummyable is invisible; TESR bound in `ClientProxy` with `IItemRendererProvider`; each TESR's rotation switch is tuned to its model (RenderChemicalPlant 0 deg at meta 12, RenderSawmill at 13).
- `IBomb.explode(world, x, y, z)` returns `BombReturnCode`: `DETONATED`, `TRIGGERED`, `LAUNCHED` (success; `wasSuccessful()`), `ERROR_MISSING_COMPONENT`, `ERROR_INCOMPATIBLE` (target implements `IBomb` but refuses, e.g. a locked blast door), `ERROR_NO_BOMB` (used by the caller when the block is not an `IBomb`), `UNDEFINED` (no feedback); `ItemDetonator` reports `getUnlocalizedMessage()` (`bomb.*` lang keys) through `ChatBuilder`. Det cord: blocks implement `IDetConnectible.canConnectToDetCord(world, x, y, z, dir)` (default true); `IDetConnectible.isConnectible(...)` is the static probe. Fluid ducts: right-clicking `FluidDuctBase` with an `IItemFluidIdentifier` (`ItemFluidIDMulti` etc.) calls `id.getType(world, x, y, z, stack)` and re-types the `TileEntityPipeBaseNT` via `setType`.

### How-to

- Rectangular multiblock: block `extends BlockDummyable`; `createNewTileEntity` as above; `getDimensions()` in the SOUTH frame; `getOffset()`; `fillSpace(world, x, y, z, dir, o) { super.fillSpace(...); x += dir.offsetX * o; z += dir.offsetZ * o; makeExtra(world, px, py, pz); ... }` (copy `LaunchPad`/`MachineCoker`; `MachineChemicalPlant`'s `x -= dir.offsetX` is the same thing for offset 1); `onBlockActivated` -> `standardOpenBehavior(..., 0)`; TE implements `IGUIProvider` (e.g. `TileEntityMachineChemicalPlant` L271-272); `TileMappings.writeMappings()` put; `ModBlocks` init (copy `machine_chemical_plant` ~L2499) + `register`; TESR in `ClientProxy`; lang `tile.machine_x.name`/`.desc` (`$` line breaks). Exemplar `blocks/machine/MachineChemicalPlant.java`.
- Irregular multiblock: override `checkRequirement`/`fillSpace` with the SAME origin/dims/dir for each extra box, every extra box touching the main body; `getAllDimensions()` rows for the preview; optional `getAABBExtras`, `getHeightOffset`. Exemplar `MachineCoker.java`.
- Rotated hitbox: add `AxisAlignedBB` entries to `this.bounding` in the ctor and `this.maxY = 0.999D`. The rotation passed to `getAABBRotationOffset` is `dir.getRotation(UP)`, so author boxes with -X as the machine's forward (as if core meta were 14/WEST) and verify in-game against `MachineSawmill`. Exemplar `MachineCentrifuge.java`.
- Single-block machine with GUI: extend `BlockContainer` (or `BlockMachineBase(Material, guiID)`); rotation meta from yaw (`i==0->2, 1->5, 2->3, 3->4`); `onBlockActivated` -> `FMLNetworkHandler.openGui(player, MainRegistry.instance, 0, world, x, y, z)`; spill inventory in `breakBlock` then `super`. Exemplar `MachineBattery.java` (note its ctor is `(Material, long maxPower)`).
- Cable/pipe block: extend `BlockContainer`, own `renderID`, bounds via `Library.canConnect`/`canConnectFluid`; ducts extend `FluidDuctBase` for identifier-item typing. Exemplar `FluidDuctStandard.java`.
- Crane: extend `BlockCraneBase`, `createNewTileEntity` -> `TileEntityCraneBase` subclass, register 13 `iconDirectional*` icons, `IEnterableBlock`. Exemplar `CraneInserter.java`.
- Conveyor: extend `BlockConveyorBendable`, no TE, drop `ModItems.conveyor_wand`. Exemplar `BlockConveyor.java`.
- Explosive: `BlockTNTBase` (icons `_side/_top/_bottom`), `BlockDetonatable(mat, encouragement, flammability, popFuse, detonateOnCollision, detonateOnShot)`, or `BlockChargeBase`; implement `IFuckingExplode.explodeEntity`; register nukes with the 2-arg form (no tooltips) or `ItemBlockBase.class` (charges do). Exemplar `BlockTNTBase.java`.
- Redstone/detonator on a multiblock: `IBomb.explode` finds the core and delegates; `onNeighborBlockChange` forwards to the core then calls `super` (orphan cleanup). Exemplar `LaunchPad.java`.

### Gotchas

- `makeExtra` silently no-ops when the target is not this block or meta > 5: wrong port coordinates give a machine with no working ports and no error.
- `safeRem`/`overrideTileMeta` are static globals: an exception inside `fillSpace`/`makeExtra` leaves `safeRem = true`.
- `BlockDummyable.positions`/`internalPlayers` are unsynchronized instance scratch state shared by client and server in single-player.
- Custom `fillSpace` with a different origin/dir creates dummy chains pointing at the box origin; any gap = orphan self-deletion.
- `TileEntityProxyBase.cachedPosition` (only assigned by `TileEntityCustomMachine`) must be cleared if a core TE is swapped in place.
- `BlockCraneBase.onBlockActivated` returns false when holding `ItemTooling`/`ItemConveyorWand`; `PneumoTube` checks `ToolType.SCREWDRIVER` first.
- `FluidDuctStandard.getPickBlock` returns `ModItems.fluid_duct` with the fluid ID as damage; `BlockCustomMachine` encodes config index as damage >= 100.
- `DummyOldBase` implements `IEnergyConnectorBlock`/`IFluidConnectorBlock`/`IDummy`; `DummyBlockBlast` extends `BlockContainer` directly.
- Smells: only 3 TODOs (`pile/BlockGraphiteDrilledBase.java:178,222`, `MachineSolar.java:17`); item-spill code duplicated in 5 classes; `FluidDuctStandard` has a large commented-out `getItem` with debug prints; `drawPlacementHighlight` is ~250 lines of tessellator code in the Block class.

## 5. Tile entities: base classes and common machines

### Purpose

`com/hbm/tileentity/` holds the hierarchy every machine builds on (`TileEntityLoadedBase` -> `TileEntityMachineBase` -> `TileEntityMachinePolluting`, plus proxies), the plug-in interfaces (`IGUIProvider`, `IBufPacketReceiver`, `IConfigurableMachine`, `IUpgradeInfoProvider`, `IControlReceiver` (`interfaces/`), `IPersistentNBT`, `IFluidCopiable`, `IConditionalInvAccess`, `IRepairable`) and `TileMappings`. `machine/` has 189 top-level files (290 recursive). Energy/fluid behaviour is inherited from the `api.hbm` default-method interfaces and driven from `updateEntity`.

### Key files

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `com/hbm/tileentity/TileEntityLoadedBase.java` | Root: `isLoaded` (set false ONLY in `onChunkUnload`), `muffled`/`tilted`, `markChanged()`, `createAudioLoop()`/`rebootAudio()`/`getVolume()`, `serialize`/`deserialize`, `networkPackNT(range)` (BufPacket, precompiled on main thread, dedupe against `lastPackedBuf` except every 20th tick, queued via `PacketThreading`), `checkTilt` (one floor block per 20 ticks). |
| `TileEntityMachineBase.java` | Abstract `ISidedInventory` base: `slots[]`, `getName()`, NBT `items`, default deny-all side access, `breatheAir()` (atmosphere check; TODO consume from tanks), deprecated `handleButtonPacket`, `isUseableByPlayer` (`getDistanceSq <= 128`). Imports Forge's `FluidTank` for `getGaugeScaled`, not HBM's. |
| `TileEntityMachinePolluting.java` | + `IFluidStandardSender` (deprecated shim) with three smoke tanks; `pollute(...)`, `sendSmoke()`. |
| `TileEntityInventoryBase.java`, `TileEntityTickingBase.java` | Non-ticking inventory base (default `getAccessibleSlotsFromSide` = `{0}`), ticking base without inventory. |
| `TileMappings.java` | `writeMappings()` -> private `put(Class, String... names)` (extra names = alternative ids for `registerTileEntityWithAlternatives`); collects `IConfigurableMachine` classes into `configurables`; `Compat.blacklistAccelerator(clazz)` (Torcherino). |
| `IUpgradeInfoProvider.java`, `inventory/UpgradeManagerNT.java`, `items/machine/ItemMachineUpgrade.java` | Upgrades: `new UpgradeManagerNT(this)` + `checkSlots(slots, a, b)` each tick, `getLevel(UpgradeType)`; mutex only for `LM_SMELTER/SHREDDER/CENTRIFUGE/CRYSTALLIZER`, and `mutexType` uses strict `>` so re-inserting the same mutex upgrade after removal is ignored until the TE is recreated. |
| `inventory/fluid/tank/FluidTank.java` | HBM tank: `loadTank/unloadTank/setType`, `writeToNBT(nbt, key)` (readFromNBT clamps to the stored `<key>_max`; missing key zeroes fill), `serialize/deserialize`, `renderTank`/`renderTankInfo`; `withPressure`/`setTankType` are no-ops when unchanged. |
| `machine/TileEntityMachineElectricFurnace.java`, `TileEntityMachineCentrifuge.java`, `TileEntityMachineDiesel.java`, `TileEntityMachineChemicalPlant.java` | Exemplars: simplest receiver (`updateConnections` every 40 ticks), IConfigurableMachine + audio + EC info, polluting provider + IControlReceiver + IFluidCopiable, multiblock core with `DirPos[] getConPos()` and tank arrays. |
| `packet/toclient/BufPacket.java`, `packet/toserver/NBTControlPacket.java`, `packet/toserver/AuxButtonPacket.java` | TE sync, GUI control (calls `receiveControl(player, nbt)` then `receiveControl(nbt)`), deprecated button packet (instanceof chain + `handleButtonPacket` fallback). |
| `sound/AudioWrapper.java`, `AudioWrapperClient.java` | Server no-op / client loop handles. |

### Patterns

- Census (machine/ top-level): 92 extend `TileEntityMachineBase`, 33 `TileEntityLoadedBase`, 23 raw `TileEntity`, 9 `TileEntityMachinePolluting`, 3 `TileEntityTickingBase`; rbmk uses `TileEntityRBMKBase` -> `ActiveBase` -> `SlottedBase`; albion `TileEntityCooledBase`.
- Sync is ByteBuf-only: override `serialize`/`deserialize` (super first, identical order), call `networkPackNT(range)` unconditionally each server tick (50 small, 100-150 large). `INBTPacketReceiver`/`networkPack(NBT)` no longer exist (only a commented-out reference in `TileEntityMachineIGenerator`, whose `updateEntity` is entirely commented out).
- Registration: `put(TileEntityX.class, "tileentity_x")` in `writeMappings()`; `MainRegistry` loops the map. Ids are lowercase `tileentity_<name>` (typos like `tilentity_objtester`, `tileentity_satellitereceicer` are kept for save compat).
- GUI: TE implements `IGUIProvider`; `provideGUI` carries `@SideOnly(Side.CLIENT)` by convention (90 of 94 in machine/); block opens with ID 0.
- Control: `IControlReceiver.hasPermission(player)` (distance < 25 or `isUseableByPlayer`) + `receiveControl(nbt)` + `markChanged()`; GUI sends `NBTControlPacket`. Four tiles use the player-aware overload (`TileEntityLaunchPadRocket`, `TileEntityMachineRadarNT`, `TileEntityOrbitalStationLauncher`, `TileEntityElectrolyser`). Do not extend `AuxButtonPacket` (9 classes still override `handleButtonPacket`).
- Config: `IConfigurableMachine` with `public static` fields; `MachineDynConfig.initialize()` runs in PreLoad and creates a throwaway instance BEFORE `readIfPresent`, so constructors must be side-effect free and ctor-time reads of statics see defaults (`TileEntityMachineDiesel`'s tank capacity).
- Audio: `createAudioLoop()` -> `MainRegistry.proxy.getLoopedSound(id, x, y, z, volume, range, pitch, keepAliveTicks)` (8-arg; the 7-arg overload is deprecated; pitch argument is dropped by the proxy, call `updatePitch`); client branch start/`rebootAudio`/`keepAlive`/`updateVolume(getVolume(1F))`; stop in `onChunkUnload` (call `super` first) and `invalidate`.
- Pollution: `PollutionHandler.incrementPollution(world, x, y, z, PollutionType.SOOT, PollutionHandler.SOOT_PER_SECOND)` once per 20 ticks, or extend `TileEntityMachinePolluting` and `pollute(...)` + `sendSmoke(...)`.
- Render culling: override `getRenderBoundingBox()` with a cached AABB and `@SideOnly getMaxRenderDistanceSquared()` (206 TEs do).

### How-to

- Single-block electric machine: `extends TileEntityMachineBase implements IEnergyReceiverMK2, IGUIProvider, IUpgradeInfoProvider`; `super(slotCount)`; `getName()` -> `"container.foo"`; `slots_io` + `isItemValidForSlot`/`canExtractItem`/`getAccessibleSlotsFromSide` (battery slot `instanceof IBatteryItem`); NBT + `serialize`/`deserialize`; server tick: `trySubscribe` per side, `power = Library.chargeTEFromItems(slots, batterySlot, power, maxPower)`, `upgradeManager.checkSlots(slots, a, b)`, work, `networkPackNT(50)`; `provideContainer`/`provideGUI`; `TileMappings` put; block `extends BlockContainer`; `ModBlocks`; `ContainerFoo`/`GUIFoo`; TESR + `ClientProxy` bind; lang; recipe. Exemplar `TileEntityMachineElectricFurnace.java`.
- Multiblock core with fluid + power: `implements IEnergyReceiverMK2, IFluidStandardTransceiverMK2, IGUIProvider`; `FluidTank[] inputTanks/outputTanks`; `for(DirPos pos : getConPos()) { trySubscribe(worldObj, pos); trySubscribe(type, worldObj, pos) per input; tryProvide(tank, worldObj, pos) per output; }`; `getReceivingTanks/getSendingTanks/getAllTanks`; render bbox. Exemplar `TileEntityMachineChemicalPlant.java`. Override `canConnect(dir)` (defaults true) to restrict faces.
- Configurable numbers: see area 1; exemplar `TileEntityMachineCentrifuge.java`.
- GUI button: `IControlReceiver` + `PacketDispatcher.wrapper.sendToServer(new NBTControlPacket(data, te.xCoord, te.yCoord, te.zCoord))` from `mouseClicked` (or `GuiInfoContainer.clickSendFlag`). Exemplar `TileEntityMachineDiesel.java`.
- Loop sound: `NTMSounds` constant + `sounds.json`; `AudioWrapper audio`; `createAudioLoop()`; client branch gating on a synced running flag; `onChunkUnload() { super.onChunkUnload(); stop }` and `invalidate()`. Exemplar `TileEntityMachineCentrifuge.java` (but it skips `super.onChunkUnload()`; do not copy that).
- Smoke-tank pollution: extend `TileEntityMachinePolluting(slotCount, bufferMb)`, `getSendingTanks()` returns `getSmokeTanks()` + own outputs, `pollute(fluidType, FluidReleaseType.BURN, amount)`, `sendSmoke(x+dx, y+dy, z+dz, dir)` per side. Exemplar `TileEntityMachineDiesel.java`.

### Gotchas

- `super.onChunkUnload()` is the only place `isLoaded` becomes false; 25 of 50 overrides skip it, leaving unloaded tiles in nets (1.7.10 never invalidates TEs on unload).
- `networkPackNT` dedupes identical buffers except every 20th tick; `TileEntityLoadedBase` does not override `getDescriptionPacket`, so a freshly loaded client sees state only after that resend. `serialize()` must be deterministic.
- `MachineDynConfig` swallows `newInstance()` failures: a missing public no-arg ctor silently drops the machine from `hbmMachines.json`.
- `ILoadedTile.TileAccessCache` caches nulls 20 ticks; `ElectricFurnace.updateConnections` runs every 40, so a new cable can take ~60 ticks to connect.
- `BlockDummyable.breakBlock` already spills `ISidedInventory` contents of the core; only single-block `BlockContainer` machines need their own spill.
- `TileEntityMachineCentrifuge.provideExtraInfo` writes both `setBoolean` and `setInteger` under `B_ACTIVE`.
- Tiles do not chunkload; `ChunkLoaderManager`/`IChunkLoader` are entity-side (missiles, shells, drones, planes).
- ElectricFurnace-style on/off block swapping (static `keepInventory` + `world.setBlock`) breaks `findCore` if copied into a BlockDummyable.
- Smells: `TileEntityMachineAssemblyFactory.java:48` TODO base class; `TileEntityMachineWarController.java:40-58` auto-generated stubs; `TileEntityReactorResearch.java:51` TODO fix reactor control; `TileEntityFEL.java:70` @Spaghetti; `IRTGUser.java` three `@Untested @Beta` overloads; `TileEntityMachineElectricFurnace`/`Centrifuge` still use deprecated `new UpgradeManagerNT()` + `checkSlots(this, ...)`.

## 6. Tile entities: RBMK, fusion, Albion, bombs, turrets, deco

### Purpose

Server-side simulation tiles for the big set pieces: RBMK (per-column heat + tick-batched neutron streams + gamerule "dials"), fusion torus and peripherals (UNINOS GenNode klystron/plasma nets), Albion particle accelerator (a `Particle` walking `IParticleUser` tiles), assembly nukes and launch pads (`IBomb`/`IRadarCommandReceiver`), `BulletConfig`-driven turrets, deco tiles, plus research/breeding/ZIRNOX/PWR reactors. All follow the area-5 skeleton and expose OC `@Callback`s and ROR hooks.

### Key files

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `tileentity/machine/rbmk/TileEntityRBMKBase.java` | Column base: heat, `reasimWater/Steam`, `moveHeat()` (4-neighbour averaging by `RBMKDials.getColumnHeatFlow`), `coolPassively()`, `boilWater()`, `hasLid()` (lid in block metadata), `meltdown()` flood-fill (corium, overpressure of `IOverpressurable` nets collected by `TileEntityRBMKBoiler.onMelt`, digamma), `getConsoleType()`, `getNBTForConsole()`, `trackingRange()` (15; control rods 100), `invalidate`/`onChunkUnload` remove the neutron node. STATIC `explodeOnBroken`, `diag`, `columns`, `pipes`. |
| `rbmk/TileEntityRBMKActiveBase.java`, `TileEntityRBMKSlottedBase.java` | + `getName()`/`isUseableByPlayer`; + copied inventory code + `IGUIProvider`. |
| `rbmk/TileEntityRBMKRod.java`, `TileEntityRBMKRodReaSim.java`, `IRBMKFluxReceiver.java`, `IRBMKLoadable.java` | Fuel channel: `receiveFlux`, burns `ItemRBMKRod` (`burn`/`updateHeat`/`provideHeat`), `fluxFromType`, `spreadFlux()` (4 cardinal streams; ReaSim 8 streams at 0.75 each), meltdown when heat > 1500 or hull >= 1500 on invalidate; calls `super.updateEntity()` mid-method. |
| `rbmk/RBMKDials.java` | Gamerule dials (`RBMKKeys`), `createDials()` (server start; calls `refresh` BEFORE writing defaults), `refresh()` (also on `/gamerule`), typed getters (server only; `getGameRule` self-heals missing rules; `getColumnHeight` returns clamp(2..16) - 1; `getSurgeMod` client fallback returns passive cooling). `KEY_REASIM_BOILERS` OR'd with `GeneralConfig.enable528ReasimBoilers`. |
| `rbmk/TileEntityRBMKControl.java`, `ControlManual.java`, `ControlAuto.java` | Rods: level moves at `0.00277 * getControlSpeed`; ReaSim rods need 5000 HE buffered and consume 5000 HE only on ticks where the level changes; Manual adds `RBMKColor` + surge term; Auto maps heat to level (`receiveControl` mods by `RBMKColor.values().length` (5) but indexes `RBMKFunction.values()` (3)). |
| `rbmk/TileEntityRBMKBoiler.java`, `Heater.java`, `Cooler.java`, `Outgasser.java`, `Storage.java`, `Blank.java`, `Inlet.java` | Steam tiers, heat exchanger (`@Optional` modid lowercase), cryo cooler, irradiation channel, rod storage, passive exemplar, ReaSim water inlet/outlet. Piped columns expose side ports only when `rbmk_loader` sits 1-2 blocks below (`getOutputPos` copy-pasted per class). |
| `rbmk/TileEntityRBMKConsole.java`, `Display.java`, `TileEntityCraneConsole.java`, `Autoloader.java`, `Gauge.java`, `Terminal.java` | 15x15 console (`rescan` every 10 ticks, full column packet only when `worldTime % 10 == 0`; `ColumnType` enum with texture offsets, `FUEL_SIM` sits out of offset order: append new constants at the end), 7x7 display, crane (`HbmPlayerProps` keybinds, `IRBMKLoadable`), piston autoloader, RTTY mini panel exemplar (`GaugeUnit[4]`), RTTY terminal. |
| `handler/neutron/NeutronHandler.java`, `NeutronNodeWorld.java`, `NeutronStream.java`, `NeutronNode.java`, `RBMKNeutronHandler.java`, `PileNeutronHandler.java`, `package-info.java` | Server tick START: cache dials into `RBMKNeutronHandler` statics (`columnHeight = dial + 1`), run all streams, clear them, `cleanNodes` every 20 ticks (RBMK only; pile TODO at `NeutronNodeWorld.java:75`). ### Patterns

- One-shot events piggyback on `BufPacket`: set a flag, `networkPackNT`, clear it; `serialize` writes a boolean discriminator (`TileEntityTurretTauon.shot`, `Maxwell.shot`, `Richard.isTurretPacket`, `PWRController.isPrinting`).
- Client interpolation via `sync*` fields and `turnProgress` counters (crane console, autoloader, launch pad large, turrets).
- RBMK lid state lives in block metadata; `RBMKBase.onScrew` must call `node.removeLid()` or the cached neutron node goes stale; unlidded columns leak radiation.
- Fusion transport: `UniNodespace.getNode(world, x, y, z, Provider.THE_PROVIDER)` else `new GenNode(provider, BlockPos).setConnections(DirPos)` + `createNode`; `node.net.addReceiver/addProvider(this)` every tick; `destroyNode` in `invalidate()`. Klystron/Plasma nets have empty `update()` and no purge; `provideKyU` guards with `isLoaded() && !isInvalid()`.
- Registration: launch pads, landmine, balefire, antimatter, compact launcher, launch table and crashed bomb are `put` in the `writeMappings()` body (L101-197); `putBombs()` only holds assembly nukes, custom nuke, charges; RBMK in `putRBMK()`, fusion in `putFusion()` (incl. `TileEntityFusionKlystronCreative`), turrets in `putTurrets()`.
- OC: `@Optional.InterfaceList(...)`, `SimpleComponent, CompatHandler.OCComponent`, `@Callback(direct = true) @Optional.Method(modid = "OpenComputers")`; see area 18 for the `methods()`/`invoke()` semantics.
- Tilt: `checkTilt(TiltType.CONFIG, true)` + `getFloorCount()/getFloorPosFromIndex()` (torus 6x6, ZIRNOX 5x5).
- RBMK gamerule dials (`RBMKDials`, created on server start, refreshed on `/gamerule`, read through typed getters): `dialPassiveCooling`, `dialPassiveCoolingInner`, `dialColumnHeatFlow`, `dialDiffusionMod`, `dialHeatProvision`, `dialColumnHeight`, `dialBoilerHeatConsumption`, `dialControlSpeed`, `dialControlSurgeMod`, `dialReactivityMod`, `dialModeratorEfficiency`, `dialAbsorberEfficiency`, `dialAbsorberHeatConversion`, `dialReflectorEfficiency`, `dialFluxRange`, `dialOutgasserSpeedMod`, `dialReasimBoilers`, `dialReasimBoilerSpeed`, `dialReasimRange`, `dialDisableDepletion`, `dialDisableXenon`, `dialDisableMeltdowns`, `dialEnableMeltdownOverpressure`, `dialEnablePermaScrap`, `dialSaveDials`. Per-rod flux weighting by neutron type is the private `TileEntityRBMKRod.fluxFromType(NType)`.

### How-to

- New RBMK column: extend `TileEntityRBMKBase` (passive) or `TileEntityRBMKSlottedBase(slots)` (GUI); `getConsoleType()` (add a `ColumnType` at the END with a free texture offset; extend `RBMKColumn.getFancyStats` if it shows stats); `getRBMKType()` + `IRBMKFluxReceiver` + a branch in `RBMKNeutronStream.runStreamInteraction` and `makeNode` if neutrons interact; `onMelt(reduce)` with `spawnDebris`; keep `super.updateEntity()` at the end; block extends `RBMKBase`/`RBMKPipedBase` (copy `RBMKRod.java`, `createNewTileEntity` uses `meta >= this.offset`); `ModBlocks` next to `rbmk_rod` (~L2390/~L3578); `putRBMK()` id `tileentity_rbmk_*`; TESR near `ClientProxy` `//RBMK` (~L466). Exemplar `TileEntityRBMKOutgasser.java`.
- New RBMK fuel: `ItemRBMKPellet` + `ItemRBMKRod(pellet)` builder chain in `ModItems` (~L3423/~L3479); register both items (`rbmk_fuel_bk247` and the `*cf` pellets are currently unregistered); hazards in `HazardRegistry.registerItems()` through the private helpers `registerRBMKPellet(pellet, base, dep[, linear][, blinding, digamma])` and `registerRBMKRod(rod, base, dep[, blinding | linear])` (rods also get `HOT`); without them the fuel carries no radiation/heat hazard and shows no hazard tooltip.
- New dial: `RBMKKeys` constant, line in `refresh()`, typed getter; cache into `NeutronHandler` statics if stream code reads it.
- New turret: extend `TileEntityTurretBaseNT`/`BaseArtillery`; `static List<Integer> configs` from `XFactory*.<bullet>.id`; `getAmmoList()`; tuning getters (`getDecetorRange` etc, typos are API); `updateFiringTick()` with `getFirstConfigLoaded()`, `cachedCasingConfig = conf.casing`, `spawnBullet`, `conusmeAmmo`; block extends `TurretBaseNT`; `putTurrets()`; TESR (~L257). Exemplar `TileEntityTurretChekhov.java`.
- Fusion consumer: `implements IFusionPowerReceiver` (`receivesFusionPower()` false for neutron-only), plasma node at `dir.getOpposite() * 4, y + 2`, `addReceiver` each tick, `destroyNode` in `invalidate`, `putFusion()`, TESR (~L485). Exemplar `TileEntityFusionBoiler.java`.
- Albion component: extend `TileEntityCooledBase(slots)` + `IParticleUser` (`canParticleEnter` checks `new BlockPos(this).offset(beamlineDir, -entry)` and direction; `onEnter` may `particle.crash(PAState.X)`; `getExitPos`); block like `blocks/machine/albion/BlockPAQuadrupole`; `TileMappings` (~L207-213); TESR (~L282). Exemplar `TileEntityPAQuadrupole.java`.
- Launchable missile: `ItemMissile` with `launchable`, `fuel`, `fuelCap`; entity ctor `(World, float, float, float, int, int)`; `missiles.put(new ComparableStack(item), Entity.class)` in `registerLaunchables()`.
- Custom nuke ingredient: `entries.put(new ComparableStack(item), new CustomNukeEntry(type, value[, MULT]))` in `registerBombItems()`; caps in `blocks/bomb/NukeCustom.explodeCustom`.
- RTTY mini panel: `TileEntityLoadedBase` + `IGUIProvider` (null container, `GuiScreen`) + `IControlReceiver` + OC; inner `XUnit[]` with per-index NBT/ByteBuf; `RTTYSystem.listen`/`broadcast`; block extends `RBMKMiniPanelBase`. Exemplar `TileEntityRBMKGauge.java`.
- Assembly nuke: plain `TileEntity` + `ISidedInventory` + `IGUIProvider` with `isReady()`/`clearSlots()`; block `BlockContainer implements IBomb` (copy `blocks/bomb/NukeBoy.java`); `EntityNukeExplosionMK5.statFac` + `EntityNukeTorex`; `putBombs()`; TESR (~L241).

### Gotchas

- Flux received in tick N is burned in tick N+1 (`lastFluxQuantity` is the displayed value). `NeutronNodeWorld.removeEmptyWorlds` drops a `StreamWorld` (and its node cache) when it has no streams. Stream iterators share a mutable `BlockPos`. `RBMKNeutronHandler` statics are overwritten per world every tick (multi-world dial race). The control-rod tail check in `runStreamInteraction` tests the origin node (dead branch, issue #1933) and blocked streams irradiate the origin column.
- `RBMKDials` getters on the client log an error and return the default.
- Fusion torus zeroes `klystronEnergy` after use and klystrons write into it directly: one-tick ordering lag by design. Forgetting `destroyNode` leaves zombie net members.
- PA: every beamline block must be a `BlockDummyable` whose core is `IParticleUser` or the run derails; coil below `quadMin/diMin` multiplies power draw 10x (100x stacked), above max crashes except inline dipole passes.
- Pads: tank types re-type from the loaded missile each tick; rocket pad rebuilds tanks and places/removes tower blocks; redstone edge needs the block's `onNeighborBlockChange` to call `updateRedstonePower`.
- Turrets: rotations in radians; `getHorizontalOffset` hard-codes 2x2 offsets; ammo slots accept anything (`isItemValidForSlot` true); damaged variants ignore the whitelist; `TurretArty.methods()` omits `getPos`, `TurretHIMARS` adds `addCoords` without listing it.
- `TileEntityRBMKHeater` uses `modid = "opencomputers"` (stripped by FML; harmless because `OCComponent` still brings `SimpleComponent`).
- Smells: `TileEntityTurretFritz.java:160` TODO duplicated connections; `TileEntityCompactLauncher`/`LaunchTable.sendCommandEntity` pass `posX` for both x and z; `TileEntityLaunchPadRocket.getDestination` inverted `hasDrive()`; `TileEntityLaunchPadLarge` checks `erector == 1F` twice; `TileEntityNukeCustom.destruct()` passes x as z; `TileEntityNukeBoy.isReady` uses `slots[01]` (octal); `TileEntityRBMKConsole.getName()` returns null; `EntityAntimatter.java` in `tileentity/bomb` is a 0-byte file; `TileEntityRBMKSlottedBase` and `getOutputPos` are admitted copy-paste.
