## 7. Energy/fluid networks (UNINOS) and packet threading

### Purpose

UNINOS (`com/hbm/uninos`) is the graph engine behind every wire-like system: HE cables, fluid ducts (one graph per `FluidType`), pneumatic tubes, and single-purpose nets (klystron, plasma, foundry channel, rebar). Tiles push a `GenNode` into a per-World map keyed `Pair(BlockPos, INetworkProvider)`; `UniNodespace.updateNodespace()` (every `ServerTickEvent` START from `ModEventHandler.onServerTick`, BEFORE tile ticks) stitches nodes into `NodeNet`s and ticks `update()`. Machines subscribe as receivers/providers to an adjacent conductor's net (area 2). `PacketThreading` (`com/hbm/handler/threading`) only offloads the netty send of precompiled packets to one worker thread and rejoins at tick END.

### Key files

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `com/hbm/uninos/UniNodespace.java` | `worlds` (World -> `UniNodeWorld`, never cleared on unload except `/ntmreapnetworks`), `activeNodeNets`, `getNode/createNode/destroyNode`, `updateNodespace()`, `checkNodeConnection`/`checkConnection`/`connectToNode`, 5-minute reaper. `UniNodeWorld.popNode` calls `node.net.destroy()`. |
| `uninos/GenNode.java`, `NodeNet.java`, `INetworkProvider.java` | Node (`positions[]`, `connections[]`, `net` null first tick, `expired`, `recentlyChanged`); abstract net (`links`, `receiverEntries`/`providerEntries` timestamp maps, `joinNetworks`, `isBadLink`; ctor self-registers in `activeNodeNets`); provider factory (must return a fresh net each call). |
| `uninos/networkproviders/PowerNetProvider.java`, `FluidNetProvider.java`, `PneumaticNetwork.java` + `Provider`, `KlystronNetwork.java`, `PlasmaNetwork.java`, `FoundryNetwork.java`, `RebarNetwork.java` | Power singleton (`Nodespace.THE_POWER_PROVIDER`), per-FluidType provider, item-tube net (raw `NodeNet`, own `receivers` map with 1000 ms timeout, `send()` every 5 ticks per compressor, range by pressure 10/25/100/250/1000, 64 mass units per transfer, NTL `accessors`/`storages`), empty-update nets. |
| `tileentity/network/TileEntityCableBaseNT.java`, `TileEntityCableSwitch.java`, `TileEntityPylonBase.java`, `TileEntitySubstation.java`, `TileEntityPipeBaseNT.java`, `TileEntityPipelineBase.java`, `TileEntityFluidValve.java`, `TileEntityFluidCounterValve.java`, `TileEntityPipeExhaust.java`, `TileEntityConverterHeRf.java`, `TileEntityConverterRfHe.java` | Conductor/duct tiles; pylons use `DirPos(..., UNKNOWN)` at their own position plus one toward each wired pylon; `PipeBaseNT.onChunkUnload` only sets `isLoaded = false` (nodes survive unload); exhaust holds 3 FluidNodes at one position. |
| `tileentity/network/pneumatic/TileEntityPneumoTube.java`, `TileEntityPneumaticMachineBase.java`, `TileEntityPneumaticStorageBase.java`, `TileEntityPneumoStorageAccess.java` | Tube (compressor/endpoint roles, filters), access-point bases (destroy node on chunk unload), storage base (detaches monitors on unload but keeps its node). |
| `tileentity/network/RTTYSystem.java`, `TileEntityRadioTorchBase.java`, `TileEntityRadioTorchSender.java`, `TileEntityRadioTorchReceiver.java` | Double-buffered radio channel bus keyed (World, channel); `broadcast` next tick visible; channels are never evicted (compare `chan.timeStamp`, `chan != null` is not "signal present"); test channel `2012-08-06` injected every tick. |
| `tileentity/network/RequestNetwork.java`, `TileEntityRequestNetwork.java`, `TileEntityDroneDock.java`, `TileEntityDroneWaypoint.java` | Drone logistics graph (leases 2000 ms; the intended 20-tick throttle is dead code so the purge runs every tick; `hasPath` uncapped over known nodes). Not nodespace-based. |
| `tileentity/machine/TileEntityMachineRadarNT.java` | Static `updateSystem()` gathers matching entities once per server tick. |
| `handler/threading/PacketThreading.java`, `packet/threading/ThreadedPacket.java`, `PrecompiledPacket.java` | Single-worker pool (`NTM-Packet-Thread-*`), `ReentrantLock lock`, `createAllAroundThreadedPacket`/`createSendToThreadedPacket`, `waitUntilThreadFinished` (50 ms per future, logs and clears on timeout, latches `hasTriggered` on the 6th consecutive non-empty clear; `packetThreadingErrorBypass` skips the wait entirely and drops whatever is queued). `preparePacket` compiles on the main thread only for `PrecompiledPacket`. `init()` only called from `/ntmpackets` (its validation is inverted: `max > core` resets both to 1). |
| `commands/CommandPacketInfo.java`, `CommandReapNetworks.java` | `/ntmpackets` with subcommands `info`, `resetState`, `toggleThreadingStatus`, `forceLock`, `forceUnlock` (forceLock starves the worker, not a deadlock; lock is reentrant); `/ntmreapnetworks` clears `activeNodeNets` and `worlds`. |
| `blocks/network/CableDiode.java`, `tileentity/machine/storage/TileEntityBatteryBase.java`, `TileEntityBatteryREDD.java`, `blocks/generic/BlockRebar.java`, `blocks/machine/FoundryChannel.java`, `tileentity/machine/fusion/TileEntityFusionKlystron.java` | Diode (`sendPowerDiode`, recursion brake, 10 pulses/tick), battery-as-conductor (node at `getPortPos()`, lookup/destroy at own xyz: REDD's ports exclude the core, so it leaks duplicate nodes), custom `transferFluid` walking `net.links`, foundry node with `NTMMaterial`, offset klystron node. |

### Patterns

- Connection rule (`checkConnection`): A connects to B iff A has a `DirPos c` at one of B's positions and B has a `DirPos r` with `r.pos - r.dir == c.pos` and `r.dir == c.dir.getOpposite()`; `skipSideCheck` is always false. Wired links use UNKNOWN on both ends (`UNKNOWN.getOpposite() == UNKNOWN`), the reverse being B's own-position UNKNOWN DirPos.
- Net formation: nodes with `!hasValidNet() || recentlyChanged` are re-checked each tick; the larger net absorbs the smaller; set `node.recentlyChanged = true` when connections change at runtime (`TileEntityPylonBase.addConnection`).
- Node keys use the provider INSTANCE, so several providers may coexist at one position; fluid nets are per `FluidType` instance (`/ntmreload` preserves instances of same-named custom fluids via `Fluids.fluidMigration`; only removed/renamed custom fluids orphan nodes).
- Tick orchestration: START: `RTTYSystem.updateBroadcastQueue`, `RequestNetwork.updateEntries`, `TileEntityMachineRadarNT.updateSystem`, `UniNodespace.updateNodespace`; END: `PacketThreading.waitUntilThreadFinished`, `NetworkHandler.flush`. A node created in `updateEntity` gets a net next tick.
- Threaded sends: `PrecompiledPacket` = serialized on the main thread before queueing (`BufPacket`, `EntityBufPacket`, `ExtPropPacket`); plain `ThreadedPacket` (`AuxParticlePacketNT`) is serialized inside `NetworkHandler.encode` on the worker thread, so its data must be immutable after construction. After the send, the task calls `getCompiledBuffer().release()`, which triggers a second, discarded `toBytes()` on the worker thread for every queued packet. Never reuse a `ThreadedPacket` instance on the threaded path.

### How-to

- Consumer/provider/duct/cable/new network kind: see area 2. Register new TEs in `TileMappings.writeMappings()` (e.g. L497 `put(TileEntityCableBaseNT.class, "tileentity_cable", "tileentity_wirecoated")`).
- Pneumatic access point: extend `TileEntityPneumaticMachineBase` and use `this.cache` (`StackCache.consumeItemsAndReturnQuantity`/`addItemsAndReturnQuantity`). Exemplar `TileEntityPneumoStorageAccess.java`.
- Tile sync packet: `serialize`/`deserialize` + `networkPackNT(range)`; custom packets that read mutable server state must extend `PrecompiledPacket`. Exemplar `TileEntityFluidCounterValve.java`.
- RTTY: sender `RTTYSystem.broadcast(worldObj, channel, value)`; receiver `RTTYChannel chan = RTTYSystem.listen(worldObj, channel)` and compare `chan.timeStamp` to the last seen stamp. Exemplar `TileEntityRadioTorchSender.java`.

### Gotchas

- `TileAccessCache` caches null lookups 20 ticks (new cable seen after up to 1 s); non-null entries self-expire on invalidation.
- Subscription timeouts are wall-clock: a paused/lagging server drops every subscriber; they self-heal on the next subscribe.
- `PowerNetMK2.update`/`FluidNetMK2.update` return early when either side is empty, so stale entries linger on one-sided nets.
- `TileEntityPylonBase.addConnection` NPEs when the node does not exist yet (same tick as placement).
- Smells: `NodeNet.joinNetworks` raw-generics cast ("this is bullshit"); `PowerNode` rant about join failures (root cause unknown); `TileEntityPipelineBase` "copy pasted crap class"; `RequestNetwork` "this entire system sucks" with an 8-point migration plan; `TileAccessCache.publicCumRag`; no TODO/@Spaghetti markers inside uninos/threading/api.

## 8. Items

### Purpose

`com/hbm/items/ModItems.java` (7192 lines, 1926 `public static Item` fields at L109-2338) instantiates items in `initializeItem()` (L2340) / `initializeItem2()` (L4373: `ModItemsArmor.init()`, ability tools, `GunFactory.init()`, buckets) and registers them in `registerItem()` (L4906). Behaviour is dispatched from the event handlers via marker interfaces (`ArmorFSB`, `ItemArmorMod`, `IItemHUD`, `IKeybindReceiver`, `IEquipReceiver`, `IGUIProvider`, `IItemControlReceiver`, `IAnimatedItem`).

### Key files

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `items/ModItems.java`, `ModItemsArmor.java` | Registry; armor sets instantiated in `ModItemsArmor.init()` (static import of `ModItems.*`), registered back in `ModItems.registerItem()`. `excludeNEI` set; `addRemap(String, Item, meta or Enum)` registers an `ItemRemap`. |

| `items/IKeybindReceiver.java`, `IItemControlReceiver.java`, `IEquipReceiver.java`, `IAnimatedItem.java`, `ISatChip.java`, `interfaces/IItemHUD.java` | Held-item hooks dispatched from `HbmKeybinds:217`/`HbmKeybindsServer:21`, `NBTItemControlPacket:67`, `ModEventHandler:767` (fires on Item identity change only), `ModEventHandlerRenderer:342`, `ModEventHandlerClient:205`. |

| `handler/HazmatRegistry.java`, `util/ArmorUtil.java`, `util/AchievementHandler.java` | Radiation resistance (`external` list filled by `ArmorFSB.setRadResist`, JSON override `config/hbmConfig/hbmRadResist.json` replaces the whole map), hazard classes (`ArmorUtil.register()` at `MainRegistry:599`), crafting achievements. |

### Patterns

- Three-phase registration: field, instantiate (`new X().setUnlocalizedName("x").setCreativeTab(MainRegistry.partsTab).setTextureName(RefStrings.MODID + ":x")`), `GameRegistry.registerItem(x, x.getUnlocalizedName())`. Registry name = unlocalized name. Hidden items use `.setCreativeTab(null)`; NEI hiding via `excludeNEI`.
- `ModItems` is kept byte-identical to upstream in this fork: fork-side creative-tab reversals (fuel plates, waste plates) live in `com/hbm/dbs/DBSItems.afterItemInit()`, run via `DBSFork.init()` from `MainRegistry.PreLoad` right after `ModItems.mainRegistry()`.
- Not every field is assigned in `ModItems`: guns/ammo come from `items/weapon/sedna/factory/*`, syringes/IVs from `ItemSimpleConsumable.init()`, armor from `ModItemsArmor.init()` (there is no `ModItemsCrafting`; everything else is in `initializeItem()`/`initializeItem2()`).
- Naming families: field = unlocalized name = registry name = texture (`hbm:<name>`); choose the class by family: `Item` (plain), `ItemCustomLore` (lang `.desc` tooltip), `ItemEnumMulti(Enum.class, multiName, multiTexture)` (meta variants, icons `x.<enum_lower>`), `ItemGenericPart`/`ItemAutogen` (material parts), `ItemSimpleConsumable`, `ArmorFSB*`/`ItemArmorMod`, `ItemToolAbility*`, `ItemGunBaseNT` (sedna), `ItemBlock*` for blocks. Tabs: `partsTab` parts/ingots/dusts, `templateTab` templates/blueprints/chips, `consumableTab` consumables, `controlTab` reactor fuel and control items, `weaponTab`/`missileTab`/`nukeTab`, `machineTab`/`blockTab` for ItemBlocks; copy the tab of the nearest sibling item, `null` hides.
- Per-identity behaviour (`this == ModItems.x`) in `ItemDrop`, `ItemPill`, `ItemLemon`, `ArmorModel`, `ModArmor`, `ItemMachineUpgrade` tooltips.
- Armor: configure the helmet with fluent flags, then `new ArmorFSB(...).cloneStats((ArmorFSB) helmet)` for plate/legs/boots; hazard classes and `hides()` are per piece. Materials via `EnumHelper.addArmorMaterial("HBM_X", ...)` (two are both named `HBM_TRENCH`).
- Charge/fuel in NBT: `IBatteryItem` (`long charge`, missing = full), `IFillableItem` (`int fuel`).
- Self-registering static lists: `ItemRTGPellet.pelletList`, `ItemRBMKRod.craftableRods` (consumed by `FuelPoolRecipes:46` and `RBMKRodDisassemblyHandler:26`), `FluidTank.noDualUnload`.
- Achievements: `new Achievement("achievement.<k>", "<k>", x, y, icon, parent).initIndependentStat().registerStat()` in `MainRegistry` L393+; must be added to the `AchievementPage` array at `MainRegistry:467`; icons via `DictFrame.fromOne(ModItems.achievement_icon, EnumAchievementType.X)`; crafting triggers in `AchievementHandler.register()`.

### How-to

- Plain item / enum item / lore tooltip / rename: see CLAUDE.md checklist; exemplars `special/ItemExpensive.java`, `ItemCustomLore.java`, `ItemRemap.java` (`addRemap` hardcodes a placeholder texture).
- FSB armor set: four fields (~L1836-2171); material via `EnumHelper.addArmorMaterial`; helmet with all flags in `ModItemsArmor.init()`, e.g. `x_helmet = new ArmorFSB(mat, 0, "hbm:textures/armor/x_1.png").setNoHelmet(false).setRadResist(20D).setSealed(true).setStep("hbm:step.x").setJump(..).setFall(..).setStepSize(1).setDashCount(1).setHasGeigerSound(true).setHasCustomGeiger(..).setHasHardLanding(..).enableVATS(..).enableThermalSight(..).addEffect(new PotionEffect(..)).setHazardClass(HazardClass.X, ..).hides(EnumPlayerPart.HEAD).setOverlay(path)`; then `x_plate = new ArmorFSB(mat, 1, "...x_1.png").cloneStats((ArmorFSB) x_helmet)` (legs use `_2.png`, slots 0-3 = helmet/chest/legs/boots). `cloneStats` copies `effects` (shared list), `noHelmet`, `vats`, `thermal`, `geigerSound`, `customGeiger`, `hardLanding`, `dashCount`, `stepSize`, `step`/`jump`/`fall`, `canSeal` and re-runs `setRadResist`; it does NOT copy `setHazardClass`, `hides` or `setOverlay` (set per piece). Powered: `ArmorFSBPowered(mat, slot, texture, maxPower, chargeRate, consumption, drain)` (`IBatteryItem`, NBT `charge`); fueled: `ArmorFSBFueled(mat, slot, texture, fuelType, maxFuel, fillRate, consumption, drain)` (`IFillableItem`). Damage resistance is not a setter: `DamageResistanceHandler.initDefaults` / `config/hbmConfig/hbmArmor.json`. Register all four (~L6900-7040); icons `textures/items/`, layers `textures/armor/x_1.png`/`x_2.png`. Construction must happen before `PostLoad` (in practice inside `ModItemsArmor.init()`, called from `ModItems` in PreLoad) because `ArmorUtil.register()` / `HazmatRegistry.registerHazmats()` (`MainRegistry` L599-600, PostLoad) snapshot the hazard-class and rad-resistance tables.
- Armor mod: `extends ItemArmorMod` with slot constant; override hooks; attribute modifiers use `ArmorModHandler.UUIDs[armorType]`. Note `ModEventHandlerClient.java:791` iterates `i < 8` while `MOD_SLOTS == 9` (battery mod's `addDesc` never shows). Exemplar `ItemModCladding.java`.
- Ability tool: instantiate in `initializeItem2()`: `new ItemToolAbility(dmg, movement, MainRegistry.tMatX, EnumToolType.PICKAXE).addAbility(IToolAreaAbility.HAMMER, 1)...`; levels 0-based (`AvailableAbilities` clamps with a warning; disallowed abilities are dropped). New ability: constant in the interface + append to `abilities[]` + lang `tool.ability.x` + `ToolConfig` flag.
- RTG pellet / RBMK rod / machine upgrade: `ItemRTGPellet(heat).setDecays(...)` (~L3019), `ItemRBMKRod(pellet)` builder (~L3479), `ItemMachineUpgrade(UpgradeType, tier)` (~L4204). Hazards for fuels go into `HazardRegistry.registerItems()`: `registerRTGPellet(pellet, base, target[, hot[, blinding]])`, `registerPWRFuel(EnumPWRFuel, baseRad)`, `registerOtherFuel(fuel[, meta], base, target, blinding)`, `registerOtherWaste`/`registerRadSourceWaste` (area 13).
- Held-item HUD/keybind/GUI: implement `IItemHUD.renderHUD`, `IKeybindReceiver`, `IGUIProvider` + `player.openGui(MainRegistry.instance, 0, world, 0, 0, 0)`, `IItemControlReceiver`; no handler wiring. Exemplar `tool/ItemToolAbility.java`.
- Simple consumable: follow `ItemSimpleConsumable.init()` (`setUseActionServer`, helpers `giveSoundAndDecrement`, `addPotionEffect`).

### Gotchas

- Instantiated but never registered: `med_schizophrenia`, `pch`, `ammo_misc`, `rbmk_pellet_lecf/mecf/hecf`, `rbmk_fuel_bk247` (the last still feeds `craftableRods` recipes/NEI). Declared but never assigned (null): `remote`, `flask_empty`, `ingot_pet`, `ingot_tetraneutronium`, `nugget_tetraneutronium`, `powder_tetraneutronium`, `satellite`, `source`, `telepad`, `coin_siege`, `gadget_explosive`, `man_explosive`, `turret_biometry`, `turret_control`.
- `ItemEnumMulti`/`ItemCustomLore.setUnlocalizedName` already set the texture name; a differing trailing `setTextureName` overrides it.
- `ItemLemon.java:40` and `en_US.lang:3614` both spell `item.med_ipecac.desс` with a Cyrillic `с` (works in en_US; fix both together or not at all).
- `ArmorFSB.onArmorTick` geiger sound only on the chestplate; `HazmatRegistry` piece weights helmet 0.2 / chest 0.4 / legs 0.3 / boots 0.1.
- `ItemToolAbility.handleKeybind` refuses to cycle presets when looking at a block that overrides `onBlockActivated` (reflection hack).
- `ModItemsArmor` instantiates `jackt`/`jackt2` twice; `ModItems.java:3185` TODO move syringes; `@Spaghetti` on `ItemStarterKit`, `ItemGlitch`, `ItemSyringe`, `ItemEnergy`, `ArmorModel`; orphan texture `achievement_icon.digammaunity.png`.

## 9. Weapons: sedna gun system, projectiles, missiles, grenades

### Purpose

`items/weapon/sedna/`: one item class `ItemGunBaseNT` driven by a config tree `GunConfig -> Receiver[] -> IMagazine -> BulletConfig[]` wired with lambdas and evaluated through `XWeaponModManager` (per-stack mod overrides). Guns are declared in `XFactory*` classes called from `GunFactory.init()` (both sides) and rendered/HUD-configured in `GunFactoryClient.init()` (client, via `proxy.registerGunCfg()`). Projectiles: `EntityBulletBaseMK4` (physical), `EntityBulletBaseMK4CL` (chunk-loading; only `XFactoryFolly.folly_nuke` uses it), `EntityBulletBeamBase` (hitscan). Legacy `ItemGunBase` is gone; `BulletConfiguration`/`BulletConfigSyncingUtil`/`EntityBulletBaseNT` (@Deprecated) survive for NPC attacks and the custom-missile TURBINE warhead. Missiles are `EntityMissileBaseNT` tiers plus `EntityMissileCustom` (`MissileStruct`); the Space fork adds `RocketStruct`/`ItemCustomRocket`/`EntityRideableRocket`. Grenades are one NBT-composed item (`ItemGrenadeUniversal`).

### Key files

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `sedna/ItemGunBaseNT.java` | `GunConfig[] configs_DNA` (akimbo = 2); `getConfig(stack, i)` via `XWeaponModManager.eval`; `onUpdate` state machine (`GunState DRAWING/IDLE/COOLDOWN/RELOADING/JAMMED`, timer, decider lambda); `handleKeybind` press/release lambdas; `renderHUD`; NBT state via static `getValue*/setValue*` with `KEY_*` + config index; `playAnimation` always sends receiverIndex 0; static client recoil/aiming fields. |
| `sedna/GunConfig.java`, `Receiver.java`, `BulletConfig.java` | Per-gun config (getters all go through `eval`; `setupStandardConfiguration()`), per-barrel config (`setupStandardFire`/`setupLockonFire`), ammo definition (global `configs` list, `id` = index; `clone()` re-registers; `pType BULLET/BULLET_CHUNKLOADING/BEAM`; `onUpdate/onImpact/onImpactBeam/onRicochet/onEntityHit`; `getDamage` handles PHYSICAL/FIRE/EXPLOSIVE/ELECTRIC/LASER/SUBATOMIC only). |
| `sedna/factory/GunFactory.java`, `GunFactoryClient.java`, `Lego.java`, `LegoClient.java`, `GunStateDecider.java`, `Orchestras.java` | Entry point (ammo items, `EnumAmmo` append-only with `order` array, mod enums, ordered `XFactory*.init()` calls incl. `XFactoryFlamer`, `XFactoryDrill`, `XFactoryPA`); client registration (star-imports most factories but NOT Flamer/Drill/PA; flamer ammo gets no renderer); standard lambdas (`doStandardFire` spawns by `pType`); HUD components and `RENDER_*` lambdas; decider composition; 1754 lines of per-gun sound/casing/muzzle timing. |
| `sedna/factory/XFactory9mm.java`, `XFactory12ga.java`, `XFactoryRocket.java`, `XFactoryEnergy.java`, `XFactory40mm.java`, `XFactoryTurret.java`, `XFactoryPA.java`, `XFactoryTool.java`, `XFactoryDrill.java`, `XFactoryFlamer.java` | Compact exemplar; tube mags (`reloadSequential`, `reload(begin, cycle, end, cock)`); rocket templates (`clone()` per launcher, `rocket_ncrpa` and `rocket_ncrpa_steer`); beams; grenades/flares; turret ammo; power-armor delegates (standard decider); extinguisher + charge thrower; drill (`ItemGunDrill`, extra mod keys `D_REACH/F_DTNEG/F_PIERCE/I_AOE/I_HARVEST`); flamers (`MagazineFullReload`; only the chemthrower uses `MagazineFluid`). |
| `sedna/mags/IMagazine.java`, `MagazineSingleTypeBase.java`, `MagazineFullReload.java`, `MagazineSingleReload.java`, `MagazineBelt.java`, `MagazineFluid.java`, `MagazineInfinite.java` | Magazine strategies; NBT keys `magcount<index>/magtype<index>` (belt uses un-indexed `magtype`); `standardReload(null inventory)` fills for free (NPC guns); `getAmount(null) = 1` for belts. |
| `sedna/mods/XWeaponModManager.java`, `WeaponModBase.java`, `WeaponModCaliber.java`, `WeaponModScope.java`, `WeaponModDrill*.java` | Mod registry (`init()` in `MainRegistry` after items; `WeaponModDefinition.addMod(gun, mod)`; `idToMod` HashBiMap: duplicate ids silently overwrite; id ranges 0-9 test, 100+ generic, 200+ special (drill 222-232), 300+ caliber; priorities SET > MULTIPLICATIVE > ADDITIVE > MULT_FINAL; `restoreMagState` receiver 0 only), mod base, caliber (shared static `DUMMY_*` mags mutated on eval), scope. Each mod's `eval` compares keys with `==` against the interned constants. |
| `sedna/impl/ItemGunStinger.java`, `ItemGunChargeThrower.java`, `ItemGunChemthrower.java`, `ItemGunDrill.java` | Subclass exemplars (lock-on, grapple, `IFillableItem`). |
| `entity/projectile/EntityBulletBaseMK4.java`, `MK4CL.java`, `EntityBulletBeamBase.java`, `EntityThrowableNT.java`, `EntityThrowableInterp.java`, `EntityBulletBaseNT.java` (@Deprecated), `EntityBullet.java` (legacy) | Config-driven projectile (DataWatcher 3 = config id; lock-on server only; ct_hook special case), hitscan (250 blocks in the gun ctor; `onUpdate` still runs `config.onUpdate`; not persisted), throwable bases. |
| `entity/missile/EntityMissileBaseNT.java`, `EntityMissileTier1.java`, `EntityMissileCustom.java`, `EntityRideableRocket.java`, `handler/MissileStruct.java`, `RocketStruct.java`, `items/weapon/ItemCustomMissilePart.java`, `ItemCustomMissile.java`, `ItemCustomRocket.java`, `ItemMissile.java`, `tileentity/bomb/TileEntityLaunchPadBase.java` | Ballistic missile base (chunkload, radar tier from `ItemMissile.tier`), tier files with static inner concrete missiles, custom missile (`WarheadType` switch marked TODO; `SCHRAB`, `APOLLO`, `SATELLITE`, `CUSTOMn` without `impactCustom` do nothing; `CLUSTER` explicit no-op), rideable multi-stage rocket (RocketStruct in DataWatcher from id 11, variable size, must stay last), item->entity map at `TileEntityLaunchPadBase.java:62-70`. |
| `items/weapon/grenade/ItemGrenadeUniversal.java`, `ItemGrenadeFilling.java`, `ItemGrenadeFuze.java`, `ItemGrenadeShell.java`, `ItemGrenadeExtra.java`, `entity/grenade/EntityGrenadeUniversal.java` | NBT-composed grenade (shell/filling/fuze/extra enums of lambdas); `make()` used by `GrenadeCraftingHandler`, NEI, crates, item pools, `EntityFBIDrone`. |
| `packet/toclient/HbmAnimationPacket.java`, `render/anim/HbmAnimations.java`, `AnimationEnums.java`, `render/item/weapon/sedna/ItemRenderWeaponBase.java`, `ItemRenderGreasegun.java` | Animation trigger (`handleSedna` sets `lastShot`, runs recoil with `configIndex = receiverIndex`, resets vanilla equip bob, halves reload for Trenchmaster), per-hotbar-slot animation store, gun renderer base + exemplar. |
| `inventory/container/ContainerWeaponTable.java`, `entity/EntityMappings.java`, `crafting/WeaponRecipes.java`, `inventory/recipes/AmmoPressRecipes.java` | Only place mods get installed; entity registration (`entity_bullet_mk4` etc L102-106); gun recipes (L67); ammo press recipes (`DictFrame.fromOne(ModItems.ammo_standard, EnumAmmo.X, n)`). |

### Patterns

- Builder declaration: `new ItemGunBaseNT(WeaponQuality, new GunConfig().dura().draw().inspect().crosshair().smoke().rec(new Receiver(0).dmg().delay().spread().reload().jam().sound().mag(...).offset(f, u, s).setupStandardFire().recoil(...)).setupStandardConfiguration().anim(...).orchestra(...)).setDefaultAmmo(EnumAmmo.X, n).setUnlocalizedName("gun_x")`.
- Lambda types: `BiConsumer<ItemStack, LambdaContext>` (press/release/decider/orchestra/smoke/onFire/onRecoil), `BiFunction<ItemStack, LambdaContext, Boolean>` (canFire), `BiFunction<ItemStack, GunAnimation, BusAnimation>` (anims).
- Animation sync: server `playAnimation` -> `HbmAnimationPacket` + NBT `KEY_LASTANIM_/KEY_ANIMTIMER_`; `Orchestras` compare `getLastAnim/getAnimTimer` to tick offsets (anim millis / 50); client stores into `HbmAnimations.hotbar[slot][gunIndex]`; renderers apply the root bus unwrapped then push/pop per child part.
- Impact pipeline (MK4): `onImpact` -> `onRicochet` (default `LAMBDA_STANDARD_RICOCHET`) -> `onEntityHit` (default applies `EntityDamageUtil.attackEntityFromNT`); beams call `onImpactBeam` (null by default) from `performHitscan`.
- Weapon quality: `A_SIDE` core, `B_SIDE` variants, `LEGENDARY`/`SECRET` hidden (`ItemGunBaseNT.secrets`), `SPECIAL`/`UTILITY` tools.
- Other MK4 consumers: `TileEntityTurretBaseNT.spawnBullet`, `ModEventHandler` (~L1122 gauntlet), `ArmorNCRPARanged`, `ItemGrenadeFilling` submunitions, `TileEntityPileCore`, `TileEntityBatterySocket.discharge` (beam), `EntityAI*` NPC AIs, `EntityAIFireGun` (drives held guns with a null-inventory context).

### How-to

- New ammo: append to `EnumAmmo` (bottom) + insert into `EnumAmmo.order`; icon `ammo_standard.<lower>.png`; lang `item.ammo_standard.<lower>.name`; `public static BulletConfig p9_xxx = new BulletConfig().setItem(EnumAmmo.P9_XXX).setCasing(casing9.clone().register("p9xxx"))...` in the caliber factory; add to every magazine's `addConfigs` and to the caliber tables at the bottom of `XWeaponModManager.init()`; `p9_xxx.setRenderer(LegoClient.RENDER_STANDARD_BULLET)` in `GunFactoryClient.init()` (invisible otherwise); `AmmoPressRecipes` entry. Exemplar `XFactory9mm.java`.
- New gun: `ModItems.gun_foo` field; builder in an `XFactory*.init()` (new factory: add its `init()` to `GunFactory.init()` order, and static-import it in `GunFactoryClient`); anims lambda (`BusAnimation().addBus("NAME", new BusAnimationSequence().addPos(...))` or `ResourceManager.<gun>_anim.get("Firing")`); `Orchestras.ORCHESTRA_FOO`; `render/item/weapon/sedna/ItemRenderFoo extends ItemRenderWeaponBase`; `ResourceManager` model/texture; `MinecraftForgeClient.registerItemRenderer` + `getConfig(null, 0).hud(...)` in `GunFactoryClient` (`*_MIRROR` HUD components on config index 0 of akimbo guns); lang; `WeaponRecipes`; add to `XWeaponModManager` material tables (a null gun there throws ClassCastException at `addMod`).
- New weapon mod: enum constant (append), `WeaponModFoo extends WeaponModBase(id, "SLOT")` with `eval(base, gun, key, parent)` comparing `key == Receiver.F_BASEDAMAGE` etc and `cast(...)`; `new WeaponModDefinition(EnumModSpecial.FOO).addMod(guns, new WeaponModFoo(unusedId))` in `XWeaponModManager.init()`; grep ids first (no duplicate rejection). Exemplar `WeaponModCaliber.java`.
- Rocket/grenade ammo variant: `rocket_template[n] = baseRocket.clone().setItem(...).setOnImpact(LAMBDA)`; impact lambdas use `Lego.standardExplode(bullet, mop, range)` and guard self-hits (`ticksExisted < 3`); renderer via `setRendererBulk`. Exemplar `XFactoryRocket.java`.
- Beam ammo: `.setBeam().setupDamageClass(DamageClass.LASER).setOnBeamImpact(...)` + `setRendererBeam`. Exemplar `XFactoryEnergy.java`.
- Custom warhead: `new ItemCustomMissilePart().makeWarhead(WarheadType.CUSTOMn, punch, mass, PartSize.SIZE_15)` and set `WarheadType.CUSTOMn.impactCustom`/`updateCustom`/`labelCustom` during item init.
- Tiered missile: static inner class in the tier file (both ctors, `onMissileImpact`, `getDebrisRareDrop`, `getMissileItemForInfo`); `EntityMappings.addEntity`; renderer (`RenderMissileGeneric/Strong/Huge/Nuclear`, `ClientProxy` ~710) + item renderer (~586); `ItemMissile` + `TileEntityLaunchPadBase.missiles.put`. Exemplar `EntityMissileTier1.java`.
- Grenade filling/fuze/extra: enum constant with lambdas; submunition `BulletConfig` statics need a renderer; recipes in `crafting/handlers/GrenadeCraftingHandler`.

### Gotchas

- Positional ids everywhere: `BulletConfig.configs` (reordering factory init calls shifts ids persisted in magazines/turrets), `EnumAmmo` ordinals (item meta), mod ids (gun NBT), `BulletConfigSyncingUtil` ordinals.
- `SpentCasing.register(name)` global map; always clone + unique name.
- `Lego.LAMBDA_STANDARD_CLICK_SECONDARY` reads `getMode(stack, 0)` but writes `ctx.configIndex` (akimbo inconsistency). `GunConfig.getReceivers(stack)[0]` is hard-wired into the standard reload/canFire/decider lambdas.
- `EntityBulletBeamBase` does its hitscan in the constructor and is not saved; `EntityBulletBaseMK4.setDead()` sends a tracker teleport so 1-tick bullets render.
- `ItemGunBaseNT.getShareTag` override is commented out ("nbt sync dupe fix, didn't work"); NPC guns reload for free and skip `EQUIP`.
- `XWeaponModManager.install()` keys by `new ComparableStack(stack)` while `modFromStack` uses `makeSingular()`; `recognizedMods` only filled by `addMod` with a non-null gun.
- `DamageClass.PLASMA/MICROWAVE/OTHER` get no DamageSource flags in `BulletConfig.getDamage`.
- Smells: `XWeaponModManager.java:277` TODO receiver-0-only mag restore; `GunFactoryClient.java:249` TODO sabots; `Lego.java:42` "this turned into fucking spaghetti"; `EntityMissileCustom.java:167` TODO demolish switch; `EntityBulletBaseMK4.java:159` ct_hook hack; `GunB92` @Spaghetti("destroy this class"); `GunRocketFactory` dead; typos preserved as identifiers (`ORCHESTRA_PANERSCHRECK`, `LAMBDA_CLICK_MELEE_SENONDARY`).

## 10. Recipes, ore dictionary, fluids, materials, item pools

### Purpose

JSON-configurable machine recipes (`SerializableRecipe` and the generic `GenericRecipes`/`GenericRecipe`), the `AStack` ingredient abstraction (`ComparableStack`/`NBTStack`/`OreDictStack`), ore-dict naming (`OreDictManager.DictFrame`/`DictGroup` + `MaterialShapes` prefixes), the material/quanta system (`Mats`/`NTMMaterial`/`MaterialShapes`/`MatDistribution`), the fluid registry with traits (`Fluids`/`FluidType`/`FluidTrait` + `FluidContainerRegistry`), crafting-table recipes (`CraftingManager` + `com/hbm/crafting/*`) and weighted loot pools (`ItemPool*`). Recipe JSON lives in `config/hbmRecipes/`; fluid/item-pool/custom-machine JSON in `config/hbmConfig/`.

### Key files

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `inventory/recipes/loader/SerializableRecipe.java` | Base of all JSON recipe sets. `registerAllHandlers()` ordered list (called once in PostLoad); `initialize()`: `clearPools`, per handler `deleteRecipes` -> (first a server-synced stream in `recipeSyncHandlers`, else `config/hbmRecipes/<file>`, else `registerDefaults()` + `IRecipeRegisterListener` + `_<file>` template) -> `registerPost()`; `modified` flag. No per-handler error isolation. Helpers `readAStack/writeAStack` (`["item", name, size?, meta?]`, `["dict", name, size?]`, `["nbt", name, size, meta, nbt]`; NBT stacks lose meta on read), `readItemStack` (`[name, size?, meta?, nbt?]`), `readFluidStack` (`[name, mB, pressure?]`), `matchesIngredients`. Unparseable stacks degrade to `ModItems.nothing`. |
| `loader/GenericRecipes.java`, `GenericRecipe.java` | Generic set (`*Limit()` abstract methods, `instantiateRecipe`, `readExtraData`/`writeExtraData`, `recipeOrderedList`, `recipeNameMap`, static `blueprintPools`/`nameToRecipeGlobal` (cross-set name collisions silently overwrite), `autoSwitchGroups`, `ChanceOutput`/`ChanceOutputMulti`); recipe builders (`setup`, `setupNamed`, `inputItems` (throws if size > max stack), `setPools` (throws on `528.` when 528 off), `setGroup`, `setIcon`). |
| `inventory/RecipesCommon.java` | `AStack` (`matchesRecipe`, `compareTo` NBT > Comparable > OreDict), `ComparableStack` (equals treats WILDCARD as any but hashCode includes meta), `NBTStack`, `OreDictStack`; `ComparableStack(Item)` substitutes `ModItems.nothing` for null. |
| `inventory/OreDictManager.java` | `DictFrame` constants (`U`, `STEEL`, ...; `U` is named `Uraninite` under GT6), `DictGroup` (`ANY_PLASTIC`...), `registerOres()` (fluent registrations, autogen loop L631-654, fragment 9-to-1, `registerCompatShapes`, `compensateMojangSpaghettiBullshit`), `registerGroups()`, `@SubscribeEvent onRegisterOre` (re-registers group aliases, fills `arcSmeltable`). Ingots also registered under the bare material name (NuclearCraft compat; TODO config). |
| `inventory/material/MaterialShapes.java`, `NTMMaterial.java`, `Mats.java`, `MatDistribution.java` | Shapes with quanta (`NUGGET 8`, `INGOT 72`, `BLOCK 648`, `QUART 162`; prefixes incl. `FRAGMENT = bedrockorefragment`, `PIPE = ntmpipe`, `CASTPLATE = plateTriple`, `WELDEDPLATE = plateSextuple`); materials (id = autogen item meta; scheme `_VS` 0-29, `_AS` 30-99, `_ES` 20000+, `_EX` 24000+, elements Z*100+mass); `Mats` constants + `materialEntries`/`materialOreEntries`; crucible smelting JSON (must precede `ArcFurnaceRecipes` in `registerAllHandlers`). |
| `inventory/fluid/Fluids.java`, `FluidType.java`, `trait/FluidTrait.java`, `FluidTraitSimple.java`, `FT_Combustible.java`, `FT_Rocket.java` | Registry (`init()` declaration-order IDs, `//ADD NEW FLUIDS HERE` ~L545, `metaOrder` size check at L887, `hbmFluidTypes.json` custom fluids with explicit ids, `reloadFluids()` preserves instances via `fluidMigration`, `readTraits` rebuilds a fluid's traits reflectively from `hbmFluidTraits.json`); fluid (`hbmfluid.<name>`, `getDict(mB)` = `(enableFluidContainerCompat ? "container" : "ntmcontainer") + mB + name-without-underscores-lowercase`, `getNetworkProvider()`); trait base (`traitNameMap` = JSON keys); tag traits; data trait exemplar; Space rocket trait (no no-arg ctor, so it cannot be instantiated from JSON). |
| `inventory/FluidContainerRegistry.java`, `FluidContainer.java`, `FluidStack.java`, `fluid/tank/FluidTank.java` | Container generation from `CD_*` descriptors/traits (loop from index 1 uses `Fluids.fromID(i)` for disperser/gland, wrong for custom ids), lookups, `clearRegistry()`; POJOs; machine tank with `loadingHandlers`. |
| `main/CraftingManager.java`, `crafting/PowderRecipes.java`, `MineralRecipes.java`, `handlers/ScrapsCraftingHandler.java` | `addRecipeAuto`/`addShapelessAuto` (String ingredient -> ore recipe; shaped detection needs a String after the pattern rows), `IRecipe` handlers + `RecipeSorter`, `ContainerUpgradeCraftingHandler` instantiated per crate in `AddCraftingRec`. |
| `itempool/ItemPool.java`, `ItemPoolsC130.java`, `config/ItemPoolConfigJSON.java` | Named weighted pools (`getStack(name, rand)`, `backupPool` fallback); JSON replaces the whole map, template written only when the live file is absent. |
| `inventory/recipes/PressRecipes.java`, `CentrifugeRecipes.java`, `ShredderRecipes.java`, `ChemicalPlantRecipes.java`, `AssemblyMachineRecipes.java`, `BlastFurnaceRecipesNT.java`, `BlastFurnaceRecipes.java` (@Deprecated, still used by DiFurnace tiles and their NEI handler; file `hbmBlastFurnaceLegacy.json`), `FusionRecipes.java`, `PrecAssRecipes.java`, `CrucibleRecipes.java`, `ArcFurnaceRecipes.java`, `CustomMachineRecipes.java`, `anvil/AnvilRecipes.java`, `AtmosphereRecipes.java`, `CryoRecipes.java`, `MachineRecipes.java` (@Spaghetti), `SILEXRecipes.java` | Classic and generic exemplars; `ShredderRecipes`/`ArcFurnaceRecipes`/`CentrifugeRecipes` generate entries in `registerPost()` that JSON cannot override; anvil smithing is static (not JSON), construction is `hbmAnvil.json`; `AtmosphereRecipes` has no-op read/write. |
| `module/machine/ModuleMachineBase.java`, `handler/nei/NEIGenericRecipeHandler.java`, `util/CompatRecipeRegistry.java`, `api/hbm/recipe/package-info.java`, `packet/toclient/SerializableRecipePacket.java`, `commands/CommandReloadRecipes.java` | Consumer, NEI base, addon API (@Untested), addon guide, server->client sync, `/ntmreload`. |

### Patterns

- Handler order matters only where code reads another set: `MatDistribution` before `ArcFurnaceRecipes`. The `//AFTER Assembler` comment above `AnvilRecipes` is stale (Assembler is added later and Anvil does not reference it). `CrucibleRecipes.getSmeltingRecipes()` is computed lazily for NEI.
- Template format: `{"comment": ..., "recipes": [...]}`; `getRecipeObject()` must be a Collection or HashMap.
- Generic recipe names use a machine prefix (`chem.`, `ass.`, `purex.`, `fus.`, `plsm.`, `precass.`, `blast.`, `crucible.`); the name doubles as lang key with `setNamed`.
- Ore dict: `STEEL.ingot()` getter = `MaterialShapes.INGOT.name() + "Steel"`; setters `STEEL.ingot(items...)` register and apply hazards; `.rad()/.hot()/...` must be chained BEFORE the shape setters (hazards snapshot at registration; shape order among themselves does not matter). `DictGroup.addPrefix` + `onRegisterOre` re-register under `AnyX` names; `registerGroups` must precede `registerOres`.
- Autogen: `NTMMaterial.setAutogen(shapes)` only produces items/ore-dict entries for `ItemAutogen` shapes (BOLT, INGOT->ingot_raw, SHELL, PIPE, FRAGMENT, WIRE, barrels/receivers/mechanism/stock/grip, CASTPLATE/WELDEDPLATE/DENSEWIRE when SMELTABLE); DUST/PLATE/BLOCK/NUGGET/BILLET in `setAutogen` are inert. Crucible/arc smelting autogen iterate all non-`noAutogen` prefixes present in the ore dict regardless of `setAutogen` (crucible: SMELTABLE or ADDITIVE; arc: SMELTABLE).
- Fluids: `new FluidType(name, color, p, f, r, EnumSymbol)` registers itself with id = current size; custom/foreign fluids use `Fluids.register(fluid, id)` (overwrites blindly). Trait queries `type.hasTrait(FT_X.class)`/`getTrait`.
- Fluid traits (`inventory/fluid/trait/`): data traits `FT_Combustible(FuelGrade, energyPerBucket)` (combustion engine, diesel, turbofan, gas turbine...), `FT_Flammable` (oil burners, wood burner, drains/tanks catching fire), `FT_Corrosive` (rating -> `FluidTank`/tank-block and atmosphere corrosion), `FT_Heatable`/`FT_Coolable` (heat exchanger, boiler and turbine tables: heat boiler, fusion boiler, PWR, Watz, steam engine, turbines), `FT_Polluting` (release type -> `PollutionHandler`: emitters, blast furnace, engines), `FT_VentRadiation`/`FT_Poison`/`FT_Toxin`/`FT_Pheromone`/`FT_Terraformer` (`EntityChemical`/`EntityMist` cloud effects), `FT_Rocket` (Space: thrust/isp for HTR3/HTRF4, xenon thruster, stations), `FT_PWRModerator`; tag traits in `FluidTraitSimple`: `FT_Gaseous` (celestial atmospheres, compressors, emitters), `FT_Liquid`, `FT_Viscous`, `FT_Plasma`, `FT_Amat`, `FT_Leaded`, `FT_LeadContainer`, `FT_Delicious`, `FT_EXPLOSIVE`, `FT_ULTRAKILL`, `FT_Unsiphonable`, `FT_NoID`, `FT_NoContainer`. Query with `type.hasTrait(FT_X.class)`/`getTrait`.
- Containers: `.addContainers(new CD_Canister(colour), new CD_Gastank(colour))` on the `FluidType` (both inner classes of `Fluids`); `FluidContainerRegistry.register()` (PostLoad L573 and `/ntmreload`) turns them into `FluidContainer` entries for `ModItems.canister_full`/`gas_full` at meta = fluid id (1000 mB, empties `canister_empty`/`gas_empty`), plus `fluid_tank_full` for every fluid and `disperser_canister` by id loop; the items take icon and name from the fluid (`hbmfluid.<name>`).
- Config flags read by recipe defaults: `GeneralConfig.enable528`, `enable528PressurizedRecipes`, `enableExpensiveMode` (`trueExp()` = expensive && `!PrecAssRecipes.INSTANCE.modified`), `enableLBSM*`, `enableServerRecipeSync`.
- Addon contract: `IRecipeRegisterListener.onRecipeLoad` fires only in the defaults branch; `IFluidRegisterListener` fires in `init` and `reloadFluids`.

### How-to

- Generic recipe / classic recipe / new GenericRecipes set (`INSTANCE`, `*Limit()`, `getFileName` `hbmMyMachine.json`, `instantiateRecipe`, `registerDefaults`; add to `registerAllHandlers()` `//GENERIC` block after any set it reads; `NEIGenericRecipeHandler` subclass + `NEIRegistry.listAllHandlers()`; consume via `ModuleMachineBase.getRecipeSet()` or `recipeNameMap`) / new classic set (`getRecipeObject`, `deleteRecipes`, `readRecipe`, `writeRecipe`, `getComment`, `registerPost`, `allowEmptyRecipeList`): exemplars `ChemicalPlantRecipes.java`, `PressRecipes.java`, `BlastFurnaceRecipesNT.java` (plain set with power 0; it does NOT override `hasPower()`; a JSON entry missing `power`/`duration` NPEs unless you override `hasPower`/`hasDuration`), `CryoRecipes.java`.
- New fluid: field in `inventory/fluid/Fluids.java`; define at the END of `init()` directly above `//ADD NEW FLUIDS HERE` (~L545; ID = declaration index, persisted in saves) as `X = new FluidType("X", 0xRRGGBB, p, f, r, EnumSymbol.NONE).addTraits(LIQUID, new FT_Combustible(FuelGrade.MEDIUM, 200_000L), ...).addContainers(new CD_Canister(0xRRGGBB), new CD_Gastank(...))`; `metaOrder.add(X);` (a missing entry crashes `Fluids.init` with "MetaOrder and Mappings are inconsistent", checked at ~L887); texture `textures/gui/fluids/<lowercase>.png`; lang `hbmfluid.<lowercase>`; crafting-table references use `Fluids.X.getDict(1000)`. New trait: public no-arg ctor + `registerTrait("name", Class)` in `FluidTrait`'s static block (that name is the `hbmFluidTraits.json` key). Exemplars `Fluids.java`, `trait/FT_Combustible.java`.
- New material: `DictFrame` constant; `Mats.MAT_X = makeSmeltable(uniqueId, FRAME, light, dark, molten).setAutogen(...).m()`; `registerOres()` line for hand-made items; `CrucibleRecipes`/`MatDistribution` entries for alloys; lang `hbmmat.x`; `ItemAutogen.aot` texture override if needed. Exemplar `Mats.java`.
- Ore-dict group: `new DictGroup("AnyX", FRAME_A, FRAME_B)` + `addPrefix(INGOT, true)` in `registerGroups()`.
- Crafting recipe: `CraftingManager.addRecipeAuto(new ItemStack(out, n), new Object[]{"ABC", ..., 'A', STEEL.plate(), 'D', Fluids.WATER.getDict(1000)})`; `MineralRecipes.add1To9Pair`; smelting in `crafting/SmeltingRecipes.java` (no ore dict); custom `IRecipe` + `RecipeSorter.register("hbm:name", ...)`.
- Loot pool: `new ItemPool(POOL_X) {{ this.pool = new WeightedRandomChestContent[]{ weighted(item, meta, min, max, weight) }; }}` in an `ItemPools*.init()`; consume with `ItemPool.getStack`.
- Fluid container item: `FluidContainerRegistry.registerContainer(new FluidContainer(full, emptyOrNull, Fluids.X, mB))` before the `getAll()` loop.
- Anvil: construction `constructionRecipes.add(new AnvilConstructionRecipe(inputs, outputs).setTier(n))`; smithing `smithingRecipes.add(new AnvilSmithingRecipe(tier, out, left, right))` (static, PostLoad).
- Fork-only recipe: add it to `com/hbm/dbs/DBSRecipes.java`, an `IRecipeRegisterListener` registered by `DBSFork.init()`; `onRecipeLoad(className)` dispatches on the set's simple class name (`AssemblyMachineRecipes` -> `registerAssembly(AssemblyMachineRecipes.INSTANCE)`, `AnvilRecipes` -> `registerAnvilConstruction()`); for another set add a branch and a method. The listener fires inside `SerializableRecipe.initialize()` after `registerDefaults()` and before the template is written, only on the no-JSON path, so semantics equal an inline default and the recipe lands at the end of the set's list. No hook in any recipe class. `tools/check-fork.sh` checks the wiring and the class names after merges.

### Gotchas

- Everything registered outside `initialize()` is wiped by `deleteRecipes()` on init, `/ntmreload` and server sync; addons must use the listener.
- `GenericRecipes.register` appends to `recipeOrderedList` BEFORE the duplicate check; `writeTemplateFile` swallows exceptions (truncated templates possible).
- `Fluids.readTraits` clears a fluid's traits first, then instantiates each listed trait; `FT_Rocket` fails (`InstantiationException` printed, trait lost). Foreign (`CompatFluidRegistry`) fluids are absent from `metaOrder` during trait read/write.
- `ComparableStack`-keyed HashMap lookups cannot find WILDCARD entries; use `makeSingular()` and retry with WILDCARD (`ShredderRecipes.getShredderResult`) or normalise to 0 (`ArcFurnaceRecipes.register`, which silently drops inputs already in `occupiedSolid/Liquid`).
- `RadiolysisRecipes.registerRadiolysis` throws if `CrackingRecipes` is empty.
- `CustomMachineConfigJSON.initialize()` runs before `SerializableRecipe.initialize()` in PostLoad; `registerAllHandlers()` is not idempotent.
- `SILEXRecipes` registers `ingot_cm_mix` twice; `ItemPoolsSingle` registers `POOL_BLUEPRINTS` twice; `MachineRecipes.java:19` TODO/@Spaghetti; `CrucibleRecipes.java:220` TODO buffer lookups; `SerializableRecipe.java:194` stale "currently unused" javadoc on `deleteRecipes`.

## 11. Containers, GUIs, NEI

### Purpose

`inventory/container/` (187 files), `inventory/gui/` (234 files incl. `element/`), `handler/nei/` (80 files), plus `NEIRegistry`, `NEIConfig`, `GUIHandler`. There is no GUI-ID table: one `IGuiHandler` (`GUIHandler`) resolves an `IGUIProvider` from the TE, then Block (13 blocks implement it directly), then held Item, then Entity with id == x; the int ID is passed through unchanged (0 by convention). NEI is a list of `TemplateRecipeHandler`s built once in `NEIRegistry.listAllHandlers()` and registered by `NEIConfig.loadConfig()` (found by NEI's classpath scan for `NEI*Config` implementing `IConfigureNEI`; the class name is load-bearing), plus a GTNH-NEI IMC path (`IMCHandlerNHNEI`).

### Key files

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `inventory/container/ContainerBase.java` | Preferred container base (29 direct subclasses incl. `ContainerCrateBase` + 8 crate containers): `public IInventory tile`, `canInteractWith` via `tile.isUseableByPlayer`, generic `transferStackInSlot` splitting at `tile.getSizeInventory()` (tile slots must be added first and completely), `playerInv`, `addSlots`, `addOutputSlots`, `addTakeOnlySlots`, `mergeItemStack` respecting slot limits. |
| `container/ContainerNT.java`, `ICustomPayloadReceiver.java` | Dead alternative base (0 subclasses); `acceptData(Side, windowId, nbt)` for `ContainerNBTCommsPacket` (only `ContainerPneumoStorageAccess`). |
| `container/ContainerMachineArcWelder.java`, `ContainerMachineReactorBreeding.java`, `ContainerMachineChemicalPlant.java` | Raw-Container exemplar (147 concrete raw containers; `index <= 7` for 8 slots is correctly bounded), minimal raw exemplar (has an off-by-one: `index <= 2` for 2 tile slots), ContainerBase-style exemplar mixing `ContainerBase.mergeItemStack` and `InventoryUtil.mergeItemStack`. |
| `inventory/gui/GuiInfoContainer.java`, `GuiInfoContainerLayered.java`, `element/GUIElements.java` | Preferred GUI base (153 direct + 11 via `GUITurretBase` + 2 layered): `drawElectricityInfo`, `drawCustomInfoStat`, `drawInfoPanel` (types 0-11 from `gui_utility.png`), `getUpgradeInfo`, `checkClick`/`clickSendFlag` (`NBTControlPacket`), scissor helpers, NEI drag-and-drop into `SlotPattern` (requires the container to be a `ContainerBase`); layered GUIs (`SlotLayer` + `GuiLayerPacket`); hover text/gauge helpers. |
| `gui/GUIMachineReactorBreeding.java`, `GUIMachineArcWelder.java`, `GUIScreenRecipeSelector.java` | Minimal GUI (`public static ResourceLocation texture` for NEI), rich GUI (`FluidTank.renderTank`/`renderTankInfo`), recipe picker for GenericRecipes machines. |
| `inventory/SlotNonRetarded.java`, `SlotCraftingOutput.java`, `SlotTakeOnly.java`, `SlotUpgrade.java`, `SlotPattern.java`, `SlotLayer.java` | Slot types. |
| `main/NEIRegistry.java`, `NEIConfig.java` | Ordered handlers (`BreederRecipeHandler` at L36; `OreSlopperHandler` before acidizing; `FluidRecipeHandler` last; `RTGRecipeHandler` if `VersatileConfig.rtgDecay()`); plugin (`registerHandler`, `AnvilOverlayHandler`, `CustomMachineHandler` per JSON machine via `registerHandlerBypass`, `API.hideItem`, `registerHighlightIdentifier` for plushies). |
| `handler/nei/NEIUniversalHandler.java`, `NEIGenericRecipeHandler.java`, `NEICelestialHandler.java`, `BreederRecipeHandler.java`, `FusionBreederHandler.java`, `BlastFurnaceHandler.java`, `CustomMachineHandler.java`, `AnvilOverlayHandler.java`, `AlloyFurnaceRecipeHandler.java` | Universal base (48 direct subclasses; all but `GrenadeRecipeHandler` pass HashMaps to the @Deprecated ctors, so ordering is non-deterministic; `InventoryUtil.extractObject` accepts ItemStack/ItemStack[]/[][]/AStack/AStack[]/Object[], no FluidStack), generic base (6), celestial variant (4; only item-usage lookup is a no-op), hand-rolled exemplar (fork-added; compares literal `"breeding"` in five places), smallest universal/generic exemplars, JSON-machine handler (no `ICompatNHNEI`, `gui_nei_custom.png`), anvil overlay, unregistered dead handler. |
| `handler/imc/ICompatNHNEI.java`, `IMCHandlerNHNEI.java` | GTNH NEI catalysts (hard-coded 166x65, 3 per page). |
| `packet/toserver/NBTControlPacket.java`, `interfaces/IControlReceiver.java`, `tileentity/IControlReceiverFilter.java` (also extends `ICopiable`; needs `nextMode`/`getFilterSlots`), `packet/GuiLayerPacket.java`, `packet/toclient/ContainerNBTCommsPacket.java` | Control plumbing. |

### Patterns

- Container/GUI naming `ContainerX`/`GUIX` (older `Gui*`); ctor `(InventoryPlayer, TileEntityX)`; GUI `super(new ContainerX(invPlayer, tile))`, `xSize`/`ySize`; textures `RefStrings.MODID + ":textures/gui/<category>/gui_<name>.png"` (`public static` when NEI needs it).
- Draw lifecycle: `drawScreen` -> super, tooltips (`renderTankInfo`, `drawElectricityInfo`, `drawCustomInfoStat`); `drawGuiContainerForegroundLayer` name (`0x404040`) + `container.inventory` at `ySize - 96 + 2`; `drawGuiContainerBackgroundLayer` glColor, bindTexture, background, bars, `drawInfoPanel`, `renderTank(guiLeft + x, guiTop + bottomY, zLevel, w, h)` (y = bottom edge; `renderTankInfo` y = top).
- Slot layout: tile slots 0..n-1, then 27 main, then 9 hotbar (`playerInv(invPlayer, 8, y)`, hotbar at y+58).
- GUIs read TE fields directly; those arrive via the TE's `networkPackNT`/`serialize`/`deserialize`, not the Container (only 6 containers override `detectAndSendChanges`; 9 files reference it). A new GUI needs the TE to serialize every field it draws.
- `drawInfoPanel(x, y, w, h, type)` draws an icon from `gui_utility.png`: 0/1 small (8x8) blue/green "i", 2/3 large (16x16) blue/green "i", 4/5 small red/yellow "!", 6/7 large red/yellow "!", 8/9 small blue/grey "*", 10/11 large blue/grey "*" (2, 8, 3 and 6 are the common ones); pair it with `drawCustomInfoStat` hover text on the same rect. NEI layout (`NEIUniversalHandler`/`NEIGenericRecipeHandler`): `PositionedStack` coordinates are relative to the 166x65 recipe area; machine icon at (75, 31) (with a template: template (75, 10), machine (75, 38)); 18x18 slot frames come from texture (5, 87) drawn at `pos - 1`; the arrow from (59, 87) is drawn at (74, 14); input/output positions are the `inPos`/`outPos` arrays the subclass passes.
- Non-zero GUI IDs: `TileEntityMachineRadarNT` (0 GuiScreen, 1 container GUI), `TileEntityElectrolyser` (-1 last, 0 fluid, 1 metal), `PneumoTube` (1, consumed only by `provideGUI` as a boolean), `BlockMachineBase.guiID`, and `MachineMilkReformer`/`MachineVacuumDistill`/`MachineAnnihilator`/`BlockPAQuadrupole` pass the clicked face.
- NEI hand-rolled shape: inner `CachedRecipe`, four `load*` overloads guarded by `outputId.equals(getRecipeID()) && getClass() == X.class`, `getGuiTexture()` = GUI's `texture.toString()`, `getGuiClass()`, `loadTransferRects()`, `drawExtras`.

### How-to

- Container + GUI for a machine: `ContainerMachineFoo extends ContainerBase` (tile slots in index order, then `playerInv`; override `transferStackInSlot` as `ContainerMachineChemicalPlant` if routing differs); `GUIMachineFoo extends GuiInfoContainer` with the lifecycle above; TE `IGUIProvider` (+ `IControlReceiver` for buttons); block opens with ID 0. Screen-only GUI: `provideContainer` returns null, `provideGUI` a `GuiScreen`. Exemplar `GUIMachineArcWelder.java`.
- Hand-rolled NEI handler: `extends TemplateRecipeHandler implements ICompatNHNEI`; use `getRecipeID()` consistently; `handlers.add(new FooRecipeHandler())` in `NEIRegistry.listAllHandlers()` before `FluidRecipeHandler`. Exemplar `BreederRecipeHandler.java`.
- Universal handler: `super(ModBlocks.foo.getLocalizedName(), ModBlocks.foo, FooRecipes.getRecipes())` + `getKey()` (ids conventionally `ntmFoo`); prefer the `List<Pair<Object,Object>>` ctor. Exemplar `FusionBreederHandler.java`.
- Generic handler: `super(name, FooRecipesNT.INSTANCE, ModBlocks.foo)` + `getRecipeID()`. Exemplar `BlastFurnaceHandler.java`.
- GUI button: `mouseClicked` -> `checkClick(x, y, left, top, w, h)` -> `NBTControlPacket`, or `clickSendFlag(tile, x, y, left, top, w, h, "toggle")`.

### Gotchas

- GTNH-NEI init-order hazard: `MainRegistry.load` (L543-547) calls `proxy.handleNHNEICompat()` -> `IMCHandlerNHNEI.IMCSender()` -> `NEIRegistry.listAllHandlers()`, constructing every handler and copying HashMap-backed recipe maps BEFORE `SerializableRecipe.initialize()` (PostLoad); the memoised list is never rebuilt (traced statically).
- NEI drag-and-drop silently does nothing for raw containers with `SlotPattern` (`ContainerMachineCustom`, `ContainerCartDestroyer`).
- NEI allows one handler per class; extra instances need `registerHandlerBypass` and `newInstance()` (as `CustomMachineHandler`).
- `ContainerOrbitalStationComputer`/`ContainerRadiobox` do not override `transferStackInSlot` but have no slots (safe until slots are added).
- `GUIMachineReactorBreeding` comments on "dud" TEs after block-state swaps (client GUI keeps an invalidated TE).
- NEI is a hard compile dependency (`build.gradle` `implementation`), tolerated at runtime through `@Optional` in `GuiInfoContainer`.
- Smells: `ContainerMachineCustom.java:77` TODO Mojang; `GUIMachineDiFurnaceRTG.java:36` and `PressRecipeHandler.java:29` @Untested; `GUIPneumoStorageAccess.java:97` and `GUIScreenRadioTorchLogic.java:99` TODO localization; `VacuumCircuitHandler`/`SolderingStationHandler:42` TODO output-only matching; `OilExtractionHandler:38,79` hard-coded; hard-coded English in several GUIs/handlers.

## 12. Entities, mobs, explosions

### Purpose

`com/hbm/entity/` (top-level, mob/, effect/, item/, logic/, cart/, train/, particle/, pathfinder/) and `com/hbm/explosion/`. Registration in `EntityMappings.writeMappings()` via `ModEntityList`; renderers in `ClientProxy`. Explosions: deprecated vanilla-subclass `ExplosionNT` (+ `ExplosionNukeSmall` mini-nukes), the composable `ExplosionVNT` pipeline (`vanillant/`), and progressive nuke drivers (`EntityNukeExplosionMK5` + `IExplosionRay`, `EntityNukeExplosionMK3` + spiral column algorithms, `EntityBalefire`, `EntityTomBlast`) that end with `EntityFalloutRain`. Space adds celestial fauna, `CBT_Invasion` siege waves and atmosphere-aware `EntityNukeTorex`.

### Key files

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `entity/EntityMappings.java`, `ModEntityList.java` | `addEntity(class, name, trackingRange[, velocityUpdates])`, `addMob(class, name, egg1, egg2)`; sequential ids by list order (not persisted; saves use `hbm.<name>` from FML); `addSpawn` skips `BiomeGenBaseCelestial`/Mushroom and always appends a duplicate entry after adjusting an existing one; spawn eggs from id 500 up; `getName`/`getEggFromEntity`/`getDatasWithEggs` dead. |
| `entity/logic/IChunkLoader.java`, `EntityExplosionChunkloading.java`, `EntityNukeExplosionMK5.java`, `EntityNukeExplosionMK3.java`, `EntityBalefire.java`, `EntityTomBlast.java`, `EntityPlaneBase.java`, `EntityBomber.java`, `EntityEMP.java`, `EntityWaypoint.java` | Chunk-loading contract (`MainRegistry` LoadingCallback re-`init()`s ENTITY tickets, but returns after the first NORMAL ticket); base forcing one chunk (`loadChunk` is a one-shot; `clearChunkLoader()` before `setDead()`); MK5 driver (`statFac` doubles `r`, persists only `ticksExisted` so it dies on reload; always `ExplosionNukeRayBatched`; `radiate()` ticks 1-9; no renderer registered for any explosion driver); MK3 (@Spaghetti, full NBT persistence); balefire/Tom drivers; planes (rolling chunk window); EMP; glyphid waypoint (rendered by `RenderMist` for debug). |
| `entity/effect/EntityFalloutRain.java`, `EntityNukeTorex.java`, `EntityMist.java`, `EntityFireLingering.java`, `EntityCloudFleija.java`, `EntityBlackHole.java`, `EntityDepress.java` | Fallout (ring scan, time-sliced `stomp`, `FalloutConfigJSON.entries`, crater biomes), client mushroom cloud (factories spawn internally and return void), gas cloud (DataWatcher 10-12), non-persistent fire, timed visual template (maxAge in DataWatcher 16), black hole, Space depressurisation pusher. |
| `entity/mob/siege/SiegeTier.java`, `EntitySiegeCraft.java`, `EntitySiegeUFO.java`, `EntitySiegeTunneler.java`; `mob/EntityUFOBase.java`, `EntityUFO.java`, `EntityMaskMan.java`, `EntityCreeperNuclear.java`, `EntityBurrowingBase.java`, `EntityFish.java`, `EntityDummy.java` | Tier registry (`tiers[100]`, id = registration order, persisted as `siegeTier`); siege UFOs (tier in DataWatcher 12); tunneler (renderer registered but NOT in `EntityMappings`); flying hostile base (DataWatcher 17-19 waypoint; subclasses call super then `approachPosition`); bosses; nuclear creeper (`EntityNukeExplosionMK5.statFac` or `ExplosionNukeSmall.explode(PARAMS_*)`). |
| `mob/glyphid/EntityGlyphid.java`, `GlyphidStats.java`, `EntityGlyphidScout.java`, `EntityGlyphidNuclear.java`, `blocks/generic/BlockGlyphidSpawner.java` | Glyphid base (DataWatcher `DW_WALL=16`, `DW_ARMOR=17`, `DW_SUBTYPE=18`; `TASK_*` system with `EntityWaypoint`; `IResistanceProvider.getCurrentDTDR(DamageSource, amount, pierceDT, pierce)`; digging via `ExplosionVNT` + `BlockAllocatorGlyphidDig`), stats (`GLYPHID_STATS_NT` active, marked UNTESTED), scout hive expansion, exemplar subclass (uses `RenderGlyphidNuclear`, instantiates deprecated `EntityProcessorStandard`), spawner (`spawnMap` of `Pair<Function<World, EntityGlyphid>, int[]{base, sootScale, sootThreshold}>`). |
| `mob/botprime/EntityWormBaseNT.java`, `EntityBOTPrimeHead.java`, `mob/ai/EntityAINearestAttackableTargetNT.java`, `EntityAIFireGun.java`, `EntityAIBreaking.java`, `pathfinder/PathFinderUtils.java` | Worm boss (74 body parts), AI helpers, partial path finding. |
| `entity/item/EntityTNTPrimedBase.java`, `EntityFallingBlockNT.java`, `EntityDroneBase.java`, `EntityMovingConveyorObject.java`, `EntityMinecartModBase.java` (legacy, test only) | Primed bomb (block id DataWatcher 12 -> `IFuckingExplode`), falling block (DataWatcher 10/11), drones, conveyor items. |
| `entity/cart/EntityMinecartNTM.java`, `EntityMinecartContainerBase.java`, `EntityMinecartCrate.java`, `items/tool/ItemModMinecart.java` | Cart base (`EnumCartBase` in DataWatcher 23), inventory cart, exemplar (`IGUIProvider` with entityId as x; ctor takes an ItemStack; `getCartItem` hardcodes `EnumCartBase.VANILLA`), factory switch (~L242; `EnumMinecart` bitmask of allowed bases). |
| `entity/train/EntityRailCarBase.java`, `EntityRailCarRidable.java`, `EntityRailCarElectric.java`, `TrainCargoTram.java`, `items/special/ItemTrain.java`, `blocks/rail/IRailNTM.java` | Trains: global `updateMotion(world)` from `ModEventHandler` world tick, `LogicalTrainUnit`, yaw/pitch smuggled through `motionX/motionY` with `velocityChanged` (works despite `velocityUpdates = false` because `EntityTrackerEntry` sends on `velocityChanged`), dummy/seat entities, coupling tool. |
| `entity/particle/EntityModFX.java` | Entity-based particles (Fog/Cloud/Chlorine/PinkCloud/Orange FX). |
| `explosion/vanillant/ExplosionVNT.java`, `interfaces/IBlockAllocator.java` (+ `IBlockProcessor`, `IEntityProcessor`, `IPlayerProcessor`, `IExplosionSFX`, `IBlockMutator`, ...), `standard/BlockAllocatorStandard.java`, `BlockProcessorStandard.java`, `EntityProcessorCross.java`, `PlayerProcessorStandard.java`, `ExplosionEffectStandard.java`, `BlockAllocatorGlyphidDig.java`, `BlockMutatorDebris.java` | Composable explosion: block phase runs only when BOTH allocator and block processor are set, entity phase only when BOTH entity and player processors are set; `makeStandard()`/`makeAmat()` presets still use the deprecated `EntityProcessorStandard`; `EntityProcessorCross` excludes MK4 bullets and universal grenades from knockback. |
| `explosion/ExplosionNT.java` (@Deprecated, `ExAttrib` flags), `ExplosionLarge.java`, `ExplosionNukeGeneric.java` (@Spaghetti; `dealDamage`, `isExplosionExempt`), `ExplosionNukeSmall.java` (@Deprecated `MukeParams`), `ExplosionNukeRayBatched.java`, `ExplosionNukeRayParallelized.java` (dead), `ExplosionNukeRayBalefire.java` (never instantiated), `ExplosionNukeAdvanced.java`, `ExplosionFleija.java`, `ExplosionThermo.java`, `ExplosionChaos.java` (TODO destroy), `NukeEnvironmentalEffect.java`, `ExplosionHurtUtil.java`, `interfaces/IExplosionRay.java`, `config/BombConfig.java` | Batched ray: rays limited to `min(ceil(strength), this.length + 1)` steps with the resistance exponent computed against `strength`; `cacheChunksTick` ignores its time budget; `BombConfig.chunkloading` is inert on the active path. |
| `dim/trait/CBT_Invasion.java`, `handler/BossSpawnHandler.java`, `blocks/bomb/BlockCrashedBomb.java` | Siege waves, mask man rolls, hand-composed VNT exemplar. |

### Patterns

- Registration: append `addEntity`/`addMob` at the end of the respective block; lang `entity.hbm.<name>.name` (prefix from FML `registerModEntity`); renderer via `RenderingRegistry.registerEntityRenderingHandler` in `ClientProxy` (`RenderEmpty` for invisible; explosion drivers have none).
- DataWatcher slots: non-living from 10; siege 12-16; UFO base 17-19; glyphids 16-18; timed clouds 16; carts 23; rail dummies 3-5.
- Progressive explosion drivers: `EntityExplosionChunkloading` subclass owning an algorithm with `boolean update()` and `saveToNbt/readFromNbt(nbt, prefix)`; `onUpdate` calls `update()` `speed` times; `statFac*` factories return the entity for the caller to spawn (except `EntityNukeTorex`).
- Client FX: `PacketThreading.createAllAroundThreadedPacket(new AuxParticlePacketNT(nbt, x, y, z), TargetPoint)` with `nbt.type` (`muke`, `tinytot`, `plasmablast`, `tau`, `giblets`, `vanillaburst`, `tower`, `depress`), or `MainRegistry.proxy.effectNT(nbt)` on the client; shaped visuals via `ExplosionCreator.composeEffect*`.
- Boss convention: `IBossDisplayData`, `IRadiationImmune`/`ISuffocationImmune`, `canDespawn() false`, achievements on death.
- Tunables: `config/MobConfig` (`enableMaskman`/`maskmanDelay`/`maskmanMinRad`/`maskmanUnderground`, `enableRaids`/`raid*`, `enableElementals`/`elemental*`, `enableDucks`, `enableMobGear`/`enableMobWeapons`/`mobWeaponSootReduction`, `enableMunCows`, hives: `enableHives`, `hiveSpawn`, `scoutThreshold`, `scoutSwarmSpawnChance`, `largeHiveChance`/`largeHiveThreshold`, `swarmCooldown`, `baseSwarmSize`, `swarmScalingMult`, `sootStep`, `spawnMax`, `enableInfestation`/`baseInfestChance`, `targetingThreshold`, `rampant*`, `waypointDebug`), `config/BombConfig` (per-nuke radii `gadgetRadius`..`aSchrabRadius`, `mk5`, `blastSpeed`, `falloutRange`, `fDelay`, `limitExplosionLifespan`, `chunkloading` (inert on the batched ray), `explosionAlgorithm`), `GlyphidStats.GLYPHID_STATS_NT`/`GLYPHID_STATS_70K` (`StatBundle` per variant, `getStats()` picks the active set). `EntityBulletBaseMK4` ctors: `(world, shooter, config, damage, spread, x, y, z, mx, my, mz)`, `(shooter, config, baseDamage, spread, sideOffset, heightOffset, frontOffset)` (from the shooter's eyes; what guns and turrets use), `(world, config, baseDamage, spread, yaw, pitch)`. `RocketStruct.RocketStage.zipWatchable()` packs one stage into a `Pair<Integer, Integer>` for the DataWatcher (ids are bounded by that packing; `unzipWatchable` reverses it).

### How-to

- Hostile mob: `EntityMob` (or `EntityUFOBase`/`EntityGlyphid`/`EntityFish`) with tasks, `applyEntityAttributes`, drops, NBT; `addMob(...)` at the end; optional `addSpawn` or a `SpawnListEntry` in a celestial biome ctor; lang; `Render*` + `ClientProxy`. Exemplar `mob/EntityMaskMan.java`.
- Glyphid variant: subclass with `getSkin`/`getScale`/`applyEntityAttributes`/`getStats`; `StatBundle` field + accessor in BOTH `GlyphidStats70K` and `GlyphidStatsNT`; `addMob`; `RenderGlyphid` (or own); `MobConfig` chance triple + `spawnMap.add(new Pair<>(EntityGlyphidX::new, MobConfig.xChance))` in `BlockGlyphidSpawner`. Exemplar `EntityGlyphidNuclear.java`.
- Siege tier: append `new SiegeTier(health, "name").addDrop(...).setDR().setDT()...` at the END of `registerTiers()`; texture `coin_siege_name.png`; add to `CBT_Invasion.spawnAttempt` rolls.
- Effect/logic entity: extend `Entity`, DataWatcher ids >= 10, `onUpdate` with `isRemote` guards, NBT (or non-persistent via `writeToNBTOptional() false`), fullbright `getBrightnessForRender() 15728880`; `addEntity(class, name, range[, false])`; renderer optional. Exemplar `effect/EntityEMPBlast.java`.
- Chunk-loading explosion: extend `EntityExplosionChunkloading`; algorithm class with `update()`/`saveToNbt`; `loadChunk` on server; `clearChunkLoader()` then `setDead()`; persist state; `statFacX` factory. Exemplar `logic/EntityBalefire.java`.
- Conventional explosion: `new ExplosionVNT(world, x, y, z, size, exploder)` then `setBlockAllocator(new BlockAllocatorStandard(res))`, `setBlockProcessor(new BlockProcessorStandard().setNoDrop().withBlockEffect(...))`, `setEntityProcessor(new EntityProcessorCross(nodeDist).withRangeMod(1.5F))`, `setPlayerProcessor(new PlayerProcessorStandard())`, `setSFX(new ExplosionEffectStandard())`, `explode()`. Exemplar `blocks/bomb/BlockCrashedBomb.java`.
- Nuclear explosion: `world.spawnEntityInWorld(EntityNukeExplosionMK5.statFac(world, radius, x, y, z))` (+ `statFacNoRad`, `statFacSalted`, `.moreFallout(n)`); cloud `EntityNukeTorex.statFac(world, x, y, z, radius, 0)`; mini-nuke `ExplosionNukeSmall.explode(world, x, y, z, PARAMS_MEDIUM)`; antischrabidium `EntityNukeExplosionMK3.statFacFleija`; balefire `new EntityBalefire(world)`. Exemplar `mob/EntityCreeperNuclear.java`.
- Minecart: `EntityMinecartNTM` subclass (ctor `(World, x, y, z, EnumCartBase[, ItemStack])`); `EnumMinecart` constant in `items/tool/ItemModMinecart` plus a `case` in its factory `switch` (~L241); `EntityMappings.addEntity(..., 250, false)`; renderer in `ClientProxy`; `IGUIProvider` with the entity id as x if it has a GUI. Exemplar `cart/EntityMinecartSemtex.java`.
- Train car: extend `EntityRailCarBase` (or `EntityRailCarRidable`/`EntityRailCarElectric`), implement the abstract getters `getCurrentSpeed`, `getMaxRailSpeed`, `getGauge`, `getLengthSpan`, `getCollisionSpan` (plus the span/seat/render overrides `TrainCargoTram` shows); add an `ItemTrain.EnumTrainType` entry naming the entity class (drives the spawn item and its stats tooltip); `EntityMappings.addEntity(..., 250, false)` (trains sync yaw/pitch through `motionX/Y` with `velocityChanged`); renderer in `ClientProxy`; lang `entity.hbm.<name>.name`. Exemplar `train/TrainCargoTram.java` (+ `TrainCargoTramTrailer`).
- AI task: `EntityAIBase` subclass in `mob/ai/` (`shouldExecute`/`startExecuting`/`updateTask`), added in the mob ctor via `tasks.addTask(priority, ...)`/`targetTasks`; `EntityAIFireGun` drives held sedna guns with a null-inventory `LambdaContext`. Exemplar `mob/ai/EntityAIFireGun.java`.

### Gotchas

- `EntityMappings` registers `EntityCloudFleijaRainbow` and `EntityCloudSolinium` under the same name `entity_cloud_rainbow`; FML's string mapping is overwritten, so a saved Rainbow cloud reloads as Solinium.
- Siege tier ids and `SolarSystem.Body` ordinals are persisted; entity numeric ids are not.
- `ExplosionNT`, `ExplosionNukeSmall`, `ExplosionLarge.explode*` are @Deprecated but live. `EntityProcessorStandard` is instantiated by `makeStandard`/`makeAmat`/`EntityGlyphidNuclear`.
- `EntityFireLingering`, `BoundingBoxDummyEntity`, `SeatDummyEntity` are non-persistent; `EntityRailCarBase` writes no NBT in the base class.
- `ExplosionNukeGeneric.isExplosionExempt` exempts ocelots, mod projectiles and creative players; `EntityCreeperNuclear` guards `isDead`.
- Other `IChunkLoader`s: `EntityArtilleryShell`, `EntityArtilleryRocket`, `EntityBulletBaseMK4CL`, `CommandDebugChunkLoad`.
- Smells: `EntityBOTPrimeHead.java:29,68` TODOs; `EntityBurrowingBase.java:62` TODO; `ExplosionChaos.java:35`; `ExplosionNukeSmall.java:70` TODO VNT; `ExplosionLarge` double import; `EntityFalloutRain` second ctor ignores `maxAge`; `EntitySiegeTunneler` rant about EntityCreature sync is unverified (no workaround exists in `EntityBurrowingSwingingBase`).

## 13. Hazards, radiation, pollution, neutron, atmosphere, compat, saved data

### Purpose

Item-carried hazards (`hazard/`), per-chunk world radiation (`handler/radiation/` with pluggable backends), regional pollution (`handler/pollution/`), the neutron nodespace (area 6), the Space atmosphere-blob system (`handler/atmosphere/`), glue handlers (hazmat ratings, armor mods, boss spawns, Bobmazon, dispensers, fuel, buckets, multiblock helpers), compat gates (OC in `CompatHandler`, AE2, ForgeMicroblock IMC, deprecated inbound IMC, GTNH-NEI outbound) and `WorldSavedData` classes (`saveddata/`). Radiation reaches entities through `util/ContaminationUtil` and `HbmLivingProps`.

### Key files

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `hazard/HazardSystem.java` (@Untested), `HazardRegistry.java`, `HazardData.java`, `HazardEntry.java`, `type/HazardTypeBase.java`, `type/HazardTypeRadiation.java`, `type/HazardTypeNeutron.java`, `type/HazardTypeCoal.java`, `modifier/HazardModifier.java`, `modifier/HazardModifierRBMKRadiation.java`, `transformer/HazardTransformerBase.java`, `transformer/HazardTransformerRadiationNBT.java`, `transformer/HazardTransformerRadiationContainer.java`, `transformer/HazardTransformerRadiationME.java` | Lookup (`oreMap` -> `itemMap` -> `stackMap` (ComparableStack made singular on lookup; `register(ItemStack)` does NOT `makeSingular`, so register 1-sized stacks); `doesOverride` purges earlier entries; `mutexBits` 0b1 = oredict autogen), isotope constants + shape multipliers (`block = 10F`) + `registerItems()`/`registerTrafos()` (`makeData` helpers are private), type singletons (`RADIATION`, `DIGAMMA`, `HOT`, `BLINDING`, `ASBESTOS`, `COAL`, `HYDROACTIVE`, `EXPLOSIVE`, `AUTISM`, `GLITCH`, `NEUTRON`), NBT-aware modifiers, content-derived transformers (`ntmNeutron` folded into radiation by the NBT transformer AND again by `HazardTypeRadiation.onUpdate`). |
| `handler/radiation/ChunkRadiationManager.java`, `ChunkRadiationHandler.java`, `ChunkRadiationHandlerSimple.java`, `ChunkRadiationHandlerPRISM.java`, `ChunkRadiationHandlerNT.java` (dead), `ChunkRadiationHandler3D.java` (dead, @Untested), `ChunkRadiationHandlerBlank.java` | Manager always registered on both buses; each event checks `RadiationConfig.enableChunkRads`; `proxy` static swapped to PRISM in `RadiationConfig.loadFromConfig`. Simple: per-world `Map<ChunkCoordIntPair, Float>`, NBT `hfr_simple_radiation`, y ignored, `setRadiation` silently drops writes to unloaded chunks, `receiveChunkUnload` removes by `Chunk` (leak). PRISM: 16 SubChunks with resistance arrays, `tZ = cX << 4` bug, force-loads chunks on `setRadiation`. |
| `handler/pollution/PollutionHandler.java` | Static API keyed `ChunkCoordIntPair(x >> 6, z >> 6)` (64-block regions), `hbmpollution.dat` per world (not chunk NBT), 60-tick spread, `decorateMob`, rampant scout spawns; `SOOT/HEAVY_METAL/POISON_PER_SECOND`; `PollutionType.FALLOUT` unused. |
| `handler/atmosphere/ChunkAtmosphereManager.java`, `ChunkAtmosphereHandler.java`, `AtmosphereBlob.java`, `IAtmosphereProvider.java`, `IBlockSealable.java`, `IPlantableBreathing.java` | `proxy.getAtmosphere(world, x, y, z)` = celestial `CBT_Atmosphere` + containing blobs; `canBreathe` (EARTHAIR >= 0.21 or OXYGEN >= 0.09), `hasLiquidPressure` (>= 0.19), `willCorrode`; blob flood fill on a pool thread when `GeneralConfig.enableThreadedAtmospheres`; `isBlockSealed` order: out of world -> open; unloaded chunk -> sealed; air/farmland/fence -> open; `IBlockSealable` -> `isSealed()`; `BlockDummyable` -> open; liquid/non-solid/leaves -> open; else full collision box. `registerAtmosphere` NPEs before the dimension's `WorldEvent.Load`. |
| `handler/CompatHandler.java`, `ae2/AE2CompatHandler.java` (+ `MSUExternalStorageHandler`, `MassStorageMEInventory`, `AFLExternalStorageHandler`, `ArcFurnaceLargeMEInventory`), `microblocks/MicroBlocksCompatHandler.java` (meta 0..14 only), `imc/IMCHandler.java` (@Deprecated) + `IMCBlastFurnace`/`IMCCentrifuge`/`IMCCrystallizer`, `imc/IMCHandlerNHNEI.java`, `imc/ICompatNHNEI.java` | OC compat (area 18), AE2 external storage (`@Optional.Method` only), microblock IMC, inbound IMC buffers, outbound GTNH-NEI IMC (gate in `MainRegistry.load`). |
| `handler/HazmatRegistry.java`, `ArmorModHandler.java`, `BossSpawnHandler.java`, `BobmazonOfferFactory.java` (re-run on every `WorldEvent.Load`), `HTTPHandler.java`, `BlockMigrations.java`, `Identity.java`, `ImpactWorldHandler.java`, `CelestialNukeShockHandler.java`, `DispenserBehaviorHandler.java`, `EntityEffectHandler.java`, `FuelHandler.java`, `BucketHandler.java`, `MultiblockHandler.java` (legacy int[6] `+x,-x,+y,-y,+z,-z`), `MultiblockHandlerXR.java`, `HbmKeybinds.java`, `HbmKeybindsServer.java`, `ThreeInts.java` (broken `compareTo`), `ability/*`, `indexing/AmmoIndex.java` | Glue handlers. `EntityEffectHandler.handleRadiationFX` adds celestial sun radiation (sky light >= 14) and nether floor for all living entities. |
