| `config/RadiationConfig.java`, `util/ContaminationUtil.java`, `util/ArmorRegistry.java`, `util/ArmorUtil.java` | Flags (`disableNeutron` default TRUE; `disableFibrosis` and `smokeStackSootMult` are dead), `contaminate(entity, HazardType, ContaminationType, amount)` (NEUTRON adds 10x to `radEnv` and is skipped when disabled; `RAD_BYPASS`), protection classes, hazard-class registration. |

### Patterns

- Fuel hazard registrars (all `private static` in `HazardRegistry`, so new fuels are registered inside `registerItems()`): `registerRBMKPellet(pellet, base, dep[, linear][, blinding, digamma])`, `registerRBMKRod(rod, base, dep[, blinding | linear])` -> `registerRBMK(rod, base, dep, hot, linear, blinding, digamma)`, `registerBreedingRodRadiation(BreedingRodType, base)`, `registerOtherFuel(fuel[, meta], base, target, blinding)`, `registerPWRFuel(EnumPWRFuel, baseRad)`, `registerRTGPellet(pellet, base, target[, hot[, blinding]])`, `registerOtherWaste(waste, base)`, `registerRadSourceWaste(waste, base)`, `makeData(type[, level[, override]])`. Generic entry: `HazardSystem.register(Object key, HazardData)` where key is an `Item`, `Block`, 1-sized `ItemStack` or ore-dict `String`. Armor: `HazmatRegistry.registerHazmat(item, coefficient)` (piece weights helmet 0.2 / chest 0.4 / legs 0.3 / boots 0.1; `ArmorFSB.setRadResist` feeds the `external` list).
- `handler/EntityEffectHandler.onUpdate` (from `LivingUpdateEvent`) is the per-tick status driver for every living entity: `handleContamination` (radiation/digamma damage from `HbmLivingProps`, with hunger/potion side effects), `handleRadiationFX`/`handleRadiationEffect`, `handleOxy`/`handleCorrosion` (atmosphere via `getAtmosphereCached`), `handleDigamma`, `handleContagion`, `handleLungDisease`, `handleOil`, `handlePollution`, `handleTemperature`, `handleDashing`, `handlePlinking`, `handleFauxLadder`; it pushes `ExtPropPacket` to players every 20 ticks (`ticksExisted % 20`). A new per-entity status effect is a `HbmLivingProps` field plus a branch here.
- Hazard type gating is per type: config kill-switches exist for asbestos, coal, hot, explosive, hydro, blinding (+autism/glitch reuse it), neutron; none for radiation/digamma. `ArmorRegistry.hasProtection` only in the particle/light types; radiation/neutron gate armor inside `ContaminationUtil`.
- Ore-dict hazards: `DictFrame.rad(f)/hot(f)/neutron(f)/...` BEFORE the shape setters; each shape registers with its own multiplier; ingots also under the bare material name.
- Hazard ticks: `ModEventHandler.onPlayerTick` -> `HazardSystem.updatePlayerInventory` (nulls slots whose size hits 0); `LivingUpdateEvent` -> `updateLivingInventory`; world tick -> `updateDroppedItem`; client tooltip -> `addFullTooltip`.
- Radiation emit: `ChunkRadiationManager.proxy.incrementRad(world, x, y, z, amount)` server-side only (do not cache the proxy). `BlockHazard` uses scheduled ticks (`tickRate` 20, reschedules in `updateTick`), not `setTickRandomly`.
- Pollution: `PollutionHandler.incrementPollution(world, x, y, z, PollutionType.SOOT, SOOT_PER_SECOND)`; chimneys (`TileEntityChimneyBase` L102-104) call it per smoke fluid at `fluid / 100F`.
- Atmosphere providers: implement `IAtmosphereProvider` (`getMaxBlobRadius`, `getRootPosition`, `getFluidType`, `getFluidPressure`, `consume`, `produce`, `onBlobCreated`); `registerAtmosphere(this)` once when supplying, `unregisterAtmosphere` on stop/invalidate. Sealable blocks implement `IBlockSealable` and call `updateSealedState` when their state changes (only `TileEntityDoorGeneric` in `com/hbm/tileentity/` does; `MachineFan` never triggers a re-path). Implementers: `BlockDoorGeneric`, `MachineFan`, `BlockAirPump`, `BlockOrbitalStation`, `MachineDiesel`, `MachineBrickFurnace`, `MachineDiFurnace`, `BlockFurnaceSpace`.
- Per-world state as `HashMap<World, ...>` created on `WorldEvent.Load` with `!isRemote` guards (radiation, pollution, neutron); atmosphere/nuke-shock key by dimension id.
- WorldSavedData: `(String)` ctor, `forWorld(world)` = `perWorldStorage.loadData` else `setData` + reload; `markDirty()` after mutation; client sync via `PermaSyncHandler`.
- Compat gating: `Loader.isModLoaded`/`Compat.isModLoaded` in static `init()` from `MainRegistry.PostLoad`; `@Optional` on foreign-API members; `Compat.tryLoadItem(modid, name)` returns null when absent.

### How-to

- Item hazard: `HazardSystem.register(ModItems.x, makeData(RADIATION, pu239 * ingot))` in `HazardRegistry.registerItems()` (outside that class build `new HazardData().addEntry(type, level[, override])`); depletion-scaled: `new HazardEntry(RADIATION, base).addMod(new HazardModifierFuelRadiation(target))`.
- New hazard type: `type/HazardTypeX extends HazardTypeBase` (`onUpdate` with a `RadiationConfig` flag and optional `ArmorRegistry.hasProtection(target, 3, HazardClass.X)`, `updateEntity`, `addHazardInformation` with `trait.x`); singleton in `HazardRegistry`; optional `DictFrame` helper. Exemplar `HazardTypeCoal.java`.
- Material hazards: `.rad(HazardRegistry.x)` before the shape calls on the material's `DictFrame` line in `OreDictManager`.
- Modifier/transformer: extend `HazardModifier` (`modify(stack, holder, level)`) or `HazardTransformerBase` (`transformPost`, registered in `registerTrafos()`; beware recursion through `getHazardLevelFromStack`). Exemplars `HazardModifierRTGRadiation.java`, `HazardTransformerRadiationME.java`.
- Radiation backend: extend `ChunkRadiationHandler` (6 abstract + `receive*` hooks; unload by `ChunkCoordIntPair`), select it after the PRISM line in `RadiationConfig.loadFromConfig`. Exemplar `ChunkRadiationHandlerSimple.java`.
- Neutron system: see `handler/neutron/package-info.java`; new `NeutronType`, `MyNeutronHandler` with node/`makeNode`/stream classes; TE creates streams on server tick and removes its node in `invalidate`/`onChunkUnload` (`TileEntityPileBase` exemplar is @Deprecated).
- Atmosphere provider / sealable block: exemplars `tileentity/machine/TileEntityAirPump.java` (L98/148/184), `blocks/machine/MachineFan.java` (isSealed only).
- Satellite: `SatelliteX extends SatelliteBase` (`getType`, NBT/ByteBuf chain, `CMD_*` in `onCommandImpl`); `registerSatellite(...)` at the END of `XSatelliteRegistry.register()`; `getTargetDimensionId` branch if body-specific; `SatelliteMiner.registerCargo` for miners; `markDirty()`. Exemplar `SatelliteDeathRay.java`.
- Bobmazon offer: `standard.add(new Offer(stack, Requirement.X, cost))` in `init()` (idempotent, cleared each world load).
- Hazmat rating: `HazmatRegistry.registerHazmat(item, coefficient * helmet)` in `initDefault()`; ArmorFSB pieces push via `setRadResist`; other mods via `Compat.registerCompatHazmat`; user `hbmRadResist.json` replaces the whole map.
- AE2 storage: `IMEInventory<IAEItemStack>` + `IExternalStorageHandler` registered in `AE2CompatHandler.registerHandler()`. Exemplar `MSUExternalStorageHandler.java`.
- Saved data: `MySaveData extends WorldSavedData` with `KEY`, `(String)` ctor, `forWorld`. Exemplar `TomSaveData.java`.
- Microblocks: `registerMicroBlockCompat(ModBlocks.x)` in `MicroBlocksCompatHandler.preInit()`.

### Gotchas

- `RadiationConfig.disableNeutron` defaults true (whole neutron-activation path off; key shares the `HAZ_01` prefix with `disableCoaldust`).
- `HazardData.addEntry(type, level, override)` sets `doesOverride` for the whole data; oredict mutex makes only the FIRST matching oredict key count.
- `HazardRegistry.registerItems` runs before `OreDictManager.registerOres`; lookup is lazy so this works.
- `AtmosphereBlob.isBlockSealed`: `BlockDummyable` never seals unless it is `IBlockSealable` (checked first); slabs/stairs/panes leak air. `ThreeInts` is mutable and used as a HashMap key in `AtmosphereBlob.plants`.
- `XSatelliteRegistry` ids: never insert in the middle; duplicate class/item registrations silently ignored. `SatelliteSavedData.readFromNBT` NPEs on unknown ids.
- `HTTPHandler` version check points at JameH2's branch; `MicroBlocksCompatHandler` skips meta 15; `HazmatRegistry` piece weights 0.2/0.4/0.3/0.1.
- `ContaminationUtil.contaminate` relies on deprecated `ArmorUtil.checkForHazmat/Haz2`; its javadoc recommends `ArmorRegistry` + `HbmLivingProps` for new hazards.
- Smells: `NeutronNodeWorld.java:75` TODO pile uncaching; `ChunkAtmosphereHandler.java:215` TODO CO2; `SatelliteRailgun.java:93` TODO projectile types (`new Random()` per shot); `OreDictManager` ~L1040 TODO hazard shapes; dead `ChunkRadiationHandlerNT`/`3D`/`Blank`, `HbmMaterials`, `Identity.value`, `BlockMigrations.doMigraion`; `PollutionHandler.decorateMob` heals mobs on every spawn event subtype; `AnnihilatorSavedData` swallows Throwable.

## 14. Dimensions and world generation (NTM: Space)

### Purpose

`com/hbm/dim/` (159 Java files, all Space-added) defines the KSP-derived solar system (`SolarSystem`/`CelestialBody` builder tree, orbital mechanics, delta-V), replaces the overworld provider with `WorldProviderEarth`, and adds dimensions Mun, Duna, Ike, Eve, Dres, Moho, Minmus, Laythe, Tekto, Thatmo and Orbit. Each body is a package with `WorldProvider<Body> extends WorldProviderCelestial`, `ChunkProvider<Body> extends ChunkProviderCelestial`, `BiomeGen*<Body> extends BiomeGenBaseCelestial`, optional `genlayer/`, and `WorldGenerator<Body> implements IWorldGenerator`. Per-body traits (`CBT_*`) persist in `SolarSystemWorldSavedData` and sync via `PermaSyncHandler`. `com/hbm/world/` holds feature generators (`OreLayer3D`, `OreCave`, `BedrockOre`, `SchistStratum`, `DepthDeposit`, `Meteorite`), the NBT/jigsaw structure system with LogicBlock scripting, legacy generators and `MapGenChainloader`.

### Key files

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `dim/SolarSystem.java`, `CelestialBody.java` | Body tree (`init()` chained builders), `Body` enum (ordinal = ore meta, max 16; `getBody()` falls back to Kerbin for name mismatches), sky metrics, delta-V (`getCostBetween`, `calculateHohmannTransfer`); body data + builder (`withMassRadius`, `withOrbitalParameters`, `withTraits`, `withSatellites`, `withBlockTextures` (mandatory: `BlockOre.registerBlockIcons` dereferences `getStoneTexture()` for every non-ORBIT Body)), lookups (`getBody(int / String / World)` fall back to dim 0; `getBodyOrNull`), trait API (`getTraits` returns the LIVE saved map when overrides exist, not a clone; `setTraits` replaces the whole set; use `modifyTraits`), `getGravity`, `inOrbit`, `getMeta`. |

### Patterns

- Body registration is a builder tree; `CelestialBody(String, int dimId, Body type)` registers `dimToBodyMap` and `canLand`.
- Per-body package convention: `WorldProvider<Body>` (`registerWorldChunkManager`, `getDimensionName`, `createChunkGenerator`, `getStone`), `ChunkProvider<Body>`, `BiomeGen<Body>` (static final instances from `SpaceConfig` IDs; `genTerrainBlocks` compares against the planet stone), `WorldGenerator<Body>` (registers structures/ore visibility in the ctor, ores in `generate`).
- Single-biome bodies: `WorldChunkManagerHell(biome, 0.0F)`; multi-biome: `createBiomeGenerators(seed)` GenLayer chain -> `WorldChunkManagerCelestial(new BiomeGenLayers(biomeLayer, detailLayer, seed))`.
- Ores: `DungeonToolbox.generateOre(world, rand, x, z, veinCount, amount, minY, variance, ore, CelestialBody.getMeta(world), provider.getStone())`; visibility `BlockOre.addValidBody(ore, Body.X)`.
- Config keys: `17.NN_` dims, `16.NN_` biomes, `1.9x_` space general, `2.xx` ores/oil, `5.xx` structures; dimension IDs count up from 413_015, biome IDs down from 126.
- Structures: `.nbt` under `assets/hbm/structures/<group>/`, static in `StructureManager`, `NBTStructure.registerStructure(dimId, new SpawnCondition("name") {{ structure = new JigsawPiece("name", StructureManager.x, heightOffset); canSpawn = biome -> ...; spawnWeight = n; }})` in an IWorldGenerator ctor; jigsaw via `pools`/`startPool`/`sizeLimit`/`fallback`; `registerNullWeight` competes in the same roll; one candidate per `structureMaxChunks` grid cell.
- Traits: defaults via `withTraits`; runtime via `CelestialBody.modifyTraits(world, trait)`; read via `getTrait(world, CBT_X.class)`; client copies in `SolarSystemWorldSavedData.clientTraits`; `update(isRemote, body)` runs every tick on both sides.
- Vacuum handling: `isHellWorld` trick on low-pressure bodies; `ModEventHandler.onBucketUse` handles pressurised rooms; `updateWaterOpacity` mutates `Blocks.water` opacity globally every world tick (flickers between dims).

### How-to

- New landable body: `SpaceConfig` dim + biome ids; append `FOO("foo")` to `SolarSystem.Body` and `new CelestialBody("foo", SpaceConfig.fooDimension, Body.FOO).withMassRadius(...).withOrbitalParameters(...).withRotationalPeriod(...).withColor(...).withBlockTextures(...)` (+ traits) inside the parent's `withSatellites`; texture `textures/misc/space/foo.png`; package `dim/foo/` (BiomeGenFoo, ChunkProviderFoo, WorldProviderFoo, WorldGeneratorFoo); `PlanetGen.init()`: `registerDimension(...)` above the `WorldGeneratorCelestial` line and `GameRegistry.registerWorldGenerator(new WorldGeneratorFoo(), 1)`; `ItemBedrockOreNew.CelestialBedrockOre` `register(Body.FOO, ...)`; optional `OreCave`/`OreLayer3D` in PostLoad, `ModBiomes` tags, `WorldConfig` knobs. Exemplar `dim/moon/WorldProviderMoon.java`.
- Multi-biome body: `BiomeGenBase<Body>` with static instances + `BiomeDecoratorCelestial(stone)`; root `GenLayer<Body>Biomes`, shaping layers, `createBiomeGenerators`; biome-dependent carving pre/post `replaceBlocksForBiome` (`ChunkProviderDuna`). Exemplar `dim/duna/WorldProviderDuna.java`.
- Ore vein: in the body's `WorldGenerator<Body>.generate` add `DungeonToolbox.generateOre(world, rand, x, z, veins, amount, minY, variance, ModBlocks.ore_x, CelestialBody.getMeta(world), provider.getStone())`, `BlockOre.addValidBody(ModBlocks.ore_x, Body.X)` in the ctor, a `WorldConfig` knob for counts. Exemplars `dim/moon/WorldGeneratorMoon.java`, `dim/duna/WorldGeneratorDuna.java`.
- Jigsaw / NBT structure: `StructureManager` static; `NBTStructure.registerStructure(dimId, new SpawnCondition("name") {{ structure = new JigsawPiece(...); pools = ...; startPool = "..."; sizeLimit = 8; minHeight/maxHeight; canSpawn = biome -> ...; spawnWeight = n; }})` in the generator ctor; per-piece options `instanceLimit` (max copies per structure), `required` (must be placed), `blockTable` (`Map<Block, BlockSelector>` random substitution) and `platform`; `ServerConfig.STRUCTURE_DEBUG` + `SpawnCondition.buildAll(world, x, y, z)` place every piece for inspection. Exemplars `dim/WorldGeneratorCelestial.java` (meteor dungeon pools), overworld `world/gen/NTMWorldGenerator.java` (+ `StructureConfig` weight).
- Trait: `CBT_Foo extends CelestialBodyTrait` with a public no-arg ctor, NBT and `serialize`/`deserialize`; append `registerTrait("foo", CBT_Foo.class)` at the END of the static block; read with `CelestialBody.getTrait(world, CBT_Foo.class)`. Exemplar `dim/trait/CBT_Temperature.java`.
- Carver: `MapGen*` subclass called directly from `ChunkProvider<Body>.getChunkPrimer` via `func_151539_a(this, worldObj, x, z, buffer.blocks)`; set `carver.meta = (byte) CelestialBody.getMeta(world)` (or `Body.X.ordinal()`) and `carver.setMetas(buffer.metas)` first so placed stone/ore decode to the right planet (`ChunkProviderTekto` L35-61, `ChunkProviderEve` L42-59). Exemplar `dim/moon/ChunkProviderMoon.java`.
- Weather / sky / fog per body: override on `WorldProvider<Body>` the `WorldProviderCelestial` hooks `updateWeather`, `getFogColor(solarAngle, y)`, `getSkyColor(camera, partialTicks)`, `getStarBrightness`, `getSunBrightness`, `getCloudHeight`, `getSkyRenderer`/`getCloudRenderer`/`getWeatherRenderer`, `calculateCelestialAngle`, `hasIce`, `hasLife` (gates mob spawning and decorators; overridden by Earth and Laythe), `getWaterOpacity`, `getStone`, `getBedrockAcid`; decorator knobs in `BiomeDecoratorCelestial` (`lakeBlock`, `lakeChancePerChunk`, `lavaCount`, `coralPerChunk`, `waterPlantsPerChunk`, `rubberPlantsPerChunk`, `seaLevel`). Exemplar `dim/duna/WorldProviderDuna.java` (dust storms).
- LogicBlock action: `actions.put("FOO", FOO)` in `world/gen/util/LogicBlockActions.initialize()`.

### Gotchas

- `Body.ordinal()` is persisted ore metadata: never reorder; max 16 entries (11 used).
- `OreLayer3D`/`OreCave` fire only for decorators that post `DecorateBiomeEvent.Pre`.
- `NBTStructure.GenStructure.validBiomeCache` is never invalidated; register structures before world load.
- Twelve celestial biomes (Duna plains, Thatmo, all Tekto and Eve biomes) use `Math.random()` in `genTerrainBlocks` (non-deterministic terrain).
- `StructureConfig.structureMaxChunks` field default 12 vs config default 16; `setDef` only replaces non-positive values.
- `BiomeGenNoMansLand`/`WorldProviderTom`/`BiomeDecoratorNoMansLand` are dead; `BiomeGenNoMansLand` hard-codes id 99 (= default `mohoLavaBiome`).
- Eve's `WorldGenElectricVolcano`/`WorldGenEveSpike` cascade chunks (TODO at `WorldGeneratorEve.java:60`); `WorldGeneratorIke` scans every column for `ModBlocks.pedestal` each chunk.
- `SpaceConfig` duplicate prefixes `17.10_` (tekto/thatmo) and `16.24_` (eveRiver/laytheCoast); `WorldGeneratorDres` registers `ore_lanthanium` twice; `ModBiomes.init()` double-registers Duna dictionary types.
- Smells: `SkyProviderCelestial.java:279` TODO fix EVERYTHING; `SkyProviderThatmo.java:65` @Spaghetti; `WorldGeneratorIke.java:67` "HACKIEST hack"; `NBTStructure.java:87` @Untested; `TimedGenerator` @Deprecated/@Spaghetti yet ticked from `worldTick`; `CellularDungeon*`/`JungleDungeon` @Deprecated but generated; `ChunkProviderTekto.java:28` `reclamp = false` comment; `world/test/*` unreferenced scaffolding.

### Open questions

- Is Thatmo intentionally unbound (WIP) or a regression? Binding needs a `Body.THATMO` entry, the `(name, id, Body)` ctor, generator registration and a bedrock table.
- Whether `OreLayer3D`'s z-axis bug should be fixed (changes existing strata); whether unused `GenLayerDunaHills`/`PolarHills` are intentional; `CBT_COMPROMISED` (inner, registered as `infected`) vs the empty top-level `CBT_Compromised`.

## 15. Client rendering, models, animations, particles, sound

### Purpose

`main/ResourceManager` (1868 lines, no `@SideOnly`; static init needs a GL context) registers OBJ models (`HFRWavefrontObject`, mostly `.asVBO()`), textures, 6 JSON gun animations and 1 Collada door animation. `ClientProxy` is the registration hub: 278 TESRs, 155 entity renderers, 60 legacy ISBRH handlers plus `RenderISBRHUniversal`, ~90 explicit `IItemRenderer`s plus automatic ones for every `IItemRendererProvider`, the client event handlers, reload listeners (`HFRModelReloader` rebuilds OBJ/VBO on F3+T, `QMAWLoader`), and the 67-branch `effectNT` particle dispatcher. Two animation systems: the JSON/Blender "bus" keyframes (`render/anim`, sedna guns and SEDNA doors) and Drillgon's Collada `animloader` (seal door only). Particles are vanilla `EntityFX` subclasses spawned from `AuxParticlePacketNT` NBT; sound loops are `AudioWrapper`/`AudioDynamic` keyed by `NTMSounds` ids from `sounds.json`.

### Patterns

- Proxy lifecycle: `registerPreRenderInfo` before `ModBlocks`/`ModItems`, `registerRenderInfo` after; inside it TESRs -> item renderers -> entity renderers -> block renderers (item auto-registration depends on TESRs already bound).
- Models: `public static final IModelCustom x = new HFRWavefrontObject(new ResourceLocation(RefStrings.MODID, "models/<cat>/<name>.obj"))[.noSmooth()].asVBO();` + `x_tex` ResourceLocation; renderers `bindTexture(ResourceManager.x_tex); ResourceManager.x.renderPart("Group")`. Group names are the API (`equalsIgnoreCase`); renaming in Blender silently stops a part drawing.
- TESR: `extends TileEntitySpecialRenderer implements IItemRendererProvider`; `glPushMatrix`, `glTranslated(x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5)`, `glEnable(GL_LIGHTING)`, `switch(tile.getBlockMetadata() - BlockDummyable.offset)` cases 2..5 (mapping varies per renderer), bind, render parts with `last + (cur - last) * interp`, restore GL state, `glPopMatrix`; bound with `ClientRegistry.bindTileEntitySpecialRenderer` in `ClientProxy`.
- ISBRH: new blocks implement `ISBRHUniversal`; legacy per-block `renderID` + handler registration is discouraged; VBO models cannot be tessellated (ISBRH needs the non-VBO copies in the `//ISBRHs` section; RBMK models are loaded twice for this reason).
- Bus animation playback: server `HbmAnimationPacket` -> `HbmAnimations.hotbar[slot][index]`; renderer applies `HbmAnimations.applyRelevantTransformation("Bus")` per part; gun configs pick `ResourceManager.<gun>_anim.get("Fire")`.
- Particles: server builds NBT `{type, ...}` and calls `IParticleCreator.sendPacket(world, x, y, z, range, nbt)`; client `effectNT` reads `posX/Y/Z` before dispatch, checks `ParticleCreators.particleCreators`, else the legacy `"name".equals(type)` chain; sheet icons registered in `ModEventHandlerClient.onTextureStitch`.
- Sound: `NTMSounds` string must match a `sounds.json` key whose `sounds[].name` resolves under `assets/hbm/sounds/`; missing events fail silently. Loop pattern in area 5.
- Client event handlers registered on BOTH buses by `ClientProxy.registerClientEventHandler`.
- `@SideOnly(Side.CLIENT)` on 56/65 particle classes but only 10/648 render classes (render/ relies on being reachable only from `ClientProxy`).

### How-to

- TESR machine: triangulated OBJ with normals + named groups under `models/machines/`, texture under `textures/models/machines/`; `ResourceManager` statics; block extends `BlockDummyable`; TE keeps prev/current render fields + `getMaxRenderDistanceSquared`; `RenderX` copying `RenderPump` (incl. `getItemForRenderer` = `Item.getItemFromBlock(ModBlocks.x)` and an anonymous `ItemRenderBase` in `getRenderer`); bind in `ClientProxy.registerTileEntitySpecialRenderer` under the matching comment group; do NOT add a `MinecraftForgeClient.registerItemRenderer` call. Verify with F3+T. Exemplar `render/tileentity/RenderPump.java`.
- ISBRH block: non-VBO `.noSmooth()` model in `//ISBRHs`; block `implements ISBRHUniversal` (`getRenderType() { return renderID; }`, `isOpaqueCube`/`renderAsNormalBlock` false, both render methods using `Tessellator.instance` + `ObjUtil.renderWithIcon` or `RenderBlocksNT`). Exemplar `render/block/RenderBlockRotated.java` (legacy handler) / `blocks/generic/BlockRebar.java`.
- Loop sound: `sounds/block/x.ogg` + `sounds.json` entry + `NTMSounds` constant; TE pattern from area 5; note the proxy drops pitch.
- Server-triggered particle: `@SideOnly ParticleX extends EntityFX`; `XCreator implements IParticleCreator` with static `composeEffect(...)` and `makeParticle(...)`; `particleCreators.put("<key>", new XCreator())` in `ParticleCreators` (key must not collide with the 67 legacy names); do not add branches to `effectNT`. Exemplar `particle/helper/ExplosionSmallCreator.java`.
- Gun bus animation: Blender actions `<Anim>.<Part>`, frame 0 rest pose, YZX Euler, export with `tools/export-json-animation-4_0.py` (or 3_2/2_79) to `models/weapons/animations/<gun>.json`; `ResourceManager` `<gun>_anim = AnimationLoader.load(...)`; renderer applies the root bus unwrapped, wraps child parts; gun config returns the animation per `GunAnimation`; register the renderer in `GunFactoryClient`. Exemplar `render/item/weapon/sedna/ItemRenderSPAS12.java`.
- Entity renderer: `render/entity/<group>/RenderX extends Render` (`doRender` with yaw interpolation, `bindTexture`, `renderAll`); `ResourceManager` entries; `RenderingRegistry.registerEntityRenderingHandler` in `ClientProxy`. Exemplar `render/entity/rocket/RenderMissileGeneric.java`.
- 3D item model without a TESR: `MinecraftForgeClient.registerItemRenderer(ModItems.x, new ItemRenderBase() { ... })` in `ClientProxy.registerItemRenderer` (L519-660); for a plain OBJ item `ItemRenderTransformer(rtp, ttp, stp, rfp, tfp, sfp, rir, tir, sir)` takes rotation/translation/scale triples per view (third person, first person, inventory; swords at L562-564); legacy bulk registrations live in the @Deprecated `ItemRenderLibrary`. Items of TESR machines need nothing (`IItemRendererProvider` auto-registration).
- Keybind: area 1 how-to (`HbmKeybinds` field + `EnumKeybind` constant; existing constants: JETPACK, TOGGLE_JETPACK, TOGGLE_MAGNET, TOGGLE_HEAD, DASH, SLAM, TRAIN, CRANE_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT/LOAD, ABILITY_CYCLE, ABILITY_ALT, TOOL_ALT, TOOL_CTRL, GUN_PRIMARY/SECONDARY/TERTIARY, RELOAD).
- Shader: `<name>.frag` in `assets/hbm/shaders/`; `private static final Shader s = new Shader(new ResourceLocation(RefStrings.MODID, "shaders/<name>.frag"));` in a client-only class; `s.use(); s.setUniform1f(...); draw; s.stop();`. Exemplar `dim/SkyProviderCelestial.java`.

### Gotchas

- Any reference to `ResourceManager` from server-loaded code paths crashes the dedicated server; referencing it before the GL context exists crashes the client.
- `HFRWavefrontObject` rejects groups mixing tris and quads unless `mixedMode = true` (then `renderAll`/`renderPart` throw; only `ObjUtil`/`tessellate*` work).
- `RenderISBRHUniversal` casts the block unconditionally: a block returning `ISBRHUniversal.renderID` without implementing the interface throws ClassCastException in chunk rendering.
- Item renderer auto-registration only covers `IItemRendererProvider`s present at `registerRenderInfo` time; missile parts are handled by `registerMissileItems`.
- Hotbar animations are keyed by unlocalized name and slot (moving the item cancels them); expiry only runs while the HUD is drawn, many times per frame.
- `AudioDynamic` stops when `keepAlive()` is not called each tick (intended failsafe); `ServerProxy.getLoopedSound` returns null.
- `TextureAtlasSpriteMutatable` with a missing base texture crashes stitching; `ObjUtil.setColor` is global mutable tint state.
- Missing-asset references outside `ResourceManager`: `models/BombGenericLarge.obj`, `textures/models/BombGenericLargeLayout.png` (RenderBombMultiLarge), `bombletThetaTexture.png`, `LilBoy2.png`, `ModelCal*.png`, `textures/blocks/test_container.png`.
- Smells: `AnimationLoader.java:68-77` dead `rotmode`; `BusAnimationSequence.java:85` FIXME; `RenderAtmosphericCompressor.java:21`, `ItemRenderQuadro.java:163`, `RenderBomber.java:65`, `TextureAtlasSpriteMutatable.java:24`, `ModEventHandlerRenderer.java:673` TODOs; @Spaghetti `SmallBlockPronter`, `RenderScreenOverlay.renderDashBar`, `ModEventHandlerClient.onPlaySound`; @Untested `RenderScreenOverlay.renderScope`; `ClientProxy` L839 `/// STOP DOING THIS ///`, L825 "particles (abysmal dogshit)", L922 "mk3, only use this one"; `particle/psys/engine` stub; `ItemRenderLibrary` deprecated but registering ~100 renderers.

## 16. Networking, packets, utilities, wiaj

### Purpose

`main/NetworkHandler` is a SimpleNetworkWrapper clone with a byte-discriminator codec (`PrecompilingNetworkCodec`) that can ship precompiled buffers from `PacketThreading`; `packet/PacketDispatcher.registerPackets()` assigns discriminators by registration order. Packet families: TE/entity sync (`BufPacket`/`EntityBufPacket` via `IBufPacketReceiver`), client->server control (`NBTControlPacket`/`NBTItemControlPacket`), particles (`AuxParticlePacketNT`), HUD messages (`PlayerInformPacket`), per-tick global state (`PermaSyncPacket`/`PermaSyncHandler`), legacy one-offs. `com/hbm/util` is the toolbox; `com/hbm/wiaj` ("World In A Jar") is the client-only scripted tutorial viewer opened with Shift+F1 over a registered item.

|---|---|

Discriminators 0-28: TESiren(C), ItemDesignator(S), AuxButton(S), TEVault(C), ParticleBurst(C), ExtProp(C), TEFF(C), ItemBobmazon(S), TEMissileMultipart(C), AuxParticleNT(C), HbmAnimation(C), PlayerInform(C), Keybind(S), NBTControl(S), AnvilCraft(S), ExplosionKnockback(C), ExplosionVanilla...(C), NBTItemControl(S), PermaSync(C), BiomeSync(C), Buf(C), EntityBuf(C), SerializableRecipe(C), HeldItemNBT(C), TransporterLinker(C), GuiLayer(S), MuzzleFlash(C), ContainerNBTComms(C), ContainerNBTComms(S). ### Patterns

- Packet class shape: fields, public no-arg ctor, `fromBytes`/`toBytes`, `public static class Handler implements IMessageHandler<X, IMessage>` returning null; client handlers `@SideOnly` and null-check `theWorld`; server handlers use `ctx.getServerHandler().playerEntity` and must validate.
- Threaded tiers: plain `IMessage` (serialized where written), `ThreadedPacket` (lazy compile on the worker; immutable data only), `PrecompiledPacket` (compiled on the main thread by `preparePacket`; still recompiled once more on the worker after the send).
- Per-tick flush: `waitUntilThreadFinished` then `NetworkHandler.flush()` at `ServerTickEvent` END.
- TE sync / control / container payload / particle / HUD message: see areas 5, 7, 15; container payloads via `ICustomPayloadReceiver.acceptData(side, windowId, nbt)` + `ContainerNBTCommsPacket` (registered on both sides).
- wiaj pipeline: `Jars.initJars()` (ClientProxy) -> tooltip hint `cannery.f1` -> Shift+`HbmKeybinds.qmaw` opens `GuiWorldInAJar(cannery.createScript(), name, icon, seeAlso)`; `JarScript.run()` -> actors `updateActor` -> `JarScene.tick()` -> `IJarAction.act()`; camera state lives on the script.

### How-to

- New packet: class in `packet/toclient/` or `packet/toserver/` implementing `IMessage` (extend `PrecompiledPacket` when it serializes mutable server state and goes through `PacketThreading`); public no-arg ctor; `fromBytes`/`toBytes` in matching order (`BufferUtil` helpers); nested `public static class Handler implements IMessageHandler<X, IMessage>` returning null and releasing stored ByteBufs in `finally`; APPEND `wrapper.registerMessage(X.Handler.class, X.class, i++, Side.CLIENT|SERVER);` at the END of `PacketDispatcher.registerPackets()` (discriminators are positional; an unregistered packet is silently sent as discriminator 0). Prefer the generic paths first: TE state via `serialize`/`deserialize` + `networkPackNT`, GUI input via `IControlReceiver` + `NBTControlPacket`, particles via `IParticleCreator`. Exemplar `packet/toclient/ExplosionKnockbackPacket.java`.
- TE sync: area 5 (`serialize`/`deserialize` + `networkPackNT(range)`). Exemplar `tileentity/machine/TileEntityMachineRadarScreen.java`.
- GUI control: TE `implements IControlReceiver` (`hasPermission(player)`, `receiveControl(player, nbt)`); the GUI sends `PacketDispatcher.wrapper.sendToServer(new NBTControlPacket(nbt, x, y, z))`. Exemplar `tileentity/machine/TileEntityMachineDiesel.java`.
- Item control (GUI opened from a held item): item `implements IItemControlReceiver` (`receiveControl(player, stack, data)`); the GUI sends `new NBTItemControlPacket(data)` and the handler applies it to the sender's held stack. Exemplars `items/tool/ItemRTTYPager.java`, `inventory/gui/GUIScreenFluid.java`.
- HUD message: `ChatBuilder` text + `ServerProxy.ID_*` slot + `PlayerInformPacket(component, id, millis)` via `wrapper.sendTo`. Exemplar `util/ArmorUtil.java`.
- Container payload: `ContainerBase` subclass (tile slots first and completely, then `playerInv`; `canInteractWith` delegates to `tile.isUseableByPlayer`, 128 sq distance) implementing `ICustomPayloadReceiver.acceptData(side, windowId, nbt)`; send `ContainerNBTCommsPacket` (registered on both sides; outbound uses discriminator 28). `detectAndSendChanges` is rarely used (6 overrides): GUI state normally arrives through the TE sync. Exemplar `inventory/container/ContainerPneumoStorageAccess.java`.
- PermaSync field: append at the END of both `PermaSyncHandler.writePacket` and `readPacket`, leading boolean for optional data, keep it small (one stream per player per tick). Exemplar `packet/PermaSyncHandler.java`.
- New cannery: `CanneryXxx extends CanneryBase` (`getIcon`, `getName` -> `cannery.xxx`, `createScript()` building `WorldInAJar`, `JarScript`, `JarScene`s with `ActionSetZoom` first, `ActionSetBlock`/`ActionWait`, `ActionCreateActor(id, new ActorTileEntity(new RenderXxx(), nbt))`, `ActionUpdateActor`, `ActorFancyPanel(font, x, y, new Object[][]{{I18nUtil.resolveKey("cannery.xxx.0")}}, 250).setColors(colorCopper).setOrientation(Orientation.BOTTOM)`, `ActionRotateBy`/`ActionOffsetBy`); `Dummies.JarDummyConnector` tiles so cables render; reset mutable actor values at scene start (rewind reuses NBT instances); `canneries.put(new ComparableStack(ModBlocks.xxx), new CanneryXxx())` in `Jars.initJars()`; lang keys. Exemplar `wiaj/cannery/CanneryStirling.java`.

### Gotchas

- Never insert a `registerMessage` line mid-list; `ContainerNBTCommsPacket` is registered twice (27/28) and outbound uses 28.
- `ThreadedPacket` instances must not be reused on the threaded path (released buffer -> `IllegalReferenceCountException`).
- `PacketThreading.init()` only via `/ntmpackets`; validation inverted; single worker with unbounded queue.
- `PermaSyncPacket` is one contiguous stream; a write/read mismatch desyncs everything after it.
- `I18nUtil` server sentinel; `EnumUtil.grabEnumSafely` silently remaps bad ordinals; `HbmAnimationPacket`/`PlayerInformPacket` swallow all exceptions.
- `ArmorUtil` static initializer throws `AssertionError` when Fisk's Superheroes is present but not reflectable.
- wiaj: `JarScript.ffwTarget`/`freeRun` are static (one fast-forward at a time); `ActorFancyPanel`/`ActorBasicPanel` create client objects at construction; `GuiWorldInAJar` ctor carries a large commented-out test script.
- Smells: `PermaSyncHandler.boykissers` / `/// SHITTY MEMES ///`; `AuxButtonPacket` still constructed in 19 files; `CompatEnergyControl` deprecated key constants; `EntityDamageUtil` deprecated overloads; `ActorFancyPanel.java:340` TODO scaled stacks; `Calculator.java:167` TODO BigDecimal; `ModEventHandler.java:1563-1572` comment documents the packet-thread race and its fix.

### Patterns

- Version: `V T (X)` = next release, build type, days since 2010-10-10; CI seds both `RefStrings.VERSION` and `mod_build_number`; local releases bump both by hand.
- Lang namespaces (en_US unique keys): item 3426, tile 1589, hbmfluid 266, container 221, desc 182, achievement 135, hbmmat 134, gun 126, book_lore 108, cannery 94, book 92, death 77, trait 52, gui 52, entity 45, body 32, armor 30, and smaller. `$` = line break (consumed by `resolveKeyArray`/`autoBreakWithParagraphs`; a literal `$` cannot be shown through them), `§` colour codes, `%` args (`%%` for literal), `#` comments.
- Lang key families: `item.<unloc>.name` and `item.<unloc>.<enum_lower>.name` (`ItemEnumMulti`), `item.<unloc>.desc` (`ItemCustomLore`, `$` line break, `.desc.P11` variant), `tile.<name>.name`/`.desc` and `tile.<name>.<enum_lower>.name` (`BlockEnumMulti`), `container.<name>`, `hbmfluid.<name>`, `hbmmat.<name>`, `hbmpseudofluid.<name>`, `entity.hbm.<name>.name`, `hbm.key.<name>`, `potion.hbm_<name>`, `itemGroup.tab<Name>`, `achievement.<k>`, `cannery.<name>[.N]`, `trait.<name>`, `desc.item.<name>`, `gun.<name>`, `book_lore.<name>`, `death.<name>`, `gui.<name>`, `body.<name>`, `armor.<name>`, `commands.<cmd>.<msg>`, `bomb.<code>`, `tool.ability.<name>`.
- Texture naming: items `setTextureName(RefStrings.MODID + ":x")` -> `textures/items/x.png`; blocks `setBlockTextureName` -> `textures/blocks/x.png`; models under `textures/models/<category>/` mirroring `models/<category>/`; GUIs `textures/gui/<category>/gui_<name>.png`.
- Model registration: `HFRWavefrontObject(...).asVBO()` for new models; `AdvancedModelLoader.loadModel` is legacy (and the only way to load `.hmf`); Collada and JSON animations via `ColladaLoader.load`/`AnimationLoader.load`.
- Sound registration is data-only (`<group>.<camelName>` -> `sounds/<group>/<file>.ogg`; categories player/block/record/hostile/ambient/neutral/music; `stream` for long loops).
- Structures: `public static final NBTStructure x = new NBTStructure(new ResourceLocation(RefStrings.MODID, "structures/<sub>/<file>.nbt"))`.
- Line endings: root Markdown LF; lang files mixed (en_US/pl_PL/ru_RU/zh_CN/en_AU LF; de_DE/fr_FR/it_IT/uk_UA/test CRLF).

### How-to

- Localized name/tooltip: see CLAUDE.md; per-variant names via `getUnlocalizedName(ItemStack)` (`ItemStampBook` L38-41) or `BlockEnumMulti`/`IBlockMulti` for blocks.
- QMAW page: `manual/<category>/<slug>.json` copying `manual/machine/assembler.json`; include `"trigger": []` when there are no triggers; content per STYLEGUIDE; dev run picks it up on F3+T (watch for `[QMAW] Error reading manual`).
- NBT structure: file under `structures/`, `StructureManager` static, check the log for `NBT Structure not found`, wire into worldgen (area 14).
- Sound: OGG under `sounds/<group>/`, `sounds.json` entry, play with `"hbm:<group>.<event>"`.
- OBJ model: `models/<category>/<name>.obj` + `textures/models/<category>/<name>.png` + `ResourceManager` statics (do not create new `.hmf`).
- Weapon animation JSON: see area 15.
- OC floppy: `disks/<sanitized>/...` + `disks.put("Name", new FloppyDisk("Name", OCColors.X.ordinal()))` in `CompatHandler.init()` + recipe after the `oc:floppy` check (item exists only after `registerFloppy`; the recipe line dereferences `disk.item` even when loading failed).
- Access transformer: append `public net.minecraft.pkg.Class field_x # mcpName` (SRG names), then `./gradlew clean setupDecompWorkspace`.
- Version bump: `mod_build_number=<days>` in `gradle.properties` and `VERSION = "1.0.27 BETA (<days>)"` in `RefStrings`; `./gradlew build` (JDK 8). Publish: `curseforge.properties` from the example, notes in `changelog` (`## Changed`/`## Fixed`), `./gradlew curse`; maven: `maven.properties` (`username`/`password`), `./gradlew publish`.
- Compile-time mod dependency: `compileOnly("group:Artifact:version:classifier") { transitive = false }` (repositories only if not already listed); guard usage at runtime; re-run `setupDecompWorkspace`.

### Gotchas

- The Gradle project version is bracketed (`[1.0.27_X5778_H261]`); the maven publication uses the unbracketed `version_name`.
- ForgeGradle 1.2 + Gradle 4.4.1 need JDK 8; the plugin coordinate is dynamic, so builds are not reproducible over time.
- `en_US.lang` has 23 duplicate keys (last wins; e.g. `hbmfluid.blood`, `item.powder_zinc.name`, `commands.station.*`); translations carry stale keys never flagged.
- `QMAWLoader.registerJson` NPEs on a page without `trigger` (caught, page skipped); a page with empty `content` strings still registers.
- `processResources` only filters `mcmod.info`; the `credits` value comes verbatim from the ISO-8859-1 `.properties` (mojibake, doubled paren, missing commas, `mikkerlo` twice).
- `HmfModelLoader` is @Deprecated but registered; `StructureManager.excavator` points at a missing file; `models/weapons/.obj` is unparseable.
- Smells: `build.gradle` L49 codechicken eclipse hack and L162 reobf hack; three hand-maintained Blender scripts; `en_US.lang:373-404` commented-out `#book.rbmk.*` block.

### Open questions

- Meaning of the `_H261` suffix; whether the 69 unreferenced `sounds.json` keys and 36 unreferenced models are built dynamically or dead; purpose of `my_hecking_realism.png`/`ABC123.png`; whether `soundCategory.ntmMachines` is planned; whether `maven.ntmr.dev` credentials exist for this fork.

## 18. OpenComputers integration

### Purpose

~64 tile entities expose OC components through one contract, `CompatHandler.OCComponent` (extends OC `SimpleComponent`, `SidedComponent`, `ManagedPeripheral`; `@Optional.InterfaceList` + `@SimpleComponent.SkipInjection`), each machine adding `@Callback`-annotated `Object[] name(Context, Arguments)` methods, with `TileEntityProxyCombo` ports forwarding calls to the multiblock core. `CompatHandler.init()` (PostLoad, `MainRegistry` L614) registers read-only floppies from `assets/hbm/disks/` and their recipes; `BlockOpenComputersCablePaintable` is a colour-matched OC cable. OC's API is a `compileOnly` dependency; everything is soft-gated with `@Optional` and `Loader.isModLoaded("OpenComputers")`. HBM uses only `li.cil.oc.api.*` (no `Machine`/`Architecture`/`Driver`), so OC-LuaJIT (a replacement Lua VM behind OC's unchanged `Machine`) inherits OC's component marshalling untouched.

### Component registry (name -> class)

`ntm_null` default; `ntm_launch_pad` LaunchPadBase; `ntm_rocket_pad` LaunchPadRocket; `ntm_custom_launch_pad` LaunchTable; `reactor_control`, `research_reactor`, `breeding_reactor`, `zirnox_reactor`, `watz_reactor`, `ntm_icf_reactor`, `ntm_pwr_control`; `dfc_emitter/receiver/stabilizer/injector` Core*; `ntm_geiger`; `microwave`; `ntm_radar`; `ntm_stardar`; `ntm_atmospheric_vent` AirPump; `ntm_combustion_engine`; `ntm_gas_turbine`; `ntm_turbine` (MachineTurbine, LargeTurbine, IndustrialTurbine (different method set), Chungus); `ntm_coker`; `ntm_pa_dipole/quad/rfc/detector/source`; `ntm_fusion_breeder/boiler/klystron/torus/mhdt`; `ntm_fluid_tank` (FluidTank, Barrel); `ntm_energy_storage` (BatteryBase, REDD, Socket with differing `getEnergyInfo`); `ntm_energy_storage_legacy` MachineBattery; `rbmk_console/crane/lever/terminal/keypad/gauge/graph/indicator/numitron/fuel_rod/control_rod/boiler/heater/cooler/outgasser`; `ntm_turret`; `ntm_artillery`; `ntm_fluid_counter_valve`; `ntm_telex`; `radio_torch`; `capacitor`; `ntm_fluid_pump`; `ntm_power_gauge`; `ntm_fluid_gauge`.

### Patterns

- Class shape: `@Optional.InterfaceList({@Optional.Interface(iface = "li.cil.oc.api.network.SimpleComponent", modid = "OpenComputers")}) class X ... implements SimpleComponent, CompatHandler.OCComponent`. The direct `SimpleComponent` is REQUIRED: OC's `ClassTransformer` injects the node/Environment implementation only when the class's OWN interface list contains it (inherited via `OCComponent` does not count; that is also why `OCComponent` carries `@SimpleComponent.SkipInjection`).
- Callback shape: `@Callback(direct = true[, limit = N][, doc = "..."]) @Optional.Method(modid = "OpenComputers") public Object[] name(Context context, Arguments args)`. Counts (382 total): 275 plain `direct = true`, 13 `direct = true, doc = ...`, 35 `limit = 4` (7 of them with `doc`), 38 `limit = 2`, 1 `limit = 3`, 1 `limit = 1`, 17 bare `@Callback` (non-direct), 1 getter, 1 setter. `Context` is never used. Arguments via `args.checkInteger` (88), `checkString` (30), `checkBoolean` (28), `checkDouble` (15), `checkTable` (1), `checkAny` (1), `optInteger` (1).
- Dispatch semantics (OC `Callbacks.scala`): every HBM component is a `ManagedPeripheral`, so OC registers every name from `methods()` as a `PeripheralCallback` with a synthetic annotation `direct = true, limit = 100, doc = ""`, on BOTH direct wiring and proxy ports, and only then adds reflected `@Callback` methods whose names are not already listed. Consequences: annotations on listed names are ignored; a callback that must stay non-direct or rate-limited must be left OUT of `methods()` (still reachable by reflection when a cable touches the core, but not through ports); OC skips its per-class cache for `ManagedPeripheral` hosts and re-reflects on every call.
- Returns: `new Object[] {}` void; `{true}/{false}`; `{null, "message"}` error tuple; aggregate `getInfo`; `getEnergyInfo` = `{power, max}`; `getPos` = `{x, y, z}`; tables as `LinkedHashMap<String, Object>` or `String[]`; any boxed Number passes through.
- Proxy forwarding requires the port dummies to be `TileEntityProxyCombo().power()` or `.fluid()` and metadata 6..11; `canConnectNode` is consulted on the core too.
- Floppies: `disks.put(name, new FloppyDisk(name, OCColors.X.ordinal()))`; `fromClass(MainRegistry.class, RefStrings.MODID, "disks/" + sanitizeName(name))`; only `PWRangler` (cyan) ships.
- OC-LuaJIT relation: `Machine.add(LuaJITArchitecture.class)`; `NativeLuaArchitecture` subclass owning only the VM factory and persistence; component invocation, argument boxing and return marshalling are OC's. HBM emits no OC signals. Only three HBM behaviours depend on marshalling details (`Map.containsKey(Integer)` in `setCustomMapValues`, `checkAny == null` in Telex, mixed boxed numeric returns), all inherited unchanged.

### How-to

- Single-block component: annotations + `implements SimpleComponent, CompatHandler.OCComponent`; `getComponentName()` unique `ntm_*`; `getX` callbacks `direct = true`; setters clamp/validate and return `{}` or an error tuple; no world mutation in direct callbacks; add `getInfo`. Exemplar `TileEntityGeiger.java`.
- Multiblock component: everything above plus `methods()` (`String[]` of names) and `invoke(String, Context, Arguments)` (`switch` + `throw new NoSuchMethodException()`); keep both in sync (nothing checks); leave non-direct callbacks out of the list. Exemplar `TileEntityMachineFluidTank.java`.
- Subclass callbacks: add annotated methods; if the base has `methods()`/`invoke()`, override both re-listing the FULL set (`TileEntityTurretArty` is the only genuine re-listing exemplar and it drops `getPos`); to change a return shape, override with the same annotations.
- Lua table / error / optional args: `LinkedHashMap` + `new Object[] {map}`; `{null, "reason"}`; `args.checkTable(0)` with boxed Integer keys 1..N; `args.optInteger(i, default)`; for optional strings use `args.count()`/`args.isString(i)`/`optString` (`checkAny` throws "value expected, got no value" when fewer arguments are passed; it returns null only for an explicit nil).
- Restrict sides: override `@Optional.Method public boolean canConnectNode(ForgeDirection side)`. Exemplar `TileEntityTurretBaseNT`.
- ROR (Redstone-over-Radio) endpoint: tile `implements IRORValueProvider` (`provideRORValue(String)` answering `VAL:<name>` queries) and/or `IRORInteractive` (`runRORFunction(String name, String[] params)` for `FUN:<name>!<param>` commands; `NAME_SEPARATOR = "!"`, `PARAM_SEPARATOR = ":"`, helpers `getCommand`/`getParams`/`parseInt`); `getFunctionInfo()` lists them for the reader/logic GUIs, and `TileEntityRadioTorchReader` lowercases the name before lookup, so compare lowercase. 42 providers / 27 interactives exist; `TileEntityProxyCombo` forwards both to the core.
- Addon or compat listener: `CompatExternal.registerRecipeRegisterListener(IRecipeRegisterListener)` (fires only in the defaults branch of `SerializableRecipe.initialize`) and `registerFluidRegisterListener(IFluidRegisterListener)` (fires in `Fluids.init` and `reloadFluids`). A new soft dependency follows `CompatHandler`/`AE2CompatHandler`: static `init()` called from `MainRegistry.PostLoad` behind `Loader.isModLoaded(modid)`, `@Optional.Method`/`@Optional.Interface` on every member touching the foreign API, `Compat.tryLoadItem(modid, name)` for items, and both gates (`Loader.isModLoaded` at init, `Compat.MOD_X` at registration) for conditional blocks/TEs.
- PermaSync field: area 16 how-to.
- Floppy disk: see area 17; keep programs 5.2-safe (no `//`, `utf8`, `goto`) if they should run under OC-LuaJIT; `PWRangler.lua` currently uses `//` and would need `math.floor(a / b)` rewrites.

### Gotchas

- `TileEntityWatz` and `TileEntityLaunchTable` implement `OCComponent` without a direct `SimpleComponent`: OC never injects a node (Watz may still be reachable via its ports; LaunchTable is dead as a component).
- 8 sites use `modid = "opencomputers"` (`TileEntityProxyCombo` x2, `TileEntityMachineFluidTank`, `TileEntityMachineBattery`, `TileEntityBatteryBase`, `TileEntityBarrel`, `TileEntityMachineCoker`, `TileEntityRBMKHeater`); FML's `Loader.isModLoaded`/`ModAPIManager.hasAPI` are exact-match, so those interfaces are stripped even with OC present. For the six TEs it is harmless (OCComponent still supplies `SimpleComponent`); for the proxy it strips `OCComponent`, i.e. `methods()`/`invoke()`/`canConnectNode` would be invisible to OC. Same code exists upstream; confirm in-game before changing behaviour, but normalising the string is safe.
- `direct = true` callbacks run on OC's worker threads; RBMK console/control, PWR, Telex and radio torch (reflection-only classes) really do run there; listed turret setters are direct regardless. `worldObj.isRemote` checks in callbacks are dead code.
- `args.checkInteger` truncates Lua doubles and HBM narrows further (`(short)` in `setModeLow`).
- `steamTypeToInt` returns `Object[]`; unwrap `[0]` when composing.
- `TileEntityTurretBaseArtillery.getCurrentTarget` does `targetQueue.get(0)` without an empty check.
- `@Optional.Method` also strips `getComponentName()`/`canConnectNode()` without OC; never call them from non-OC code.
- `TileEntityMicrowave` ships test callbacks (`test`, `variableget`, `variableset`).
- Component-name reuse with divergent APIs (`ntm_turbine` x4, `ntm_energy_storage` x3).
- Smells: `// :vomit:` at `TileEntityTurretBaseNT.java:1013`/`TileEntityTurretArty.java:472`; `TileEntityProxyCombo.java:47-48` early-name-lookup rant and L501 `// please work`; `CompatHandler.java:251` SkipInjection comment; `TileEntityCraneConsole` "if this doesnt work im going to die"; `TileEntityRadioTelex.java:299`; 20 of 69 callback files use the `// do some opencomputer stuff` marker; `limit = 4` on setters is inconsistent (some setters plain direct, FluidPump limits getters too).

### Open questions

- Exactly when OC creates the injected node and whether it re-reads `getComponentName()` later (a freshly placed proxy may register as `ntm_null` until recreated).
- Whether `Arguments.checkTable` returns a map with Integer or Double keys (`setCustomMapValues` silently no-ops in the latter case); same under OC-LuaJIT.
- `SimpleComponent.SkipInjection` and `Items.registerFloppy` are assumed unchanged between MightyPirates OC `1.7.10-forge~1.8.9` and GTNH OC 1.12.x (no GTNH jar here).
- Whether thread-unsafe world access in direct callbacks has produced real crashes in this fork.
